items.title_en: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
items.abstract_en: Deeper neural networks are more difficult to train. We present a residual learning framework to ease the training of networks that are substantially deeper than those used previously. We explicitly reformulate the layers as learning residual functions with reference to the layer inputs, instead of learning unreferenced functions. We provide comprehensive empirical evidence showing that these residual networks are easier to optimize, and can gain accuracy from considerably increased depth. On the ImageNet dataset we evaluate residual nets with a depth of up to 152 layers---8x deeper than VGG nets but still having lower complexity. An ensemble of these residual nets achieves 3.57% error on the ImageNet test set. This result won the 1st place on the ILSVRC 2015 classification task. We also present analysis on CIFAR-10 with 100 and 1000 layers. The depth of representations is of central importance for many visual recognition tasks. Solely due to our extremely deep representations, we obtain a 28% relative improvement on the COCO object detection dataset. Deep residual nets are foundations of our submissions to ILSVRC & COCO 2015 competitions, where we also won the 1st places on the tasks of ImageNet detection, ImageNet localization, COCO detection, and COCO segmentation.

items.title_zh: 用于图像识别的深度残差学习
items.abstract_zh: 更深的神经网络难以训练。我们提出一种残差学习框架，使训练比以往深得多的网络变得容易。具体做法是把网络层重新表述为学习相对于该层输入的残差函数，而非学习无参照的函数。大量实证表明，残差网络更易优化，并可从显著增加的深度中获得精度提升。在 ImageNet 上我们评估了深达 152 层的残差网络——比 VGG 深 8 倍但复杂度更低。这些残差网络的集成在 ImageNet 测试集上取得 3.57% 的错误率，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 分类任务第一名。我们还在 CIFAR-10 上分析了 100 层与 1000 层的网络。表征深度对许多视觉识别任务至关重要：仅因采用极深的表征，我们在 COCO 目标检测数据集上获得 28% 的相对提升。深度残差网络是我们参加 ILSVRC 与 COCO 2015 竞赛的基础，并在 ImageNet 检测、ImageNet 定位、COCO 检测与 COCO 分割任务中均获第一。
items.highlight_zh: 提出残差学习，让 152 层网络更易训练且精度更高
items.digest_zh:
要解决的问题：神经网络越堆越深，理论上表达力更强，但实践中深网络反而更难训练，误差不降反升，这并非过拟合，而是优化困难。

方法思路：作者提出「残差学习」。普通网络让若干层直接学习目标映射 H(x)；残差网络改为让这些层学习残差 F(x)=H(x)−x，再通过一条「捷径连接」把输入 x 原样加到输出上。若最优映射接近恒等，网络只需把残差压到接近零，比从头学一个恒等映射容易得多；捷径连接也不引入额外参数，几乎不增加计算量。

实验结果：在 ImageNet 上训练最深层达 152 层的残差网络，深度是 VGG 的 8 倍而复杂度更低；单模型与集成模型表现优异，集成取得 3.57% 的 top-5 错误率，获 ILSVRC 2015 分类第一。作者还在 CIFAR-10 上验证了 100 层乃至 1000 层网络的可行性。把该骨干网络迁移到检测与分割任务，仅在 COCO 目标检测上就带来 28% 的相对提升。

为何重要：它证明了「深度」本身可以被有效解锁，且这种极深特征对检测、定位、分割等任务普遍有益。残差连接此后成为几乎所有深层网络的标配结构，是深度学习发展中的关键基石之一。

items.title_en: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold
items.abstract_en: Abstract Proteins are essential to life, and understanding their structure can facilitate a mechanistic understanding of their function. Through an enormous experimental effort 1–4 , the structures of around 100,000 unique proteins have been determined 5 , but this represents a small fraction of the billions of known protein sequences 6,7 . Structural coverage is bottlenecked by the months to years of painstaking effort required to determine a single protein structure. Accurate computational approaches are needed to address this gap and to enable large-scale structural bioinformatics. Predicting the three-dimensional structure that a protein will adopt based solely on its amino acid sequence—the structure prediction component of the ‘protein folding problem’ 8 —has been an important open research problem for more than 50 years 9 . Despite recent progress 10–14 , existing methods fall far short of atomic accuracy, especially when no homologous structure is available. Here we provide the first computational method that can regularly predict protein structures with atomic accuracy even in cases in which no similar structure is known. We validated an entirely redesigned version of our neural network-based model, AlphaFold, in the challenging 14th Critical Assessment of protein Structure Prediction (CASP14) 15 , demonstrating accuracy competitive with experimental structures in a majority of cases and greatly outperforming other methods. Underpinning the latest version of AlphaFold is a novel machine learning approach that incorporates physical and biological knowledge about protein structure, leveraging multi-sequence alignments, into the design of the deep learning algorithm.

items.title_zh: 利用 AlphaFold 实现高精度蛋白质结构预测
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质对生命至关重要，理解其结构有助于从机制上认识其功能。经过大量实验努力，目前约十万种独特蛋白质的结构已被测定，但这仅占已知数十亿条蛋白质序列的极小部分——测定单个结构往往需要数月乃至数年的艰苦工作，成为结构覆盖的瓶颈，因此亟需准确的计算方法来支撑大规模结构生物信息学。仅凭氨基酸序列预测蛋白质所采取的三维结构（即「蛋白质折叠问题」中的结构预测部分）是五十多年来重要的开放难题。尽管近期已有进展，现有方法仍远未达到原子级精度，在没有同源结构时尤其如此。本文提出首个即使在无相似结构可参考时，也能经常以原子精度预测蛋白质结构的计算方法。我们在极具挑战的第 14 届蛋白质结构预测关键评估（CASP14）中验证了完全重新设计的神经网络模型 AlphaFold，在多数案例中精度可与实验结构媲美，并大幅超越其他方法。最新版 AlphaFold 的核心是一种新颖机器学习方法，它把关于蛋白质结构的物理与生物学知识、以及多序列比对信息，融入深度学习算法的设计中。
items.highlight_zh: 首个在无同源结构时仍能达原子精度的蛋白质结构预测方法
items.digest_zh:
要解决的问题：蛋白质的功能由其三维结构决定，但用实验手段（如冷冻电镜、X 射线晶体学）测定一个结构往往耗时数月到数年。已知序列有数十亿条，已测结构仅约十万个，缺口巨大。仅凭氨基酸序列推断三维结构，是悬而未决五十多年的「蛋白质折叠问题」核心。

方法思路：作者完全重新设计了基于神经网络的模型 AlphaFold，把关于蛋白质结构的物理与生物学先验知识融入深度学习架构，尤其是充分利用多序列比对（MSA）中的进化信息——同源序列间的共变模式暗示了残基间的空间接触。网络据此直接输出原子的三维坐标。

结果：在 CASP14 这一国际盲测评估中，AlphaFold 在多数目标上达到与实验结构相当的精度，显著领先所有其他参赛方法，尤其在以往最困难的、没有相似已知结构的案例中表现突出。

为何重要：这意味着结构预测从「少数情况可用」迈向「常规可用」，可大规模填补序列与结构之间的鸿沟，加速结构生物信息学、药物设计与机制研究。需要注意，模型精度仍随目标难度变化，并非所有预测都达到实验级水准，但该方法已实质性改变了结构生物学的研究方式。

items.title_en: All-Optical Machine Learning Using Diffractive Deep Neural Networks
items.abstract_en: We introduce an all-optical Diffractive Deep Neural Network (D2NN) architecture that can learn to implement various functions after deep learning-based design of passive diffractive layers that work collectively. We experimentally demonstrated the success of this framework by creating 3D-printed D2NNs that learned to implement handwritten digit classification and the function of an imaging lens at terahertz spectrum. With the existing plethora of 3D-printing and other lithographic fabrication methods as well as spatial-light-modulators, this all-optical deep learning framework can perform, at the speed of light, various complex functions that computer-based neural networks can implement, and will find applications in all-optical image analysis, feature detection and object classification, also enabling new camera designs and optical components that can learn to perform unique tasks using D2NNs.

items.title_zh: 基于衍射深度神经网络的全光学机器学习
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种全光学的衍射深度神经网络（D2NN）架构：先通过深度学习设计一组协同工作的无源衍射层，之后该架构即可学习实现多种功能。我们用 3D 打印的 D2NN 在太赫兹波段实验演示了该框架的成功：它学会了实现手写数字分类以及成像透镜的功能。借助现有的众多 3D 打印与其他光刻制造方法以及空间光调制器，这一全光学深度学习框架能以光速执行计算机神经网络可实现的多种复杂功能，并将应用于全光图像分析、特征检测与目标分类，还能催生新型相机设计与可学习执行独特任务的光学元件。
items.highlight_zh: 用 3D 打印衍射层实现光速运算的全光学神经网络
items.digest_zh:
要解决的问题：传统神经网络依赖电子计算芯片，运算速度与能耗受硬件限制。能否让光本身完成神经网络的计算？光传播速度极快、并行度高，若能用光学元件直接实现网络，就能在极低延迟下完成识别等任务。

方法思路：作者提出衍射深度神经网络（D2NN）。它由若干层无源衍射元件堆叠构成，光穿过每一层时发生衍射，层间的光场传播相当于网络的「连接」，每层对相位的调制相当于可训练的「权重」。这些层的相位分布先由计算机上的深度学习反向传播算法离线训练好，再用 3D 打印制造成实体器件；制造完成后，器件本身不需供电、不需计算，光一穿过就完成推理。

结果：在太赫兹波段，作者打印出实际器件并实验验证：同一套框架学会了两类任务——手写数字分类，以及充当成像透镜把光聚焦成像。

为何重要：它展示了「把训练放在计算机里、把推理交给一块被动光学元件」的可行路线，推理以光速并行完成，几乎不耗电。结合空间光调制器与光刻工艺，可用于全光图像分析、特征检测、目标分类，并为新型相机与可学习光学元件开辟思路。当前局限在于器件一旦制成就固定，任务变更需重新设计制造，且受波长、对准精度与材料工艺约束。

items.title_en: XGBoost: A Scalable Tree Boosting System
items.abstract_en: Tree boosting is a highly effective and widely used machine learning method. In this paper, we describe a scalable end-to-end tree boosting system called XGBoost, which is used widely by data scientists to achieve state-of-the-art results on many machine learning challenges. We propose a novel sparsity-aware algorithm for sparse data and weighted quantile sketch for approximate tree learning. More importantly, we provide insights on cache access patterns, data compression and sharding to build a scalable tree boosting system. By combining these insights, XGBoost scales beyond billions of examples using far fewer resources than existing systems.

items.title_zh: XGBoost：一个可扩展的树提升系统
items.abstract_zh: 树提升是一种极为有效且被广泛使用的机器学习方法。本文描述一个可扩展的端到端树提升系统 XGBoost，它被数据科学家广泛用于在众多机器学习竞赛中取得最先进的结果。我们提出一种新的面向稀疏数据的稀疏感知算法，以及用于近似树学习的加权分位数草图。更重要的是，我们给出了关于缓存访问模式、数据压缩与分片的洞见，用以构建可扩展的树提升系统。综合这些设计，XGBoost 能在资源消耗远低于现有系统的情况下扩展到数十亿级样本。
items.highlight_zh: 系统级优化让树提升可扩展到数十亿样本且资源更省
items.digest_zh:
要解决的问题：梯度提升树（GBDT）精度高、适用广，但当数据规模达到上亿甚至数十亿样本、特征高度稀疏时，传统实现训练慢、内存吃紧，难以端到端扩展。

方法与工程创新：XGBoost 不只是算法改进，更是一整套系统设计。其一，提出稀疏感知算法，能自动处理缺失值与稀疏特征，为每个分支学习默认走向，避免填充缺失值带来的偏差。其二，提出加权分位数草图，用近似方法在分布式环境下高效寻找最优切分点，且该草图带有理论上的权重保证。其三，在工程层面深入优化：按特征预排序并以块结构存储，使切分搜索可并行；设计能感知缓存访问模式的布局，让梯度统计的读取更贴合 CPU 缓存；支持数据压缩与分片，降低内存与网络开销。

结果：把这些洞见组合起来，XGBoost 能用远少于既有系统的资源扩展到数十亿级样本，并在大量机器学习竞赛与任务上取得当时最好的成绩。

为何重要：它说明「好的系统实现」与「好的算法」同样关键——工程细节决定了方法能否真正落地。XGBoost 此后成为表格数据建模的常用基线工具，被数据科学界广泛采用。

items.title_en: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
items.abstract_en: We introduce a new language representation model called BERT, which stands for Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers. Unlike recent language representation models, BERT is designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by jointly conditioning on both left and right context in all layers. As a result, the pre-trained BERT model can be fine-tuned with just one additional output layer to create state-of-the-art models for a wide range of tasks, such as question answering and language inference, without substantial task-specific architecture modifications. BERT is conceptually simple and empirically powerful. It obtains new state-of-the-art results on eleven natural language processing tasks, including pushing the GLUE score to 80.5% (7.7% point absolute improvement), MultiNLI accuracy to 86.7% (4.6% absolute improvement), SQuAD v1.1 question answering Test F1 to 93.2 (1.5 point absolute improvement) and SQuAD v2.0 Test F1 to 83.1 (5.1 point absolute improvement).

items.title_zh: BERT：用于语言理解的深度双向 Transformer 预训练
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种新的语言表示模型 BERT（Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers）。与近期语言表示模型不同，BERT 在所有层中同时基于左右两侧上下文，从无标注文本预训练深层双向表示。因此，预训练的 BERT 只需增加一个输出层进行微调，就能在问答、语言推理等广泛任务上构建当前最优模型，而无需对任务特定结构做大幅修改。BERT 概念简单而实证有力，在十一项自然语言处理任务上取得新的最优结果：GLUE 得分提升至 80.5%（绝对提升 7.7 个百分点），MultiNLI 准确率提升至 86.7%（绝对提升 4.6），SQuAD v1.1 问答测试 F1 达 93.2（绝对提升 1.5），SQuAD v2.0 测试 F1 达 83.1（绝对提升 5.1）。
items.highlight_zh: 双向预训练加轻量微调，刷新 11 项 NLP 任务纪录
items.digest_zh:
① 研究问题：在 BERT 之前，语言模型多为单向（从左到右）读取文本，或只是把两个单向模型浅层拼接，难以同时利用一个词左右两侧的信息；而且每做一个下游任务，往往要重新设计专门的网络结构。
② 方法：BERT 用多层 Transformer 编码器堆叠，并设计两个预训练目标——“掩码语言模型”（随机遮住部分词再让模型猜）和“下一句预测”。遮词预测迫使每一层都同时看左右上下文，从而学到真正深层的双向表示。预训练完成后，只需在顶部加一个简单输出层、用少量标注数据微调，就能迁移到各类任务。
③ 结果：在 11 项自然语言处理任务上刷新最好成绩，包括 GLUE 80.5%、MultiNLI 86.7%、SQuAD v1.1 F1 93.2、SQuAD v2.0 F1 83.1，提升幅度都很明显。
④ 意义：它确立了“大规模无标注预训练 + 轻量微调”的通用范式，把人工特征工程和任务定制结构的需求降到最低，成为后续大规模语言模型的重要基石，也深刻改变了自然语言处理的研究与工程实践方式。

items.title_en: ORB-SLAM3: An Accurate Open-Source Library for Visual, Visual-Inertial and Multi-Map SLAM
items.abstract_en: This paper presents ORB-SLAM3, the first system able to perform visual, visual-inertial and multi-map SLAM with monocular, stereo and RGB-D cameras, using pin-hole and fisheye lens models. The first main novelty is a feature-based tightly-integrated visual-inertial SLAM system that fully relies on Maximum-a-Posteriori (MAP) estimation, even during the IMU initialization phase. The result is a system that operates robustly in real-time, in small and large, indoor and outdoor environments, and is 2 to 5 times more accurate than previous approaches. The second main novelty is a multiple map system that relies on a new place recognition method with improved recall. Thanks to it, ORB-SLAM3 is able to survive to long periods of poor visual information: when it gets lost, it starts a new map that will be seamlessly merged with previous maps when revisiting mapped areas. Compared with visual odometry systems that only use information from the last few seconds, ORB-SLAM3 is the first system able to reuse in all the algorithm stages all previous information. This allows to include in bundle adjustment co-visible keyframes, that provide high parallax observations boosting accuracy, even if they are widely separated in time or if they come from a previous mapping session. Our experiments show that, in all sensor configurations, ORB-SLAM3 is as robust as the best systems available in the literature, and significantly more accurate. Notably, our stereo-inertial SLAM achieves an average accuracy of 3.6 cm on the EuRoC drone and 9 mm under quick hand-held motions in the room of TUM-VI dataset, a setting representative of AR/VR scenarios. For the benefit of the community we make public the source code.

reference_review.reason_zh: 单目、双目、RGB-D 与视觉惯性多地图 SLAM 的原始工作及作者代码，适合定位基线复现。
reference_review.limitations_zh: 需要正确的相机/IMU标定与时间同步；弱纹理、动态遮挡与实时算力需实测，GPL许可及其他商用条款需核对。

recommendation.reason_zh: 单目、双目、RGB-D 与视觉惯性多地图 SLAM 的原始工作及作者代码，适合定位基线复现。 截至 2026-11-20，Crossref 索引记录 4599 次引用，可作长期文献线索。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需要正确的相机/IMU标定与时间同步；弱纹理、动态遮挡与实时算力需实测，GPL许可及其他商用条款需核对。

items.title_zh: ORB-SLAM3：面向视觉、视觉惯性与多地图 SLAM 的精确开源库
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 ORB-SLAM3，这是首个能在单目、双目和 RGB-D 相机以及针孔与鱼眼镜头模型下，同时完成视觉、视觉惯性与多地图 SLAM 的系统。第一个创新是完全依赖最大后验（MAP）估计的、基于特征的紧耦合视觉惯性 SLAM，即使在 IMU 初始化阶段也是如此；因此系统能在室内外大小场景中实时鲁棒运行，精度比以往方法高 2 至 5 倍。第二个创新是基于召回率更高的场景识别方法的多地图系统：当视觉信息长期匮乏而跟丢时，系统会新建地图，重访已建图区域时再无缝合并。与只利用最近几秒信息的视觉里程计不同，ORB-SLAM3 能在所有算法阶段复用全部历史信息，把时间上相隔很远、甚至来自此前建图会话的共视关键帧纳入光束法平差，从而获得高视差观测、提升精度。实验表明，在各种传感器配置下其鲁棒性与现有最佳系统相当，精度显著更高：双目惯性在 EuRoC 无人机数据上平均精度 3.6 cm，在 TUM-VI 室内快速手持运动（代表性 AR/VR 场景）下为 9 mm。源代码已公开。
items.highlight_zh: 首个统一视觉/视觉惯性/多地图的开源 SLAM 系统
items.digest_zh:
① 研究问题：机器人或 AR/VR 设备需要在未知环境里边走边定位并建图（SLAM）。单一传感器很容易失效：纯视觉在纹理稀少或运动过快时会跟丢，单独用惯性传感器（IMU）又会漂移；更麻烦的是，系统一旦跟丢，此前辛苦建好的地图常常被直接丢弃。
② 方法：ORB-SLAM3 是开源系统，支持单目、双目、RGB-D 相机和针孔、鱼眼镜头，并可与 IMU 融合。其一是紧耦合的视觉-惯性 SLAM，从 IMU 初始化阶段起就完全基于最大后验（MAP）估计，而不是分步近似；其二是多地图系统，用召回率更高的场景识别方法，跟丢时开一张新地图，重访旧区域时自动无缝拼接。它还能在各阶段复用历史信息，把相隔很久、甚至来自旧会话的关键帧一起放进光束法平差。
③ 结果：在各种传感器配置下，鲁棒性与现有最好系统持平，精度明显更高，总体比以往方法精确 2 至 5 倍；双目加惯性在 EuRoC 无人机数据上平均误差约 3.6 cm，在 TUM-VI 手持快速运动场景下约 9 mm。
④ 意义：它把“能长期稳定运行、能复用历史地图”的 SLAM 做成开源可用工具，为机器人导航与 AR/VR 提供了扎实的工程基础。

items.title_en: Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence
items.title_zh: Sage-Med：面向医疗多模态智能的规模化扩展
items.abstract_en: Establishing effective scaling laws for medical multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remains a persistent and fundamental challenge. Our systematic evaluation shows that existing medical MLLMs tend to underperform frontier general-purpose MLLMs across a range of medical tasks, while scaling model size primarily improves text capabilities rather than multimodal perception, and enabling reasoning modes fails to close this visual gap. To investigate how medical multimodal intelligence scales in practice, we introduce Sage-Med-Preview, a 35B-parameter medical multimodal model with 3B activated parameters, built by combining stage-specific curation over 322.7 million candidate records with a progressive training curriculum spanning medical pretraining, staged supervised fine-tuning, and adaptive reinforcement learning. Across this curriculum, progressive supervised refinement and adaptive reinforcement learning yield consistent stage-wise gains, substantially advancing both specialized visual understanding and medical language capabilities. Evaluated against 77 competing models across 238 clinical tasks spanning 61 public and 13 private multi-center benchmarks in more than 40 modalities, Sage-Med-Preview achieves an average score of 58.26% on the 31 public multimodal benchmarks. It outperforms the state-of-the-art open-source medical model Hulu-Med-235B-A22B at 50.99% and the general scientific model Intern-S2-Preview at 52.24%, and approaches the advanced proprietary model GPT-6.2-Sol across multiple tasks such as comprehensive multimodal understanding, report generation, and visual grounding. Although substantial challenges remain in complex medical reasoning and multi-step clinical workflows, this report provides empirical evidence, actionable data and training recipes, and a rigorous benchmark toward scalable clinical multimodal intelligence.
items.abstract_zh: 为医疗多模态大模型（MLLMs）建立有效的扩展规律仍是基础性难题。系统评估发现，现有医疗 MLLM 在多项医疗任务上不及前沿通用 MLLM；扩大模型规模主要提升文本能力而非多模态感知，开启推理模式也无法弥补视觉差距。为此作者提出 Sage-Med-Preview：一个 35B 参数、3B 激活参数的医疗多模态模型，融合对 3.227 亿条候选记录的阶段化筛选与覆盖医疗预训练、分阶段监督微调、自适应强化学习的渐进训练课程。在 61 个公开与 13 个多中心私有基准、40 余种模态的 238 项临床任务上与 77 个模型对比，其在 31 个公开多模态基准上平均得分 58.26%，高于开源医疗模型 Hulu-Med-235B-A22B（50.99%）与 Intern-S2-Preview（52.24%），并在多模态理解、报告生成、视觉定位等任务上接近 GPT-6.2-Sol。复杂医疗推理与多步临床流程仍存挑战。
items.highlight_zh: 35B医疗多模态模型：能力提升靠训练课程而非堆参数
items.digest_zh:
• 研究了什么：医疗多模态大模型是否“越大越强”？作者先做系统性体检，发现三个反直觉现象：现有医疗专用模型在不少医疗任务上还不如通用大模型；单纯加大参数量主要提升文字能力，看图的本事没跟上；开启“推理模式”也补不上视觉短板。
• 用了什么方法：构建 Sage-Med-Preview，总参数 35B、每次只激活 3B。数据端从 3.227 亿条候选记录中按阶段筛选；训练端分三步逐步“加练”：医疗预训练→分阶段监督微调→自适应强化学习。
• 得到什么结果：在 61 个公开基准、13 个多中心私有基准、40 多种模态、238 项临床任务上与 77 个模型同场竞技。31 个公开多模态基准平均分 58.26%，超过开源医疗模型 Hulu-Med-235B-A22B（50.99%）与科学通用模型 Intern-S2-Preview（52.24%），在多模态理解、报告生成、视觉定位等任务上逼近闭源 GPT-6.2-Sol，而参数量远小于对手。
• 为何重要：给出了“数据筛选＋渐进训练”的可复用配方，说明医疗多模态能力的关键可能不在参数规模，而在训练课程与数据质量；同时坦承复杂临床推理、多步骤工作流仍是短板，为后续研究指明方向。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: KnitNet: Learning to Search at Inference Time for Exact RNA Inverse Design
items.title_zh: KnitNet：面向精确 RNA 逆向设计的推理时搜索学习
items.abstract_en: RNA inverse design seeks nucleotide sequences that fold into specified target structures. Existing methods rely on learned generators that can miss exact structural matches, especially beyond their training distributions, or on costly search over a vast, multimodal sequence space. Search is further complicated by globally coupled nucleotide interactions, as correcting one pairing error can create new errors beyond a fixed repair scope. To address this, we introduce KnitNet, an inference-time scaling framework that learns from verifier feedback to refine sequences for exact fold-back matching. Starting from candidates generated for a target secondary structure, KnitNet uses mismatched folds to infer nucleotide dependencies and adapt its joint repair strategy, while an online surrogate learns to predict which edits are promising. This makes search progressively more informed and compute-efficient. Crucially, KnitNet generalizes across RNA structural regimes by changing only the optimization signal to match the verifier required by each setting. Across five secondary-structure benchmarks, KnitNet increases exact solve rates by an average of 21 percentage points over continued sampling with 70% less time-to-solve. On OpenKnot57 specifically, KnitNet is the first method to achieve exact computational matches for all complex, pseudoknotted structures. Beyond 2D, KnitNet improves 3D structural self-consistency over per-target RL by 7.8% while being 39.3% faster, demonstrating generalization and effective inference-time scaling across RNA design regimes.
items.abstract_zh: RNA 逆向设计旨在寻找能折叠成指定目标结构的核苷酸序列。现有方法依赖学习式生成器，在训练分布之外常难以命中精确结构匹配；或在庞大且多峰的序列空间中做高成本搜索。核苷酸相互作用全局耦合，使修正一处配对错误可能在固定修复范围之外引入新错误。为此作者提出 KnitNet——一个从验证器反馈中学习、在推理时扩展的框架，用于精修序列以实现精确回折匹配。它从为目标二级结构生成的候选出发，利用折叠不匹配信息推断核苷酸依赖关系并自适应调整联合修复策略，同时用在线代理模型预测哪些编辑更有前景，使搜索逐步更具信息量、更省算力。只需更换优化信号即可跨不同 RNA 结构场景泛化。在五个二级结构基准上，精确求解率平均提升 21 个百分点，求解时间减少 70%；在 OpenKnot57 上首个对所有复杂假结结构实现精确计算匹配；3D 结构自一致性较逐目标 RL 提升 7.8%，速度快 39.3%。
items.highlight_zh: 推理时学习搜索，RNA精确设计求解率提升21个百分点
items.digest_zh:
• 研究了什么：RNA 逆向设计是“给定想要的折叠结构，反推一条能折成它的序列”。难点在于：序列空间极大且多峰，改一个碱基修好一处配对，可能又把别处弄坏，错误会到处牵连；而单纯靠模型“生成”往往只能接近、不能精确命中。
• 用了什么方法：KnitNet 不去重训一个生成器，而是在推理阶段“学着搜”。它从已有候选出发，看哪些位置折错了，据此推断核苷酸之间的依赖关系，做联合修复；再用一个在线代理模型预测哪种编辑更可能成功，把算力花在刀刃上。换一种“裁判”（验证器）就能迁移到二级结构、假结、3D 等不同场景。
• 得到什么结果：五个二级结构基准上精确求解率平均提高 21 个百分点，求解时间反而少 70%；在 OpenKnot57 上，它是首个对所有复杂假结结构都给出精确计算匹配的方法；扩展到 3D 时，结构自一致性比逐目标强化学习高 7.8%，速度快 39.3%。
• 为何重要：说明“推理时扩展”这套在大模型里流行的思路，在生物序列设计上同样管用——不改模型、只改搜索策略，就能同时提高精确率和效率，为湿实验前的候选筛选提供更可靠的序列。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: Gradient Optical Diffraction Tomography Using Deep Learning-Assisted Amplitude Estimation
items.title_zh: 基于深度学习辅助振幅估计的梯度光学衍射层析
items.abstract_en: Gradient Optical Diffraction Tomography (GODT) enables the non-invasive reconstruction of a spatial derivative of the 3D sample's refractive index distribution, providing enhanced sensitivity to subtle refractive index variations through gradient-based contrast. Implemented using lateral shearing interferometry (LSI), GODT benefits from a common-path architecture that provides environmental stability and high signal-to-noise ratio measurements. Unlike conventional optical diffraction tomography (ODT), which requires numerical integration of LSI-derived phase gradients to recover the object phase, GODT enables direct tomographic reconstruction from the LSI data. Notably, GODT requires derivatives of both the phase and amplitude of the object fields as input. While the phase derivative can be readily extracted from LSI data, the amplitude gradient cannot be directly retrieved. Thus, in the original GODT formulation, the amplitude gradient was assumed to be negligible, limiting the accuracy of the resulting 3D reconstruction. In this work, we introduce amplitude-informed GODT (AI-GODT), which employs physics-informed supervised deep learning to estimate the missing amplitude gradient based on accessible LSI data, specifically the fringe modulation. The proposed approach, applying a ResNet architecture and training on computer-generated data, is validated through numerical simulation and experimental measurements of both a well-characterized test object and primary neuronal cell culture, demonstrating the network's ability to generalize to diverse samples. We show that incorporation of the recovered amplitude gradient into the GODT reconstruction pipeline improves the 3D reconstruction quality, especially in its out-of-focus regions. The software and datasets are openly available to facilitate reproducibility and further development.
items.abstract_zh: 梯度光学衍射层析（GODT）可无创重建三维样品折射率分布的空间导数，借助梯度对比度提升对细微折射率变化的灵敏度。它基于横向剪切干涉（LSI）实现，共路架构带来环境稳定性与高信噪比。与需数值积分相位梯度的传统光学衍射层析（ODT）不同，GODT 可直接由 LSI 数据重建。但其输入需要物场相位与振幅的导数：相位导数可从 LSI 数据中直接提取，振幅梯度却无法直接获得，因此原始 GODT 假设振幅梯度可忽略，限制了三维重建精度。本文提出振幅信息 GODT（AI-GODT），采用物理信息监督深度学习，从可获得的 LSI 数据（条纹调制）估计缺失的振幅梯度。方法采用 ResNet 架构并在计算机生成数据上训练，通过数值仿真以及对标定测试物体和原代神经元细胞培养的实验测量验证其泛化能力。将恢复的振幅梯度纳入重建流程可改善三维重建质量，尤其是在离焦区域。软件与数据集已公开。
items.highlight_zh: 用深度学习补出缺失的振幅梯度，改善离焦区三维重建
items.digest_zh:
• 研究了什么问题：光学衍射层析（ODT）能从多角度测量中重建细胞的三维折射率。GODT 是其变体，直接用横向剪切干涉测折射率的“梯度”，对细微变化更敏感，共路光路也更抗环境扰动。但重建需要两样输入：相位梯度和振幅梯度。相位能从干涉数据里算出来，振幅梯度却测不到，原方法只好假设它为零，结果离焦区域重建偏差较大。
• 用了什么方法：AI-GODT 把“测不到的量”交给网络去推断。它用物理信息监督的深度学习，输入容易获得的干涉条纹调制信息，用 ResNet 训练（训练数据由计算机仿真生成），输出估计的振幅梯度，再送入原有的 GODT 重建流程。
• 得到什么结果：通过数值仿真，以及对标定好的测试物体和原代神经元细胞培养的实验测量进行验证，网络可泛化到不同样品；把估计的振幅梯度加回重建后，三维重建质量提升，离焦区域的改善尤为明显。软件与数据已公开。
• 为何重要：这是一种低成本升级现有成像模态的思路——不必改动硬件光路，仅用带物理约束的神经网络补全缺失的物理量，就能提升活细胞三维成像的准确性。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为三维与定位，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对传感器、标定、尺度与算力；重建画质和可用的定位精度属于不同指标。

items.title_en: An Embedded Ergonomic Posture Monitoring and AI-Assisted Home Learning System on a Raspberry Pi 3B Edge Platform
items.title_zh: 基于树莓派 3B 边缘平台的嵌入式人体工学坐姿监测与 AI 辅助居家学习系统
items.abstract_en: During independent home study sessions, students frequently sustain improper sitting postures, accumulate excessive sedentary hours, and experience productivity loss from off-task digital distractions. Furthermore, learners often lack real-time pedagogical scaffolding for demanding self-study curricula. To mitigate these ergonomic and instructional challenges, this paper presents an affordable, privacy-preserving cyber-physical embedded system for domestic study spaces. Engineered on a Raspberry Pi 3 Model B (1 GB RAM) paired with a UVC optical camera and a USB condenser microphone, the system executes on-device computer vision utilizing MediaPipe Pose and OpenCV to monitor upper-body alignment, sagittal head inclination, and coronal shoulder asymmetry in real time without persisting raw video streams. A deterministic finite state machine (FSM) quantifies active study durations, enforces health-compliant rest periods, and detects illicit smartphone usage. Simultaneously, an integrated multimodal AI tutoring agent parses voice and text queries via an encrypted API gateway, synthesizing Socratic conceptual hints rather than direct solutions. A lightweight parental web dashboard delivers encrypted session analytics and scheduling configurations. Empirical benchmarks on the physical prototype confirm an end-to-end inference latency of 244-250 ms at a 352x288 resolution (4.0-4.1 FPS), a trunk-angle estimation error of 4.39 degrees MAE over 5,760 synthetic ground-truth poses, a resident set size of 320 MB, a peak SoC temperature of 58.0 degrees Celsius under sustained load, and a 1.58 s total latency for the offline TTS feedback path, proving high practicality for resource-constrained edge deployment.
items.abstract_zh: 居家独立学习时，学生常保持不良坐姿、久坐时间过长，并因数字分心导致效率下降；面对高难度自学内容也缺少实时教学支持。为缓解这些人体工学与教学问题，本文提出一套低成本、保护隐私的信息物理嵌入式系统。系统基于树莓派 3B（1GB 内存）、UVC 摄像头与 USB 电容麦克风，在设备端用 MediaPipe Pose 与 OpenCV 实时监测上身对齐、矢状面头部倾角与冠状面肩部不对称，且不保存原始视频流。确定性有限状态机（FSM）统计有效学习时长、强制健康休息并检测违规使用手机；集成的多模态 AI 辅导代理经加密 API 网关解析语音与文本提问，给出苏格拉底式概念提示而非直接答案；轻量家长网页仪表盘提供加密的会话分析与排程配置。物理原型实测：352×288 分辨率下端到端推理延迟 244–250 ms（4.0–4.1 FPS），在 5760 个合成真值姿态上躯干角度估计 MAE 为 4.39°，常驻内存 320 MB，持续负载下 SoC 峰值温度 58.0°C，离线 TTS 反馈路径总延迟 1.58 s，证明其在资源受限边缘设备上的实用性。
items.highlight_zh: 树莓派上实现隐私友好的坐姿监测与AI启发式辅导
items.digest_zh:
• 研究了什么问题：孩子在家自习时容易趴着歪着、一坐就是几小时，还常被手机分心；遇到难题又没人即时答疑。作者要在一个便宜、保护隐私、不需联网上传视频的边缘设备上同时解决“坐姿/久坐”和“缺辅导”两件事。
• 用了什么方法：硬件是树莓派 3B（仅 1GB 内存）＋普通 USB 摄像头＋USB 麦克风。软件上：MediaPipe Pose 与 OpenCV 在本地实时估计头部前倾、躯干角度、双肩是否等高，视频不上传；一个有限状态机统计真正在学习的时间、到点提醒休息、识别玩手机；再接一个 AI 家教，把语音或文字提问转成“苏格拉底式”提示而不是直接给答案；家长通过加密网页看统计和排课。
• 得到什么结果：原型实测端到端推理 244–250 ms（约 4 FPS，352×288 分辨率），躯干角度误差 4.39°（5760 个合成真值姿态），内存占用 320 MB，满负荷芯片峰值 58°C，离线语音反馈总延迟 1.58 s，均在可接受范围。
• 为何重要：证明几十美元级的边缘设备也能跑得起隐私友好的姿态监测加 AI 辅导，为家庭学习场景提供了一个现实可落地、不依赖云端视频的低成本方案。

items.title_en: What People Choose Not to Say: A Multimodal Benchmark for Fine-Grained Information Manipulation in Conversations
items.title_zh: 人们选择不说什么：对话中细粒度信息操控的多模态基准
items.abstract_en: Recent advances in MLLMs have improved social understanding, enabling models to recognize emotions and distinguish truthful from deceptive behaviors. However, existing benchmarks largely focus on coarse-grained emotion recognition or binary truth-deception detection, overlooking the diverse ways people manipulate information in conversations, such as withholding, leakage, fabrication, evasion, and defensive counterclaim. Understanding these behaviors requires reasoning about underlying facts, participant knowledge, and conversational context, making them difficult to evaluate reliably. To address this gap, we introduce InfoCon, a multimodal benchmark for fine-grained information manipulation in conversations. InfoCon identifies six fine-grained strategies and derives a coarse consistency label from their factual and interactional relations. We develop an evidence-grounded multi-agent annotation framework to construct and verify reliable labels from rich contextual evidence. We benchmark representative multimodal models and systematically analyze their fine-grained information manipulation understanding, providing a testbed beyond binary truth-deception judgments.
items.abstract_zh: 多模态大模型在社会理解上进步显著，已能识别情绪并区分真实与欺骗。但现有基准多限于粗粒度情绪识别或二元真假检测，忽视了隐瞒、泄露、编造、回避、防御性反诉等信息操控方式。理解这些行为需推理底层事实、参与者知识与对话语境，评估困难。我们提出 InfoCon——对话中细粒度信息操控的多模态基准：界定六种策略，并依其事实与互动关系导出粗粒度一致性标签；采用基于证据的多智能体标注框架构建并校验可靠标签。我们对代表性多模态模型进行基准测试与系统分析，提供超越二元真假判断的试验平台。
items.highlight_zh: 首个细粒度对话信息操控多模态基准，超越二元真假判断
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：人在对话中并不只是「说真话」或「说谎」——更多时候会隐瞒不说、说漏、编造、回避、甚至反咬一口。以往评测把这类行为压成二分类，丢掉了大量信息。
方法：作者构建 InfoCon 基准，把信息操控拆成六种细粒度策略，再根据这些策略背后的事实关系与互动关系，归纳出一个粗粒度的一致性标签。为了让标签可信，他们设计了多智能体标注流程：每个标签都必须有语境中的证据支撑，并被交叉验证。
结果：用该基准测评一批代表性多模态模型后可以看到，模型在细粒度策略的区分上表现有限，其能力远不能只用「真假判断」来概括。
意义：它把「模型是否懂人」的评测从二元判断推进到行为层面的细粒度诊断，对社交智能、可信对话系统与欺骗检测研究都有价值，也为后续训练更懂分寸的对话模型提供了数据集基础。

items.title_en: SEEK: Self-Evolution through Execution Knowledge for Agentic Robot Manipulation
items.title_zh: SEEK：通过执行知识实现自我进化，面向智能体式机器人操作
items.abstract_en: General-purpose multimodal foundation models enable robots to adapt during deployment from observations and execution feedback, without task-specific demonstrations or training. However, the robot retains what it learns only in the model's working context. Once the task ends, it loses this execution knowledge, such as how to carry a bowl between two grippers. On the next attempt at the task, the robot may take just as long and repeat the same mistakes. To avoid this repetition, robots must retain execution knowledge across attempts. Yet replaying past actions is insufficient, because their effects depend on the current conditions. Procedures that determine actions from the current scene address this, but when they meet conditions that earlier attempts did not cover, revising them requires the measured effects of earlier actions. We therefore propose SEEK, an agentic framework that retains both, enabling robots to improve across attempts while keeping the underlying model fixed. To adapt retained knowledge to the current scene, SEEK adopts a Self-Evolving Programmatic Policy (SEPP) that encodes manipulation as executable procedures and determines each action from current observations. As the robot executes these procedures, SEEK records the measured effects of its actions, including those from failed attempts, in a Persistent Action-Effect Bank (PAEB). Where a retained procedure applies, it acts without a model request; where it meets a condition it does not cover, this evidence guides its revision. On RoboDojo, knowledge retained over ten attempts raises SEEK's average task score from 27.0 to 54.4 and its success rate from 19.7% to 48.0% across all 42 tasks. On 34 of these tasks with GPT-6.2 Astra, SEEK reaches 80.1 after five attempts, against 49.6 for the same model acting directly, and uses 77.6% fewer model requests. https://zeyangguan.github.io/SEEK-Agentic-Robot-Manipulation/
items.abstract_zh: 通用多模态基础模型让机器人能在部署中根据观察与执行反馈自适应，无需任务专用示范或训练。但机器人只在模型工作上下文中保留所学，任务结束便丢失执行知识（如怎样在两指夹爪间搬碗），下次尝试仍可能耗时相近、重犯错误。为此我们提出 SEEK：在固定底层模型的前提下让机器人跨尝试持续改进。SEEK 采用自进化程序化策略（SEPP），把操作编码为可执行程序，并依据当前观测决定每步动作；执行中把动作实测效果（含失败尝试）记入持久动作—效果库（PAEB）。程序可覆盖时无需请求模型即可执行，遇到未覆盖条件时由证据指导修订。在 RoboDojo 全部 42 项任务上，十次尝试内积累的知识使平均分由 27.0 升至 54.4，成功率由 19.7% 升至 48.0%。
items.highlight_zh: 让机器人把经验写成可执行程序并跨尝试复用改进
items.digest_zh:
问题：机器人借助多模态基础模型可以直接上手干活，但经验只存在「当前上下文」里，任务一结束就忘光——下次搬同样的碗还得从头摸索，把同样的错误再犯一遍。单纯回放旧动作也不行，因为动作效果取决于当下的场景条件。
方法：SEEK 不重新训练模型，而是把经验存成两类东西。一是自进化程序化策略（SEPP）：把操作写成可执行程序，每一步动作由当前观测决定；二是持久动作—效果库（PAEB）：记录每次动作的真实效果，失败尝试也照记。
机制：程序能覆盖的情形直接执行，不必询问模型；碰到程序没覆盖的条件，就用记录下来的效果证据去修改程序。这样知识既能复用，又能按现场情况调整。
结果：在 RoboDojo 的 42 项任务上，十次尝试内积累的知识把平均任务分从 27.0 拉到 54.4，成功率从 19.7% 提到 48.0%；配合 GPT-6.2 Astra 时，34 项任务五次尝试后达 80.1，而同模型基线为 49.6。
意义：它说明「不改权重也能进化」——把执行知识外置并持续累积，是提升机器人实际动手能力的低成本路径。

items.title_en: Agentic LongLive: Asynchronous Agentic Memory for Long Video Generation
items.title_zh: Agentic LongLive：面向长视频生成的异步智能体内存
items.abstract_en: Real-time autoregressive video generators stream minutes of video and accept new prompts on the fly, but struggle to keep people, objects, and places consistent over a long interactive story. Agent systems provide such memory for offline multi-shot generation, yet they read the whole script in advance, plan each shot before generating it, and regenerate failed shots, which a live stream does not allow. We present Agentic LongLive, an asynchronous agentic memory for long video generation. A memory agent on separate GPUs reads only the prompts revealed so far, never the generated video, and keeps a text state and evolving images for every person, object, and scene. From this entity memory it composes a global image and a per-shot memory image, which an auxiliary GPU prefills into the generator's attention sink before the next shot starts, and writes entity cards for the prompts that name them, so the video never waits for memory and video errors are not written back. A small language model, trained with reinforcement learning and an image reward calibrated using downstream video outcomes, decides what to remember before the next prompt is known. On LongStory-Online, a new benchmark of 25 stories (857 shots) revealed one shot at a time, Agentic LongLive improves persistent-state accuracy of LongLive-2.0, its base generator, by 26.3 points, protagonist identity by 44.9, and revisited-place consistency by 40.4, at about 1% extra generation time on H100. The full system streams faster than real time on one 8xB200 node with the generator in BF16 (34.3 FPS), keeps image quality stable over 14-minute stories, and improves identity on two MiniMax-H3 generators, one of which, LongLive-H3, also runs in real time with it. To our knowledge, it is the first real-time video generator with text and image memory kept by an LLM agent.
items.abstract_zh: 实时自回归视频生成器可流式输出数分钟视频并即时接受新提示，却难以在长篇交互故事中保持人物、物体与场景一致。离线多镜头智能体方案需预读剧本、逐镜规划并重生成失败镜头，直播式流中无法采用。我们提出 Agentic LongLive：独立 GPU 上的记忆智能体只读取已揭示的提示、从不查看生成视频，为每个实体维护文本状态与演化图像，并合成全局图像与分镜记忆图像，由辅助 GPU 在下一镜头开始前预填充进生成器的 attention sink，同时为被命名的实体写入实体卡，使视频无需等待记忆、错误也不写回。小型语言模型经强化学习训练、并以校准于下游视频结果的图像奖励，在下一提示未知前决定记忆内容。在 LongStory-Online 上，持久状态准确率提升 26.3 点、主角身份 44.9 点、重访地点一致性 40.4 点，额外生成时间约 1%。
items.highlight_zh: 异步记忆智能体让实时长视频生成保持人物场景一致
items.digest_zh:
问题：实时视频生成模型能一边生成一边接受新提示，但故事一长，人物长相、物体、场景就开始漂移，前后对不上。
难点：离线的多镜头方案靠智能体充当「记忆」，可它们要先读完整剧本、逐镜规划、失败重拍，直播式的流式生成根本等不起。
方法：Agentic LongLive 把记忆做成异步的，跑在另外的 GPU 上。记忆智能体只看已经出现的提示，从不看生成的视频，为每个实体维护文字状态与不断更新的图像，并合成一张全局图像和一张分镜记忆图像；辅助 GPU 在下一镜头开始前把它们预填充进生成器的 attention sink，相当于提前把「记忆」塞进注意力里。还会给被提示点名的实体写实体卡，保证角色、地点对得上号。
关键设计：视频生成从不等记忆，记忆出错也不会污染视频流；一个小语言模型用强化学习训练，奖励由下游视频效果校准，负责在下一个提示到来前决定该记什么。
结果：新基准 LongStory-Online（25 个故事、857 个镜头）上，持久状态准确率 +26.3、主角身份 +44.9、重访地点一致性 +40.4，额外耗时约 1%；单台 8×B200 节点以 34.3 FPS 快于实时运行，14 分钟故事画质稳定。
意义：首次让长期记忆与实时视频生成并行不悖，为可交互的长篇视频创作打下基础。

items.title_en: A multimodal foundation model for tissue proteomics and morphology in cancer
items.title_zh: 面向癌症组织蛋白组学与形态学的多模态基础模型
items.abstract_en: Cancer diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment decisions increasingly rely on integrating tissue morphology with specific molecular readouts of the tumor and its microenvironment. H&E histopathology provides scalable morphology, whereas multiplex spatial proteomics quantifies dozens of proteins in situ with spatial context, but remains selectively deployed, often with different marker panels across cohorts. This creates a translational bottleneck: most patients lack high-depth molecular profiling, and existing models rarely integrate morphology and spatial molecular data in a single framework. We present VirTues-M2, a multimodal foundation model that jointly learns from H&E and spatial proteomics using a novel vision transformer-based architecture. By encoding marker identity during pretraining, VirTues-M2 is robust to missing modalities, imperfect modality pairing or registration, and variable marker panels, enabling unified inference for tissue phenotyping, panoptic cell segmentation, virtual staining, annotation-free biomarker discovery, and reinforcement learning-based adaptive marker panel selection to reduce assay burden. As a concrete demonstration of translational utility, in a newly collected cohort of 1,053 treatment-naive non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) patients with paired spatial proteomics and H&E, VirTues-M2 discovers high-risk and low-risk tissue signatures that stratify overall survival in both the discovery cohort and an independent validation cohort, outperforming current state-of-the-art stratification schemes; all enabled by VirTues-M2's ability to jointly analyze both modalities within a single model.
items.abstract_zh: 癌症的诊断、预后判断与治疗决策，越来越依赖把组织形态与肿瘤及其微环境的具体分子读出整合起来。H&E 病理能提供可规模化获取的形态信息，多重空间蛋白组则能在原位、带空间上下文地量化数十种蛋白，但目前只在部分场景使用，且各队列采用的标记 panel 往往不同。这造成转化瓶颈：多数患者缺乏高深度分子分型，现有模型也很少在单一框架内整合形态与空间分子数据。我们提出 VirTues-M2，一个基于新型视觉 Transformer 架构、联合学习 H&E 与空间蛋白组的多模态基础模型。通过在预训练中编码标记身份，VirTues-M2 对模态缺失、模态配对或配准不完美以及标记 panel 可变都具有鲁棒性，可统一完成组织表型分析、全景细胞分割、虚拟染色、免标注生物标志物发现，以及基于强化学习的自适应 panel 选择以减轻检测负担。作为转化价值的例证，在新收集的 1053 例初治非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者配对空间蛋白组与 H&E 队列中，VirTues-M2 发现的高风险与低风险组织特征能在发现队列和独立验证队列中区分总生存期，优于当前最先进的分层方案；这得益于其能在单一模型中联合分析两种模态。
items.highlight_zh: 单模型联合 H&E 与空间蛋白组，可分层 NSCLC 生存
items.digest_zh:
① 研究问题：肿瘤诊断和治疗决策越来越依赖“形态 + 分子”的联合信息。H&E 染色切片便宜、可大规模获得；多重空间蛋白组能在原位量化几十种蛋白并保留空间位置，但成本高、只在部分患者中开展，且不同队列使用的蛋白标记 panel 不一致。结果是大多数患者没有高深度分子数据，而现有模型很少能把两种信息放进同一框架。
② 方法：提出多模态基础模型 VirTues-M2，基于视觉 Transformer，同时从 H&E 与空间蛋白组学习。关键设计是在预训练中编码“标记身份”，使模型能容忍模态缺失、配对或配准不完美、以及 panel 各不相同。一个模型就能做组织表型分析、全景细胞分割、虚拟染色、免标注的生物标志物发现，还能用强化学习自适应挑选最少必要的标记 panel，降低检测负担。
③ 结果：在新收集的 1053 例初治非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）配对队列中，模型发现的高风险与低风险组织特征，在发现队列和独立验证队列中都能区分患者总生存期，效果优于现有最好的分层方案。
④ 意义：它展示了用统一多模态模型打通廉价形态学与昂贵分子信息的可能，有望让没做深度分子检测的患者，也获得接近分子水平的风险分层，缓解转化瓶颈。

items.title_en: Geometry-conditioned differentiable surrogate with adjoint Monte Carlo sampling for scintillator detector co-design
items.title_zh: 面向闪烁体探测器协同设计的几何条件可微代理模型与伴随蒙特卡罗采样
items.abstract_en: Optimizing light-guide geometries for scintillator-based imaging detectors requires repeated photon-transport evaluations, making direct Monte Carlo simulation computationally costly. Differentiable surrogates can accelerate these evaluations and support detector readout co-design aimed at improving information extraction from particle interactions. In this work we describe a surrogate model for photon transport. We develop it starting from a modular, event-driven Monte Carlo model for the generation and transport of scintillation photons, and a reciprocal Monte Carlo construction (an adjoint model) of a spatially and temporally resolved optical response field. The latter evaluates the collectible light output and its temporal structure from a scintillator volume by launching weighted photon trajectories from the light-guide readout face. We apply this approach to a scintillator cell with two mirrored, curved, single-clad light guides. We employ the adjoint model to train a geometry-conditioned neural surrogate that predicts collection probabilities and conditional transport-time distributions across a constrained guide-design family. The surrogate is natively differentiable, lending itself to be an element of a differentiable pipeline for gradient-based optimization. A forward-reciprocal benchmark and validation on held-out geometries establish the accuracy of the trained model and identify its limitations. The developed tools provide a foundation for rapid optical-response studies and detector readout co-design.
items.abstract_zh: 为闪烁体成像探测器优化光导几何，需要反复评估光子输运，直接蒙特卡罗模拟代价高昂。本文从模块化、事件驱动的闪烁光子产生与输运蒙特卡罗模型出发，构建了空间与时间分辨的光学响应场的伴随（互易）蒙特卡罗构造：从光导读出端面发射加权光子轨迹，评估可收集光输出及其时间结构。以带两个镜面弯曲单包层光导的闪烁体单元为例，用伴随模型训练几何条件神经网络代理，使其在受限设计族内预测收集概率与条件输运时间分布。该代理原生可微，可嵌入基于梯度的优化流程；正演—互易基准与留出几何上的验证确认了模型精度并指出其局限，为探测器读出协同设计奠定基础。
items.highlight_zh: 伴随蒙特卡罗训练可微代理，加速光导几何协同设计
items.digest_zh:
【要解决什么】闪烁体探测器（如医学成像、高能物理中的成像量能器）需要把闪烁体产生的微弱光通过光导汇聚到读出端。光导形状设计得越好，收光越多、时间信息越清晰，探测器能提取的粒子相互作用信息也越多。但每评估一个候选几何，都要用蒙特卡罗方法追踪大量光子的随机路径，计算非常昂贵，难以放进需要成百上千次评估的梯度优化循环。
【用了什么方法】作者做了两件事。第一，建了一个模块化、事件驱动的蒙特卡罗正演模型，模拟闪烁光子的产生与输运。第二，利用光路可逆性构造“伴随模型”：不从闪烁体内向外发射光子，而是从光导读出面反向发射加权光子，统计它们落回闪烁体内的位置与时间，从而更高效地得到“可收集光输出”及其时间结构这一响应场。随后用伴随模型生成训练数据，训练一个以几何参数为条件的神经网络代理，输出收集概率和条件输运时间分布。
【得到了什么结果】在带两个镜面弯曲单包层光导的闪烁体单元上，作者用正演与伴随结果互相校验，并在未参与训练的几何上测试代理精度，同时明确指出模型失效的边界。
【为何重要】该代理可微，意味着光学响应可以被放进端到端可微的探测器设计流程，用梯度直接优化几何乃至读出方案，而不必穷举仿真。这为快速的光学响应研究和探测器“几何+电子学”协同设计提供了可复用的工具基础。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对数据划分、基线、消融与计算预算；结果的适用范围以原文实验为准。

items.title_en: RAP: Radial-Angular Random Projection for Hyperbolic Representations
items.title_zh: RAP：面向双曲表示的径向—角度随机投影
items.abstract_en: Random projection is a basic compression primitive for Euclidean representation learning, with the Johnson--Lindenstrauss lemma giving a target dimension $k=O(\varepsilon^{-2}\log n)$ independent of the ambient dimension. As hyperbolic representations gain increasing attention in modern Transformers, vision-language models, and large language models, the same need for oblivious dimensionality reduction arises, but no analogous primitive yet exists for hyperbolic representations. We study this gap. Two natural attempts fail in dual ways: a tangent-space scheme gives a clean local guarantee but is chart-bound and pays a curvature penalty, while a fully hyperbolic projection in the hyperboloid model is geometrically native but mixes radial and angular error before feeding them into the conditioning of $\operatorname{arcosh}$. We propose radial-angular random projection (RAP), which preserves the radial coordinate exactly and applies a Euclidean random projection only to the angular direction, lifting the result back to the target hyperboloid. RAP is hyperbolic-to-hyperbolic by construction, costs one Gaussian matrix-vector product, and reduces hyperbolic compression to a normalized angular JL question on $\mathbb{S}^{d-1}$. We prove a finite-set RAP guarantee with explicit $\sinh(\sqrt{c}\,r_x)\sinh(\sqrt{c}\,r_y)$ conditioning, complemented by a local tangent-space JL theorem and an arcosh-conditioning lemma for the fully hyperbolic comparator. Across an origin-centered broad-radius point cloud, a balanced tree, a clustered Gaussian, and the WordNet noun hierarchy, RAP attains the lowest mean relative distortion in every $(n,k)$ cell, reducing distortion over the strongest hyperbolic baseline by approximately $48\%$--$49\%$ on broad-radius data. RAP also scales to million-point datasets and improves retrieval on vision--language representations over hyperbolic projection baselines.
items.abstract_zh: 随机投影是欧氏表示学习的基本压缩原语，Johnson–Lindenstrauss 引理给出与真实维度无关的目标维度 k=O(ε^-2 log n)。随着双曲表示在 Transformer、视觉-语言模型与大语言模型中受到关注，同样需要与数据无关的降维，但双曲情形尚无对应原语。两种自然尝试各有缺陷：切空间方案局部保证干净，却受坐标卡限制并付出曲率代价；双曲面模型中的全双曲投影几何自然，却把径向与角度误差混合后送入 arcosh 的条件数。我们提出径向—角度随机投影（RAP）：精确保持径向坐标，仅对角度方向施加欧氏随机投影，再提升回目标双曲面。RAP 天然是双曲到双曲，只需一次高斯矩阵—向量乘，并把双曲压缩归约为 S^{d-1} 上的归一化角度 JL 问题。我们给出有限集 RAP 保证与显式条件；在宽半径点云、平衡树、聚类高斯与 WordNet 名词层级上，其平均相对失真在每个 (n,k) 单元格最低，宽半径数据上较最强双曲基线降低约 48%–49%。
items.highlight_zh: 保径向、只压角度，为双曲表示补上随机投影原语
items.digest_zh:
问题：随机投影是欧氏空间里最常用的降维手段——高维数据乘一个高斯随机矩阵就能大致保距，且目标维度只与点数和误差有关，与原始维度无关。可双曲表示（常用于层级数据、知识图谱）没有这样「随手压一压」的工具。
两条死路：先把点映到切空间再降维，局部性质漂亮，但依赖坐标卡、还得为曲率买单；直接在双曲面模型里做全双曲投影，几何上自然，却把半径误差和角度误差混在一起，再送进 arcosh 会被放大。
方法：RAP 的思路很干脆——径向坐标原样不动，只对角度方向做普通欧氏随机投影，然后把结果放回目标双曲面。这样一来，双曲压缩就变成了球面 S^{d-1} 上的标准化角度 JL 问题，计算量只需一次高斯矩阵—向量乘。
理论：作者给出有限点集的失真保证，显式包含 sinh(√c r_x)·sinh(√c r_y) 条件项（半径越大越吃紧），并配套局部切空间 JL 定理与 arcosh 条件引理，解释对照方案为何吃亏。
结果：在宽半径点云、平衡树、聚类高斯与 WordNet 名词层级上，RAP 在所有 (n,k) 组合下平均相对失真都最低，宽半径数据上比最强的双曲基线低约 48%–49%，并可扩展到百万级规模。
意义：为双曲表示补上了缺失的压缩原语，对需要大规模双曲嵌入的模型与检索系统有直接的工程价值。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: When Does Optical Context Compression Pay Off? A Decode-Aware Cost Analysis of Reasoning VLMs
items.title_zh: 光学上下文压缩何时才划算？推理型 VLM 的解码感知成本分析
items.abstract_en: Rendering long text as images lets a vision-language model (VLM) read a document with fewer input tokens, and evaluations often count mainly these prefill tokens. We show that for reasoning models this accounting is incomplete. Across five models and two long-context benchmarks, reading the rendered document makes the model think longer: decode length grows by 1.5-3.5x on the four general-purpose VLMs tested, and under typical output pricing this decode tax makes image input more expensive than text for two of the five models on QuALITY. Unrecoverable information loss is not sufficient to explain the tax at moderate compression: Qwen's OCR of the same images recovers 98.7% of words, and feeding Kimi-K3 its own transcription as text restores text-mode reasoning length and accuracy. Whether compression pays off reduces to an exchange rate, (1-1/c)/(r-1), that must exceed the workload's price-weighted ratio of output to input tokens; this accounting decomposition shows why Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash can benefit and Qwen and GLM cannot. None of the training-free signals we test predicts the tax before generation. As a practical heuristic, an image-first policy that sends only inputs with a per-input compression ratio of at least 1.6 to images and falls back to text once image-mode reasoning costs as much as the input's prefill saving cuts the bill by 6-14% on Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at an accuracy cost of 0.3-1.2 points; on QuALITY, asking for a reasoning budget on both paths is a stronger lever.
items.abstract_zh: 把长文本渲染成图像，可以让视觉语言模型（VLM）用更少的输入 token 读取文档，而现有评测通常只统计这部分 prefill token。我们指出，对推理模型来说这种成本核算并不完整：在五个模型与两个长上下文基准上，读渲染文档会让模型思考更久，四个通用 VLM 的解码长度增长 1.5–3.5 倍；按典型输出定价，这笔“解码税”使得在 QuALITY 上，图像输入对五个模型中的两个反而比文本更贵。在中等压缩率下，信息损失不足以解释该现象（Qwen 对同一图像的 OCR 可恢复 98.7% 的词）。是否划算可归结为一个必须超过价格加权输出/输入 token 比的“汇率”判据，据此可解释 Kimi-K3 与 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 获益而 Qwen、GLM 不能；图像优先的回退策略可降本 6–14%。
items.highlight_zh: 推理型 VLM 读图会“想更久”，解码税可让光学压缩得不偿失
items.digest_zh:
• 研究问题：把长文档渲染为图片再让 VLM 阅读，是省 token 的常见技巧。但以往评测只算“读进去”的输入 token，忽略了模型随后“想出来”的输出 token，这部分恰是推理模型最花钱的地方。
• 方法：作者在五个模型、两个长上下文基准上比较文本输入与图像输入，同时统计 prefill（输入）与 decode（输出）长度，并按真实价格折算总成本；再用 OCR 转写回灌、免训练信号预测等实验，拆解成本上涨的来源。
• 结果：图像输入会让解码长度膨胀 1.5–3.5 倍。信息损失并非主因——Qwen 的 OCR 能还原 98.7% 的词，把 Kimi-K3 自己的转写当文本喂回，推理长度与准确率都恢复正常。真正决定盈亏的是一个“汇率”式判据：压缩带来的输入节省，必须压过输出膨胀按价格加权后的代价。据此，Kimi-K3 与 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 能获益，Qwen 与 GLM 不能；且没有任何免训练信号能在生成前预测这笔税。
• 实用建议：只把压缩比≥1.6 的输入送成图像、一旦图像模式推理成本超过其输入节省就回退文本，可在两个模型上省 6–14% 费用，仅损失 0.3–1.2 个准确率点。
• 为何重要：它提醒业界，多模态“省 token”的宣传不能只看输入侧账单，必须把推理长度纳入成本模型。

items.title_en: ROAM-Bench: Evaluating Embodied Active Spatial Intelligence through Evidence Verification
items.title_zh: ROAM-Bench：通过证据验证评估具身主动空间智能
items.abstract_en: Embodied spatial intelligence requires agents to gather information through exploration and interaction, then use it to reason and act. Existing benchmarks insufficiently distinguish correct outcomes from completion of these task requirements. We introduce ROAM-Bench to evaluate these abilities under robot motion and collision constraints. Independent checks use simulation state and episode records to assess outcomes and task requirements, with stronger checks of geometry, coverage, or placement. It comprises 250 manually validated tasks across 11 types in five groups and 27 indoor environments, covering object and room search, counting, geometric judgments, direction reasoning, and relocation. Human evaluators achieve 84% strict task success on 100 sampled tasks, with every correct outcome satisfying the required checks. Across seven frontier vision-language models, we identify two complementary failure modes: correct outcomes with unmet task requirements, and incorrect outcomes despite passing stronger checks. Oracle-input diagnostics show that more complete target observations and calibrated feedback improve final spatial judgments.
items.abstract_zh: 具身空间智能要求智能体通过探索与交互收集信息，再据此推理与行动。现有基准难以区分“结果正确”与“任务要求被真正完成”。我们提出 ROAM-Bench，在机器人运动与碰撞约束下评估这些能力：独立检查借助仿真状态与回合记录判定结果与任务要求，并对几何、覆盖、摆放做更强校验。基准含五大组、11 类任务、27 个室内环境中的 250 个经人工验证任务，涵盖物体与房间搜索、计数、几何判断、方向推理和重定位。人类评测者在抽样的 100 个任务上严格任务成功率为 84%，且每个正确结果都满足必要检查。在七个前沿视觉语言模型上，我们发现两种互补的失败模式：结果正确但任务要求未满足，以及通过了更强检查却结果错误。Oracle 输入诊断表明，更完整的目标观测与校准反馈能改善最终空间判断。
items.highlight_zh: 区分“答案对”与“过程合规”，揭示具身空间智能的两类失败
items.digest_zh:
• 研究问题：具身智能体要在真实空间里边走边看、边看边想。以往基准往往只看最终答案对不对，答对了就给分，却不检查它是否真的按任务要求探索过、是否遵守了运动和碰撞约束，因此高分可能来自“蒙对”。
• 方法：作者构建 ROAM-Bench，在仿真中让智能体执行任务，并用独立的自动检查读取仿真状态与回合记录：不仅看结果，还看任务要求是否达成，并额外做几何关系、覆盖范围、物体摆放等更严格的校验。任务共 250 个，经人工验证，分属 5 组 11 类，覆盖 27 个室内环境，包括找物体、找房间、计数、几何判断、方向推理和重定位。
• 结果：人类在抽样 100 个任务上的严格成功率为 84%，且所有正确结果都通过了必要检查，说明评分标准可达成但不宽松。测试七个前沿视觉语言模型后，发现两类互补的失败：一是结果对了但过程不合规（比如没真正观察到目标）；二是过程看似通过更强校验，最终结论却错。
• 诊断与意义：用“Oracle 输入”（直接给出更完整的目标观测与校准反馈）做对照，发现模型的空间判断能明显改善，说明瓶颈部分在于观测不完整与反馈不校准，而非纯粹推理能力不足。这为后续具身模型的设计与评测提供了更细的诊断维度。

items.title_en: 3D CoCa v3: Contrastive Learners with Scene Graphs for Urban Scene Understanding
items.title_zh: 3D CoCa v3：用于城市场景理解的带场景图的对比学习器
items.abstract_en: Understanding large-scale 3D urban scenes requires representations that capture both multi-scale geometric structures and complex spatial relationships. However, existing 3D vision-language methods primarily emphasize global semantic alignment or object-level representations, leaving structured relational modeling underexplored within unified contrastive and generative frameworks. In this paper, we present 3D CoCa v3, a scene-graph-enhanced contrastive and generative framework for urban 3D scene understanding. Our framework features a Pyramid Vision Encoder for multi-scale geometric representation learning and a language-model-based decoder with question-guided caption retrieval and visual cross-attention. We further introduce MSG-based relational descriptions to enrich contrastive 3D-language alignment with structured spatial relationships. To support semantic and relational supervision, we construct City3D-9.6K, a multi-view urban vision-language dataset with aligned visual-geometric observations, scene captions, and scene graphs. Extensive experiments on City-3DQA demonstrate that 3D CoCa v3 achieves 88.35% and 64.79% overall top-1 accuracy on the sentence-wise and city-wise splits, surpassing 3D CoCa v2 by 20.88 and 3.57 percentage points, respectively. Furthermore, 3D CoCa v3 achieves the best performance on GeoEval3D, demonstrating its effectiveness in urban spatial reasoning and geometric understanding. Code is available at https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/3DCoCav3.
items.abstract_zh: 理解大规模 3D 城市场景需要能够同时捕获多尺度几何结构和复杂空间关系的表示。然而，现有 3D 视觉-语言方法主要强调全局语义对齐或对象级表示，使得结构化关系建模在统一的对比与生成框架中仍未得到充分探索。本文提出 3D CoCa v3，一个用于城市 3D 场景理解的场景图增强对比与生成框架。我们的框架具有用于多尺度几何表示学习的金字塔视觉编码器，以及基于语言模型的解码器，带有问题引导的标题检索和视觉交叉注意力。我们进一步引入基于 MSG 的关系描述，以结构化空间关系丰富对比式 3D-语言对齐。为支持语义和关系监督，我们构建 City3D-9.6K，一个多视角城市视觉-语言数据集，包含对齐的视觉-几何观测、场景标题和场景图。在 City-3DQA 上的大量实验表明，3D CoCa v3 在句子级和城市级划分上分别达到 88.35% 和 64.79% 的整体 top-1 准确率，分别比 3D CoCa v2 高出 20.88 和 3.57 个百分点。此外，3D CoCa v3 在 GeoEval3D 上取得最佳性能，展示了其在城市空间推理和几何理解方面的有效性。代码见 https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/3DCoCav3。

items.title_en: Learning Multimodal Representations from Partially Paired, Small-Scale Data
items.title_zh: 从部分配对的小规模数据中学习多模态表示
items.abstract_en: Modeling multimodal data from partially paired samples is critical for advancing domains like biomedicine, where vast unimodal datasets and foundation models exist but paired data remains scarce. Existing fusion methods rely on large-scale paired datasets, limiting their use in scenarios with incomplete pairing. We introduce CAMEO, an adversarial learning-based modality fusion framework that integrates modalities from small, partially paired datasets. Combining any pre-trained unimodal encoder with a cross-modal latent alignment mechanism, CAMEO learns shared representations requiring only minimal paired samples. Evaluated on computational pathology tasks such as niche classification and cell type composition prediction, CAMEO achieves superior data efficiency, outperforming contrastive approaches like CLIP in low paired-data regimes, and highlighting the benefits of adversarial alignment when paired annotations are scarce. To facilitate further research, we additionally release a fully annotated HuggingFace dataset comprising three organs and paired image and gene expression modalities. By extending fusion methods to address limited pairing and small-scale datasets, we provide a framework that advances multimodal learning and broadens its applicability to real-world biomedical problems.
items.abstract_zh: 从部分配对的样本中建模多模态数据，对生物医学等领域至关重要：这些领域有大量单模态数据和基础模型，配对数据却十分稀缺。现有融合方法依赖大规模配对数据，限制了其应用。作者提出 CAMEO，一个基于对抗学习的模态融合框架，能从少量部分配对数据中整合模态：它将任意预训练单模态编码器与跨模态隐空间对齐机制结合，只需极少配对样本即可学到共享表示。在计算病理学的 niche 分类与细胞类型组成预测任务上，CAMEO 在低配对数据条件下优于 CLIP 等对比方法，体现出更高的数据效率；作者另发布了一个涵盖三个器官、图像与基因表达配对的 HuggingFace 数据集。
items.highlight_zh: 少量配对数据即可融合多模态，数据效率超过 CLIP
items.digest_zh: ① 问题：生物医学（如计算病理）中单模态数据和基础模型很多，但同一样本同时具备图像与基因表达等配对数据的极少；主流融合方法（如 CLIP 式对比学习）依赖大规模配对数据，样本一少就失效。② 方法：CAMEO 用对抗学习做跨模态对齐。它可以直接接上任意预训练的单模态编码器，再加一个跨模态隐空间对齐机制，靠判别器区分配对与非配对表示，从而用少量配对样本把两种模态映射到同一表示空间。③ 结果：在 niche 分类、细胞类型组成预测等计算病理任务上，配对数据很少时 CAMEO 优于 CLIP 类对比方法，数据效率更高，说明对抗对齐在配对标注稀缺时更有优势。团队还发布了涵盖三个器官、图像与基因表达配对的公开 HuggingFace 数据集。④ 意义：把多模态融合从“必须大量配对”的假设中解放出来，让生物医学中大量半配对的真实数据变得可用，拓展了多模态学习的适用范围。

items.title_en: Monotone Crossing Lattices for Exact Binary Optimization Encodings on Rydberg Arrays
items.title_zh: 用于 Rydberg 阵列上精确二进制优化编码的单调交叉晶格
items.abstract_en: Programmable Rydberg-atom arrays realize maximum-weight independent set encoding on unit-disk graphs under the ideal blockade model, but embedding nonlocal interactions requires auxiliary atoms and limits the size of tractable instances. We introduce a four-state unit-disk crossing cell that couples directly to adjacent cells, with interfaces enforcing one-sided propagation: along occupied paths directed away from the diagonal, copy bits are nondecreasing. For the maximum-weight independent set problem, uniform cell weights guarantee that every ground state of the encoded instance decodes to an optimal solution of the original problem, even when local copies disagree. For binary quadratic objectives subject to pairwise Boolean constraints, every feasible optimum yields consistent active copies and a target weight given by an explicit constant offset minus the source objective. A rectangular variant of the architecture further encodes minimum set cover problem. Prior to constraint-induced site deletions, the full layout requires $2n^2 - n$ sites, halving the leading-order site count of a fixed complete-grid reference, while activity pruning yields an exact site count set by the propagation span. Across 18 paired benchmarks with independent ordering from a shared candidate pool, the layout reduces site counts by 12.1%-54.0%.
items.abstract_zh: 可编程 Rydberg 原子阵列在理想阻塞模型下实现了单位圆盘图上的最大权重独立集编码，但嵌入非局域相互作用需要辅助原子，并限制了可处理实例的规模。我们引入一种四态单位圆盘交叉单元，它直接与相邻单元耦合，其接口强制单向传播：沿远离对角线的占据路径，复制比特是非递减的。对于最大权重独立集问题，均匀单元权重保证编码实例的每个基态都解码为原问题的最优解，即使局部副本不一致。对于受成对布尔约束的二进制二次目标，每个可行最优解都产生一致的活动副本，以及由显式常数偏移减去源目标给出的目标权重。该架构的矩形变体进一步编码最小集合覆盖问题。在约束诱导的位点删除之前，完整布局需要 2n^2 - n 个位点，将固定完整网格参考的主导阶位点数减半，而活动剪枝产生由传播跨度设定的精确位点数。在来自共享候选池且具有独立排序的 18 个配对基准上，该布局将位点数减少 12.1%-54.0%。

items.title_en: Contact Geometry for Generative Models: An Unbalanced Optimal Transport Formulation
items.title_zh: 用于生成模型的接触几何：一种非平衡最优传输表述
items.abstract_en: Real-world generative problems in biology, medical imaging, or robotics, rarely come with perfectly paired source and target distributions. While unbalanced Optimal Transport (uOT) provides a robust framework to bridge unpaired datasets via minimum-length paths in probability space, existing formulations based on the Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao (WFR) geometry introduce a structural bias toward high density regions, often triggering mode collapse. We introduce Contact unbalanced Optimal Transport (CuOT), a novel uOT formulation grounded in contact geometry that decouples density transport direction from mass growth to eliminate structural bias. This allows CuOT to adapt sampling steps to the local data structure, naturally reducing step sizes in high-density regions to prevent overshooting and ensuring stable convergence. The result is a stable, scalable path-length minimization solver that consistently outperforms WFR-based methods on biological dynamics reconstruction, unpaired image-to-image translation, and video generation.
items.abstract_zh: 生物、医学成像与机器人等真实生成问题中，源分布与目标分布往往并非完美配对。非平衡最优传输（uOT）通过在概率空间中求最短路径，为无配对数据架桥，但基于 Wasserstein–Fisher–Rao（WFR）几何的现有形式存在对高密度区域的结构性偏置，常导致模式坍缩。本文提出 Contact 非平衡最优传输（CuOT），一种基于接触几何的新型 uOT 形式，将密度输运方向与质量增长解耦，从而消除结构性偏置。CuOT 能根据局部数据结构自适应调整采样步长，在高密度区自然缩小步长以避免过冲，保证稳定收敛，由此得到一个稳定、可扩展的路径长度最小化求解器，在生物动力学重建、无配对图像到图像翻译与视频生成上一致优于基于 WFR 的方法。
items.highlight_zh: 接触几何解耦密度输运与质量增长，消除 uOT 结构偏置
items.digest_zh:
【要解决什么】许多生成式建模场景（细胞动力学、医学影像、机器人轨迹）拿不到一一配对的数据：源分布和目标分布形状不同、质量也不相等。非平衡最优传输（uOT）正是为此设计，它允许概率质量在搬运途中“生出”或“消失”。但主流实现基于 Wasserstein–Fisher–Rao（WFR）几何，会天然把概率质量往高密度区推，形成结构性偏置，训练中容易出现模式坍缩——模型只覆盖少数几个模态。
【用了什么方法】作者从接触几何（contact geometry）出发重新表述 uOT，提出 CuOT。核心是把两件事拆开：概率质量往哪个方向搬运，和质量增加多少。在 WFR 里这两者被绑在一起，于是产生了偏向高密度区的漂移；解耦后，采样步长可以根据数据的局部结构自适应调节，在高密度区域自动缩小步长，避免“冲过头”，使路径长度最小化的求解更稳定、更易扩展到大规模问题。
【得到了什么结果】作者在生物动力学重建、无配对图像到图像翻译和视频生成三类任务上做了验证，CuOT 一致优于基于 WFR 的方法，并表现出更稳定的收敛行为。
【为何重要】这相当于给无配对数据的生成建模换了一套更合理的几何底座：既保留了 uOT 处理质量不守恒的灵活性，又去掉了导致模式坍缩的偏置，减少调参负担，且求解器可扩展，对实际应用有直接价值。

items.title_en: Escriba-OCR: A 1B Vision-Language Model for Error-Preserving Transcription of Handwritten Portuguese Essays
items.title_zh: Escriba-OCR：一个用于手写葡萄牙语作文保留错误转写的 1B 视觉语言模型
items.abstract_en: Feedback tools and research on learner writing need transcriptions of handwritten essays that keep exactly what the student wrote: misspellings, line breaks, struck-through words and insertions. Vision-language models (VLMs) read handwriting well, but they also tend to rewrite it into correct language. We measure this on BRESSAY, 1,000 handwritten Brazilian Portuguese essays, with a benchmark that adds error preservation, invented errors, edit-markup precision and recall and line structure to the character error rate (CER) and uses paired bootstrap confidence intervals. We restrict the study to open-weight models that schools can run on their own hardware. Of 22 open baselines, the best, Qwen3-VL 235B-A22B, reaches 5.6% CER on the 199 test pages; none reproduces the edit markup reliably, and every VLM replaces 39-78% of the words absent from a Portuguese dictionary with dictionary words. We fine-tune LightOnOCR-3-1B on the 647 training pages in 85 minutes on one GPU. The resulting Escriba-OCR-1B reaches 2.06% CER, 3.5 points below the best baseline (95% CI [-4.2, -2.9]); under the ICDAR 2024 competition metric it reaches 2.1% CER, below the best published page-level results (2.2-2.4%). It recovers 67% of insertions and 77% of illegible deletions, and reproduces the line structure of 97% of the pages, but still normalises 60% of likely misspellings. Three seeds agree within 0.04 CER points, and quantised to 4 bits the model runs on an ordinary CPU at about one minute per page. On 40 letters of another corpus it matches its base model (without that model's appended comments) but misreads unseen words more often; weight interpolation recovers half the gap. A teacher's review finds that 45% of the judgeable apparent corrections are errors in the BRESSAY ground truth, so dictionary-based scores likely understate preservation. We release the model, the benchmark code and the review data.
items.abstract_zh: 反馈工具和学习者写作研究需要对手写作文进行转写，且必须精确保留学生所写内容：拼写错误、换行、划掉词语和插入内容。视觉语言模型（VLM）能很好地阅读手写文本，但它们也倾向于将其改写为正确语言。我们在 BRESSAY（1,000 篇手写巴西葡萄牙语作文）上测量这一点，所用基准在字符错误率（CER）之外增加了错误保留、虚构错误、编辑标记精确率和召回率以及行结构，并使用配对 bootstrap 置信区间。我们将研究限制在学校可在自有硬件上运行的开放权重模型。在 22 个开放基线中，最佳的 Qwen3-VL 235B-A22B 在 199 个测试页面上达到 5.6% CER；没有一个能可靠复现编辑标记，而且每个 VLM 都会把葡萄牙语词典中不存在的单词中的 39–78% 替换为词典词。我们在 647 个训练页面上微调 LightOnOCR-3-1B，在一块 GPU 上耗时 85 分钟。所得 Escriba-OCR-1B 达到 2.06% CER，比最佳基线低 3.5 个百分点（95% CI [-4.2, -2.9]）；在 ICDAR 2024 竞赛指标下，它达到 2.1% CER，低于最佳已发表页面级结果（2.2–2.4%）。它恢复了 67% 的插入和 77% 的不可辨认删除，并复现了 97% 页面的行结构，但仍将 60% 的可能拼写错误正常化。三个随机种子在 0.04 CER 点内一致，量化为 4 比特后，模型在普通 CPU 上以每页约一分钟运行。在另一语料的 40 封信件上，它与基座模型匹配（不含该模型附加的评论），但更常误读未见词；权重插值恢复了一半差距。教师审查发现，在可判断的表观更正中有 45% 是 BRESSAY 真值中的错误，因此基于词典的分数可能低估了保留程度。我们发布模型、基准代码和审查数据。

items.title_en: RoboEvo$^2$: Recursive Robot Self-Improvement via Harness-Policy Co-Evolution
items.title_zh: RoboEvo$^2$：通过 Harness-策略协同进化的递归机器人自我改进
items.abstract_en: Robots should adapt to unfamiliar environments and acquire new skills through interaction, then execute those skills efficiently with practice. Vision-language-action policies provide efficient control, but often need additional human demonstrations to handle unfamiliar settings; reasoning agents can discover solutions using broad prior knowledge and robot-control APIs, but repeated deliberation and repair are costly. Inspired by human learning through reasoning and practice, we propose RoboEvo$^2$, a framework for recursive harness-policy co-evolution. In Policy-to-Harness (P2H) evolution, policy failures guide a coding agent to search complementary Code, Code+ICL, and Code+Policy routes, consolidating verified solutions into reusable skills, routing strategies, and experience memory. In Harness-to-Policy (H2P) evolution, verified trajectories provide supervised training, while Counterfactual Preference Distillation (CPD) teaches the policy to favor successful corrections over failures from the same starting state. The improved policy provides stronger motor skills for subsequent search, while its remaining failures redirect harness evolution, closing the reciprocal loop. Through recursive co-evolution without additional human demonstrations, RoboEvo$^2$ improves standalone success from 11.0% to 84.1% and hybrid success from 30.4% to 90.5% on LIBERO-PRO, with similar gains and reduced agentic costs on RoboTwin C2R. Further experiments demonstrate autonomous task acquisition, cross-embodiment harness transfer, and 95.0% hybrid success on the Unitree G1-D. Our models and code will be publicly released.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人应适应不熟悉的环境，并通过交互获得新技能，然后通过练习高效执行这些技能。视觉-语言-动作策略提供高效控制，但通常需要额外的人类演示来处理不熟悉的设置；推理智能体可以使用广泛的先验知识和机器人控制 API 发现解决方案，但反复推理和修复代价高昂。受人类通过推理和实践学习的启发，我们提出 RoboEvo$^2$，一个用于递归 harness-策略协同进化的框架。在 Policy-to-Harness（P2H）进化中，策略失败引导编码智能体搜索互补的 Code、Code+ICL 和 Code+Policy 路线，将经验证的解决方案整合为可复用技能、路由策略和经验记忆。在 Harness-to-Policy（H2P）进化中，经验证的轨迹提供监督训练，而反事实偏好蒸馏（CPD）教导策略在相同起始状态下偏好成功的修正而非失败。改进后的策略为后续搜索提供更强的运动技能，而其剩余失败重新引导 harness 进化，闭合互惠循环。通过无需额外人类演示的递归协同进化，RoboEvo$^2$ 在 LIBERO-PRO 上将独立成功率从 11.0% 提高到 84.1%，将混合成功率从 30.4% 提高到 90.5%，并在 RoboTwin C2R 上取得类似增益且降低智能体成本。进一步实验展示了自主任务获取、跨具身 harness 迁移，以及在 Unitree G1-D 上 95.0% 的混合成功率。我们的模型和代码将公开。

items.title_en: HOG-WAM: Improving Visual Robustness through Future Gradient Prediction
items.title_zh: HOG-WAM：通过未来梯度预测提升视觉鲁棒性
items.abstract_en: World-action models jointly predict future observations and actions, yet visual corruption can disrupt the resulting policies. We introduce HOG-WAM, which adds future Histograms of Oriented Gradients (HOG) as structural supervision derived directly from demonstration images. An auxiliary HOG diffusion transformer (DiT) module reads RGB features through asymmetric attention, allowing its objective to shape the visual representation used for control. The module is used only during training and removed at inference, preserving FastWAM's RGB-to-action architecture. We evaluate four controlled observation corruptions through a visual-corruption extension of RoboTwin, termed RoboTwin-Plus; HOG-WAM achieves the highest success among the compared policies under all four. Mixed-noise success increases from 78.86% to 82.86% relative to FastWAM, with comparable performance on clean scenes. On LIBERO Plus, overall success increases from 74.49% to 75.26%, with the largest gain under sensor noise, from 74.14% to 78.89%. Across four Franka tasks, average success increases from 40% to 59% under clean observations and from 17% to 24% under noisy observations. A representation ablation favors combining RGB observations with auxiliary HOG prediction over replacing RGB with HOG. These findings support future-gradient prediction as complementary supervision for visually robust control, with larger absolute gains on physical tasks than in simulation. Code is available at https://github.com/iPPLab/HOG-WAM.
items.abstract_zh: 世界-动作模型联合预测未来观测和动作，但视觉损坏会扰乱由此产生的策略。我们引入 HOG-WAM，它将未来的方向梯度直方图（HOG）作为直接从演示图像导出的结构监督。一个辅助 HOG 扩散 Transformer（DiT）模块通过非对称注意力读取 RGB 特征，使其目标能够塑造用于控制的视觉表示。该模块仅在训练时使用，在推理时移除，从而保留 FastWAM 的 RGB 到动作架构。我们通过 RoboTwin 的视觉损坏扩展 RoboTwin-Plus 评估四种受控观测损坏；HOG-WAM 在全部四种情况下在所比较的策略中取得最高成功率。相对于 FastWAM，混合噪声成功率从 78.86% 提高到 82.86%，在干净场景上性能相当。在 LIBERO Plus 上，整体成功率从 74.49% 提高到 75.26%，在传感器噪声下增益最大，从 74.14% 提高到 78.89%。在四个 Franka 任务上，平均成功率在干净观测下从 40% 提高到 59%，在噪声观测下从 17% 提高到 24%。表示消融偏好将 RGB 观测与辅助 HOG 预测结合，而非用 HOG 替换 RGB。这些发现支持未来梯度预测作为视觉鲁棒控制的补充监督，并且在物理任务上比在仿真中具有更大的绝对增益。代码见 https://github.com/iPPLab/HOG-WAM。

items.title_en: Fishing for new immunotherapy compounds to boost innate tumor rejection
items.title_zh: 寻找增强先天性肿瘤排斥的新型免疫治疗化合物
items.abstract_en: Despite significant advances in cancer immunotherapy, tackling immunosuppression remains critical to achieve more effective responses. While developing the zebrafish xenograft model, we found that some human tumors engraft very efficiently ("progressors"), while others are cleared by the host ("regressors"). We showed that this was dependent on innate immunity, which recognizes and eliminates some cancer cells, while others are able to evade and suppress it. This opened an opportunity to perform an in vivo phenotypic drug screen to find compounds that induce clearance by boosting innate-tumor rejection. Zebrafish xenografts of human colorectal (CRC) and breast cancer (BC) that show a high engraftment/low clearance phenotype were used to screen over 500 FDA-approved small-molecule compounds, with tumor clearance serving as the phenotypic readout. The screen identified 23 hit compounds, of which six were effective across both cancer models. Mechanism-of-action enrichment analysis revealed a significant overrepresentation of autonomic nervous system-targeting drugs among the hits, particularly cholinergic ones. Immune profiling in myeloid reporter lines showed that the lead hit, Tiotropium bromide, a muscarinic receptor antagonist, reprograms tumor-associated macrophages toward a pro-inflammatory, anti-tumoral state. Tiotropium significantly increased macrophage phagocytosis, and macrophage depletion completely abolished its pro-clearance activity, establishing these myeloid cells as essential effectors. In a syngeneic CT26 colorectal mouse model, Tiotropium synergized with anti-PD-1 to control tumor growth and improve survival, outperforming all monotherapy arms. This effect was immune-dependent, as it was lost in immunodeficient NSG mice. Together, these findings demonstrate that in vivo phenotypic screening of FDA-approved compounds in zebrafish xenografts is a productive strategy for innate immune drug discovery in cancer. The identification of Tiotropium as a myeloid-reprogramming innate immune primer, together with the unbiased recovery of the neuro-immune axis as a druggable target, opens new avenues for overcoming immunotherapy resistance.
items.abstract_zh: 尽管癌症免疫治疗取得了显著进展，应对免疫抑制仍是实现更有效应答的关键。在开发斑马鱼异种移植模型时，我们发现一些人源肿瘤能非常高效地植入（“进展者”），而另一些则被宿主清除（“消退者”）。我们表明这依赖于先天免疫：先天免疫识别并清除某些癌细胞，而其他癌细胞则能够逃避并抑制它。这为开展体内表型药物筛选提供了机会，以寻找通过增强先天免疫对肿瘤的排斥来诱导清除的化合物。使用表现出高植入/低清除表型的人结直肠癌（CRC）和乳腺癌（BC）斑马鱼异种移植模型，筛选了500多种FDA批准的小分子化合物，以肿瘤清除作为表型读出。筛选鉴定出23个命中化合物，其中6个在两种癌症模型中均有效。作用机制富集分析显示，命中化合物中靶向自主神经系统的药物显著过代表，尤其是胆碱能药物。在髓系报告细胞系中的免疫分析表明，先导命中化合物噻托溴铵（一种毒蕈碱受体拮抗剂）将肿瘤相关巨噬细胞重编程为促炎、抗肿瘤状态。噻托溴铵显著增强巨噬细胞吞噬作用，而清除巨噬细胞完全消除了其促清除活性，从而确立这些髓系细胞为必需效应细胞。在同系CT26结直肠癌小鼠模型中，噻托溴铵与抗PD-1协同控制肿瘤生长并改善生存，优于所有单药治疗组。该效应依赖免疫，因为在免疫缺陷NSG小鼠中该效应消失。总之，这些发现表明，在斑马鱼异种移植模型中对FDA批准化合物进行体内表型筛选，是癌症先天免疫药物发现的一种高效策略。将噻托溴铵鉴定为一种重编程髓系细胞的先天免疫引发剂，以及无偏地发现神经-免疫轴作为可成药靶点，为克服免疫治疗耐药开辟了新途径。

items.title_en: Direct generation of N00N states with layered semiconductors
items.title_zh: 利用层状半导体直接生成 N00N 态
items.abstract_en: Photonic N00N states enable phase sensing beyond the classical limit, but their generation conventionally relies on interferometric manipulation of photons using bulk optical components. Here we demonstrate the direct generation of a family of tunable two-photon polarization N00N states from a subwavelength-thick 3R-MoS2 flake. For propagation along the optic axis, the in-plane crystal symmetry allows all symmetry permitted spontaneous parametric down-conversion pathway to interfere coherently, while the large second-order nonlinearity provides sufficient brightness at submicrometer thickness without phase matching. The pump polarization sets the basis of the N00N state or equivalently a two-photon Holland-Burnett state without altering its structure or the generation efficiency. The biphotons are highly indistinguishable, reach high fidelity with the target state across a wide range of pump polarizations, and show two-photon interference fringes with visibilities above the threshold for the postselected phase supersensitivity. Our theoretical analysis further indicates that, in the ideal single-mode limit, the same interaction would yield higher-order Holland-Burnett states. By eliminating interferometric stages, our results establish a compact, pump-programmable source for quantum-enhanced polarization interferometry
items.abstract_zh: 光子 N00N 态能够实现超越经典极限的相位传感，但其产生通常依赖于使用体光学元件对光子进行干涉操控。在此，我们展示了从亚波长厚度的 3R-MoS2 薄片直接生成一族可调谐双光子偏振 N00N 态。对于沿光轴传播，面内晶体对称性允许所有对称性允许的自发参量下转换路径相干干涉，而大的二阶非线性在亚微米厚度下无需相位匹配即可提供足够亮度。泵浦偏振设定 N00N 态的基，或等价地设定双光子 Holland-Burnett 态的基，而不改变其结构或产生效率。双光子高度不可区分，在广泛的泵浦偏振范围内与目标态达到高保真度，并显示出可见度高于后选择相位超灵敏度阈值的双光子干涉条纹。我们的理论分析进一步表明，在理想单模极限下，相同相互作用会产生高阶 Holland-Burnett 态。通过消除干涉阶段，我们的结果建立了一个紧凑、泵浦可编程的源，用于量子增强偏振干涉测量。

items.title_en: InducedTFMs: A Family of Sub-Quadratic Tabular Foundation Models Using Induced Attention
items.title_zh: InducedTFM：基于诱导注意力的次二次复杂度表格基础模型家族
items.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) have emerged as a serious competitor to gradient-boosted trees, predicting on a new table in a single forward pass by in-context learning. However, their attention is quadratic in the number of samples and features, which caps pretraining at small synthetic tables and forces inference on large ones to rely on chunking or subsampling. Row-compression models reduce the feature-wise cost, but only by discarding the cell-level representation, and remain quadratic in the number of samples. We introduce InducedTFM, which replaces both attention stages of a bidimensional TFM with the induced attention of the Set Transformer, preserving cell-level representations while making its cost linear in both samples and features. Under a training budget matched to a full-attention TabICLv2 reimplementation, InducedTFM matches its accuracy on TabArena and on a benchmark of larger datasets, and clearly outperforms a kernel linear-attention baseline of the same asymptotic cost. It overtakes TabICLv2 in inference time on narrow tables, reaching a 30x speed-up at 640K rows, although row compression remains preferable on wide tables.
items.abstract_zh: 表格基础模型（TFM）通过上下文学习、在单次前向中预测新表格，已成为梯度提升树的有力竞争者；但其注意力对样本数和特征数均为二次复杂度，使预训练规模受限于小型合成表，大表推理只能依赖分块或下采样。行压缩方法降低了特征方向开销，却丢弃单元格级表示，且在样本数上仍是二次的。作者提出 InducedTFM，用 Set Transformer 的诱导注意力替换二维 TFM 的两个注意力阶段，在保留单元格级表示的同时，使样本与特征方向的开销都变为线性。在与全注意力 TabICLv2 重实现相匹配的训练预算下，InducedTFM 在 TabArena 及更大数据集基准上精度相当，并明显优于同等渐近开销的核线性注意力基线；在窄表上推理快于 TabICLv2，64 万行时加速达 30 倍，但宽表上仍以行压缩方案为佳。
items.highlight_zh: 诱导注意力让表格基础模型对样本与特征均线性
items.digest_zh: ① 问题：表格基础模型靠上下文学习，一次前向就能预测新表格，效果已能与梯度提升树抗衡。但它的注意力对样本数和特征数都是二次复杂度，因此预训练只能用小型合成表，遇到大表只能分块或下采样。已有的行压缩方法降低了特征方向的开销，却丢掉了单元格级表示，样本方向仍是二次。② 方法：InducedTFM 把二维表格 TFM 的两个注意力阶段（样本间、特征间）都换成 Set Transformer 的诱导注意力：用少量可学习的“诱导点”作为中介来聚合信息，复杂度对样本和特征都是线性，同时保留单元格级表示。③ 结果：在与全注意力 TabICLv2 重实现相同的训练预算下，InducedTFM 在 TabArena 和更大数据集的基准上精度相当，并明显优于同渐近复杂度的核线性注意力基线；在窄表上推理更快，64 万行时达 30 倍加速；但宽表上仍以行压缩方案更合适。④ 意义：为表格基础模型提供了一条可扩展路线——预训练与推理不再被表格规模卡住，同时不牺牲细粒度信息。

items.title_en: Bigger Model or Bigger Table? How Much Backbone a Chorus N-gram Module Replaces
items.title_zh: 更大的模型还是更大的表？Chorus N-gram 模块替代了多少骨干
items.abstract_en: We ask how much of a transformer's backbone the Chorus N-gram module replaces. Chorus adds hashed tables of token bigrams and trigrams to its input and attention. We train models of 16M to 349M parameters on 1.34 billion tokens of Polish printed before 1918 and find the size of a plain model with the same held-out loss. A separate learning-rate search for each kind of model cuts Chorus's gain at 47M by about a third. With tables about as large as the backbone, Chorus then matches a plain model 1.34 times its size at 16M and 1.16 to 1.20 times from 107M to 349M. With these tables, each added parameter replaces at most 0.31 backbone parameters. Chorus trains slower than a plain model of its size and faster than one of the same loss. On a fact quiz the two differ about as much as two seeds of one model. The results rest on one corpus, one 8,000-token vocabulary and a fifth of an epoch.
items.abstract_zh: 我们研究 Chorus N-gram 模块替代了 transformer 骨干的多少部分。Chorus 将 token 二元组和三元组的哈希表加入其输入和注意力。我们在 1918 年前印刷的波兰语文本的 13.4 亿个 token 上训练 1600 万至 3.49 亿参数的模型，并找出具有相同留出损失的普通模型的规模。对每类模型分别进行学习率搜索，使 Chorus 在 4700 万参数时的增益减少约三分之一。当表规模与骨干大致相当时，Chorus 在 1600 万参数时匹配参数量为其 1.34 倍的普通模型，在 1.07 亿至 3.49 亿参数时匹配为其 1.16 至 1.20 倍的普通模型。使用这些表时，每个新增参数最多替代 0.31 个骨干参数。Chorus 训练速度慢于相同规模的普通模型，但快于具有相同损失的普通模型。在事实测验中，两者差异大致相当于同一模型的两个随机种子之间的差异。结果基于一个语料库、一个 8,000 token 词表以及五分之一个 epoch。

items.title_en: FAST-LIO2: Fast Direct LiDAR-inertial Odometry
items.abstract_en: This paper presents FAST-LIO2: a fast, robust, and versatile LiDAR-inertial odometry framework. Building on a highly efficient tightly-coupled iterated Kalman filter, FAST-LIO2 has two key novelties that allow fast, robust, and accurate LiDAR navigation (and mapping). The first one is directly registering raw points to the map (and subsequently update the map, i.e., mapping) without extracting features. This enables the exploitation of subtle features in the environment and hence increases the accuracy. The elimination of a hand-engineered feature extraction module also makes it naturally adaptable to emerging LiDARs of different scanning patterns; The second main novelty is maintaining a map by an incremental k-d tree data structure, ikd-Tree, that enables incremental updates (i.e., point insertion, delete) and dynamic re-balancing. Compared with existing dynamic data structures (octree, R*-tree, nanoflann k-d tree), ikd-Tree achieves superior overall performance while naturally supports downsampling on the tree. We conduct an exhaustive benchmark comparison in 19 sequences from a variety of open LiDAR datasets. FAST-LIO2 achieves consistently higher accuracy at a much lower computation load than other state-of-the-art LiDAR-inertial navigation systems. Various real-world experiments on solid-state LiDARs with small FoV are also conducted. Overall, FAST-LIO2 is computationally-efficient (e.g., up to 100 Hz odometry and mapping in large outdoor environments), robust (e.g., reliable pose estimation in cluttered indoor environments with rotation up to 1000 deg/s), versatile (i.e., applicable to both multi-line spinning and solid-state LiDARs, UAV and handheld platforms, and Intel and ARM-based processors), while still achieving higher accuracy than existing methods. Our implementation of the system FAST-LIO2, and the data structure ikd-Tree are both open-sourced on Github.

items.title_zh: FAST-LIO2：快速直接 LiDAR-惯性里程计
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 FAST-LIO2：一个快速、鲁棒且通用的 LiDAR-惯性里程计框架。它在高效紧耦合迭代卡尔曼滤波的基础上引入两项关键创新。其一是将原始点直接配准到地图并同步更新地图，无需提取特征，从而能利用环境中的细微特征提高精度，去掉手工特征提取也使系统天然适配不同扫描模式的新型 LiDAR。其二是用增量式 k-d 树 ikd-Tree 维护地图，支持增量插入、删除与动态重平衡；相比八叉树、R*-tree、nanoflann k-d 树，ikd-Tree 整体性能更优且天然支持树上降采样。作者在多个公开 LiDAR 数据集的 19 个序列上做了详尽基准比较，FAST-LIO2 以远低的计算量取得一致更高的精度，并在小视场固态 LiDAR 上开展真实实验。总体而言，它计算高效（大型室外场景可达 100 Hz）、鲁棒（室内杂乱环境、旋转达 1000 deg/s 仍可靠定位）、通用（适配多线旋转与固态 LiDAR、无人机与手持平台、Intel 与 ARM 处理器），精度高于现有方法。
items.highlight_zh: 原始点直接配准配合 ikd-Tree，实现高频高精度 LiDAR 惯性里程计
items.digest_zh:
【要解决什么】LiDAR-惯性里程计要让机器人在未知环境中实时知道自己在哪、并同时建图。传统方法一般先从每帧点云里提取边缘、平面等特征再匹配，这样做会丢掉环境中的细节，而且特征提取模块往往与特定 LiDAR 的扫描模式绑定，换一种新式 LiDAR 就得重做；另外地图用 k-d 树等结构维护时，频繁重建非常耗时，成为速度瓶颈。
【用了什么方法】FAST-LIO2 建立在紧耦合的迭代卡尔曼滤波上，做了两处关键改动。第一，跳过特征提取，把原始点云直接配准到地图并同步更新地图，这样能利用细微结构提升精度，也自然适配不同扫描模式的 LiDAR（包括小视场的固态 LiDAR）。第二，自己实现增量式 k-d 树 ikd-Tree 来维护地图，支持点的插入、删除和局部重平衡，还能直接在树上做降采样，避免每次都重建整棵树。
【得到了什么结果】作者在多个公开 LiDAR 数据集的 19 条序列上与其他先进系统做了详尽对比，FAST-LIO2 在计算量低得多的情况下精度一致更高。实机实验中，大型室外场景可达约 100 Hz 的里程计与建图；在杂乱室内环境、角速度高达 1000 deg/s 时仍能可靠估计位姿；可运行于多线旋转 LiDAR 与固态 LiDAR、无人机与手持平台、Intel 与 ARM 处理器。代码已开源。
【为何重要】它把“直接用原始点”和“增量地图”这两件事做成了工程上可用的组合，兼具速度、鲁棒性和跨传感器通用性，成为该方向被广泛引用的基线，也启发了后续大量 LiDAR-惯性系统与实时建图工作。

items.title_en: Tracking Any Point with Agentic Visual Reasoning
items.title_zh: 以智能体视觉推理跟踪任意点
items.abstract_en: A general-purpose Vision-Language Model (VLM) has surpassed expert vision models in many domains such as object detection and video recognition. However, point correspondence is known to be challenging for VLMs since it goes beyond object-level recognition: it requires pixel-level localization of the same physical surface point across observations, even when appearance changes or the point disappears and later reappears. In this paper, we introduce AgenTAP, a VLM-based agent that directly predicts point coordinates and visibility and actively reasons over videos. Starting from its own estimate, the agent autonomously chooses what to inspect and uses the resulting evidence to verify point identity and refine its predictions. With GPT-6 Astra, it surpasses expert vision models in both point localization and visibility prediction, without correspondence-specific fine-tuning. We further use AgenTAP to re-identify physical points after disappearance and reconnect fragmented tracks, constructing EgoTAP-4D, a dataset of 3D point trajectories in long real-world egocentric videos. On sampled reappearing points, its predictions approach human agreement, and adding EgoTAP-4D to D4RT training improves average 3D tracking performance.
items.abstract_zh: 通用视觉语言模型（VLM）已在目标检测和视频识别等许多领域超越专家视觉模型。然而，点对应被认为对 VLM 具有挑战性，因为它超出目标级识别：它要求在观测之间对同一物理表面点进行像素级定位，即使外观发生变化，或该点消失后再次出现。本文介绍 AgenTAP，一种基于 VLM 的智能体，可直接预测点坐标和可见性，并主动对视频进行推理。该智能体从自身估计出发，自主选择要检查的内容，并利用由此获得的证据验证点的身份并细化其预测。在 GPT-6 Astra 的加持下，它在点定位和可见性预测两方面均超越专家视觉模型，且无需针对对应关系进行特定微调。我们进一步使用 AgenTAP 在物理点消失后重新识别它们，并重新连接碎片化轨迹，构建 EgoTAP-4D，这是一个长时真实世界第一人称视频中的 3D 点轨迹数据集。在采样的重新出现点上，其预测接近人类一致性；将 EgoTAP-4D 加入 D4RT 训练可提升平均 3D 跟踪性能。

items.title_en: Constraint-Based Pan-Cancer Metabolic Modeling Identifies Medium-Robust Biomarkers and Broad-Spectrum Anticancer Targets
items.title_zh: 基于约束的泛癌代谢建模识别中等稳健生物标志物和广谱抗癌靶点
items.abstract_en: Background: Cancer metabolic reprogramming varies across tumour types and nutrient environments, complicating the identification of robust metabolic biomarkers and therapeutic targets. We developed a constraint based pancancer framework to identify medium robust metabolic alterations and broadly effective candidate enzyme targets. Methods: Transcriptomic profiles from 33 TCGA cancer types were integrated with Recon3D to reconstruct cancer and healthy tissue specific genome scale metabolic models. Parsimonious multiobjective metabolite flow variability analysis was performed under five nutrient conditions to classify differential rates of metabolite synthesis, uptake, and secretion. An extended Anticancer Target Discovery framework incorporating fuzzy multiobjective optimization was employed to evaluate candidate enzyme perturbations based on cancer cell inhibition, ATP suppression, preservation of healthy tissue metabolism, and robustness across nutrient conditions. Findings: The models predicted recurrent increases in cardiolipin-related lipid synthesis and aromatic amino acid metabolism, enhanced uptake of essential amino acids and choline, and elevated lactate secretion across multiple cancer medium combinations. CRLS1 emerged as the most broadly effective predicted enzyme target, satisfying the treatment criteria across all 165 cancer medium combinations, whereas PGS1 and PTPMT1 exhibited broad but incomplete coverage. These findings highlight mitochondrial phospholipid metabolism as a potential shared vulnerability across cancer types and provide testable candidates for metabolomic and experimental validation.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：癌症代谢重编程因肿瘤类型和营养环境而异，这使识别稳健的代谢生物标志物和治疗靶点变得复杂。我们开发了一个基于约束的泛癌框架，以识别中等稳健的代谢改变和广泛有效的候选酶靶点。方法：将来自 33 种 TCGA 癌症类型的转录组谱与 Recon3D 整合，以重建癌症和健康组织特异性基因组尺度代谢模型。在五种营养条件下进行简约多目标代谢物通量变异性分析，以分类代谢物合成、摄取和分泌的差异速率。采用结合模糊多目标优化的扩展抗癌靶点发现框架，基于癌细胞抑制、ATP 抑制、健康组织代谢保持以及跨营养条件的稳健性来评估候选酶扰动。发现：模型预测在多种癌症培养基组合中，心磷脂相关脂质合成和芳香族氨基酸代谢反复增加，必需氨基酸和胆碱摄取增强，乳酸分泌升高。CRLS1 成为最广泛有效的预测酶靶点，在全部 165 种癌症培养基组合中满足治疗标准，而 PGS1 和 PTPMT1 表现出广泛但不完整的覆盖。这些发现突出线粒体磷脂代谢是跨癌种潜在的共同脆弱性，并为代谢组学和实验验证提供可检验的候选。
