items.title_en: Decoupling the clocks of learning and computing in spiking neural networks
items.title_zh: 解耦脉冲神经网络中学习与计算的时钟
items.abstract_en: Biological intelligence thrives on minimal power despite its noisy, imperfect components, with neurons that communicate through voltage spikes. Brain-inspired computing seeks to bring such efficiency to real devices, which requires training methods tailored to them. The standard way to train spiking neural networks, backpropagation through time, computes weight updates through every step of a simulated device, so faithful or long simulations can make training costly and unstable. Here we show that spiking networks can learn reliably and efficiently by decoupling the clock of learning from that of computing. Our method, ChronoProp, calculates weight updates from each neuron's spike counts in fixed time bins using its measured input-output function. Compared with backpropagation through time, ChronoProp reaches similar accuracy in image classification, with about 3 times less training time and 20 times less memory at the finest timestep tested, and up to 10 times fewer spikes. On spoken-word benchmarks, ChronoProp is far more accurate in recurrent networks at fine timesteps, and with simple, hardware-compatible techniques it approaches the best published models. These networks also tolerate simulated hardware defects and limitations better than those trained with backpropagation through time. Therefore, ChronoProp enables stable and efficient training in simulations close to the continuous time of analog hardware.
items.abstract_zh: 生物智能尽管由噪声大、不完美的组件构成，却能以极低功耗蓬勃发展，其神经元通过电压脉冲进行通信。类脑计算旨在将这种效率带到真实设备中，这需要为其量身定制的训练方法。训练脉冲神经网络的标准方法——随时间反向传播——通过模拟设备的每一步计算权重更新，因此高保真或长时模拟会使训练代价高昂且不稳定。在这里，我们表明脉冲网络可以通过将学习的时钟与计算的时钟解耦来可靠且高效地学习。我们的方法ChronoProp利用每个神经元测得的输入-输出函数，从固定时间箱中的脉冲计数计算权重更新。与随时间反向传播相比，ChronoProp在图像分类中达到相似准确率，在所测试的最细时间步长下训练时间约少3倍、内存约少20倍，脉冲最多少10倍。在口语词基准上，ChronoProp在细时间步长的循环网络中准确率远高于随时间反向传播，并且借助简单、硬件兼容的技术，它接近已发表的最佳模型。这些网络也比用随时间反向传播训练的网络更好地容忍模拟硬件缺陷和限制。因此，ChronoProp能够在接近模拟硬件连续时间的模拟中实现稳定且高效的训练。

items.title_en: When Ink Meets Pixel: Intent-Aware OCR with VLMs for Human-Corrected Financial Documents
items.title_zh: 当墨迹遇见像素：面向人工校正金融文档的、基于 VLM 的意图感知 OCR
items.abstract_en: Human annotations on documents (such as arrows, carets, strikethroughs, and insertions) express corrective intent yet existing OCR and document understanding systems treat these marks as visual noise rather than semantic edit operations. We introduce intent-aware OCR, the task of generating corrected transcriptions by jointly reasoning over original document content and visual intent cues (handwritten or digital) that convey edit intent. To support this setting, we present DocIntent, a multimodal dataset of 1,600 financial documents with over 5,700 annotated visual intent cues, each paired with layout-aware, intent-resolved OCR targets. We further introduce IntentBench, a 216-document benchmark designed to evaluate model robustness under diverse real-world annotation conditions. Leveraging DocIntent, we fine-tune DocIntentOCR, a suite of 3B and 7B parameter vision-language models, under direct intent supervision on corrected transcriptions. On IntentBench, the fine-tuned 3B and 7B models achieve F1-scores of 0.81 and 0.83, respectively, substantially outperforming commercial closed-source (e.g., GPT-4.1 (0.626)), and open-source models (e.g., LLaMA-3.2-Vision-90B (0.50)) demonstrating that intent-aware supervision enables compact domain-specific models to outperform substantially larger general-purpose systems on this task. This work establishes intent-aware OCR as a novel human-in-the-loop document understanding task and provides foundational resources (dataset, benchmark, models) to advance research in interactive document processing.
items.abstract_zh: 文档上的人工标注（如箭头、插入符、删除线和插入内容）表达了校正意图，然而现有的 OCR 和文档理解系统将这些标记视为视觉噪声，而非语义编辑操作。我们引入意图感知 OCR，即通过联合推理原始文档内容和传达编辑意图的视觉意图线索（手写或数字）来生成校正后转录的任务。为支持这一设定，我们提出 DocIntent，一个包含 1,600 份金融文档、超过 5,700 个已标注视觉意图线索的多模态数据集，每个线索都配有布局感知、意图解析后的 OCR 目标。我们进一步引入 IntentBench，一个包含 216 份文档的基准，旨在评估模型在不同真实世界标注条件下的鲁棒性。利用 DocIntent，我们在校正后转录的直接意图监督下微调 DocIntentOCR，这是一套 3B 和 7B 参数的视觉语言模型。在 IntentBench 上，微调后的 3B 和 7B 模型分别达到 0.81 和 0.83 的 F1 分数，大幅优于商业闭源模型（例如 GPT-4.1 (0.626)）和开源模型（例如 LLaMA-3.2-Vision-90B (0.50)），表明意图感知监督使紧凑的领域特定模型在该任务上能够超越大得多的通用系统。这项工作将意图感知 OCR 确立为一种新颖的人在回路文档理解任务，并提供基础资源（数据集、基准、模型）以推进交互式文档处理研究。

items.title_en: iMFPO: Improving Mean Flow Policy Optimization with Drift-Aware Velocity Alignment for Embodied Control
items.title_zh: iMFPO：通过漂移感知速度对齐改进平均流策略优化以实现具身控制
items.abstract_en: Flow-based generative policies offer expressive action modeling for embodied control, yet achieving efficient one-step generation under reward-driven policy optimization remains challenging. In particular, evolving action distributions during online reinforcement learning may introduce inconsistencies between instantaneous-velocity learning and interval-averaged action generation. To address this challenge, we propose iMFPO, a one-step generative policy optimization framework with decoupled velocity learning and drift-aware velocity alignment. A shared interval-conditioned actor supports instantaneous-velocity supervision and interval-averaged action generation. JVP-corrected velocity regression is jointly optimized with reward-driven policy objectives, with action-level guidance from a frozen PPO teacher during training. At inference, iMFPO directly generates actions through interval-averaged velocity prediction, achieving one-step control without iterative flow integration. Across Go2, G1, H1, and Spot, zero-latent evaluation yields mean returns of 35.69, 34.44, 416.23, and 29.86. On Go2, action-generation latency drops from 15.57 ms to 0.41 ms relative to 64-step RFPO. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/iMFPO. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/iMFPO.
items.abstract_zh: 基于流的生成式策略为具身控制提供了富有表现力的动作建模，但在奖励驱动策略优化下实现高效单步生成仍具挑战性。具体而言，在线强化学习过程中不断演化的动作分布可能引入瞬时速度学习与区间平均动作生成之间的不一致。为应对该挑战，我们提出 iMFPO，一种具有解耦速度学习和漂移感知速度对齐的单步生成式策略优化框架。一个共享的区间条件 actor 同时支持瞬时速度监督和区间平均动作生成。JVP 校正的速度回归与奖励驱动的策略目标联合优化，训练期间由冻结的 PPO 教师提供动作级引导。在推理时，iMFPO 通过区间平均速度预测直接生成动作，无需迭代流积分即可实现单步控制。在 Go2、G1、H1 和 Spot 上，零潜变量评估得到的平均回报分别为 35.69、34.44、416.23 和 29.86。在 Go2 上，相对于 64 步 RFPO，动作生成延迟从 15.57 ms 降至 0.41 ms。代码：https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/iMFPO。网站：https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/iMFPO。

items.title_en: PartAgent: Agentic 3D Part Segmentation via Expert Integration and Closed-Loop Refinement
items.title_zh: PartAgent：通过专家集成与闭环细化实现的智能体式三维部件分割
items.abstract_en: Segmenting a 3D object into semantically meaningful parts requires joint reasoning about geometric structure and semantic context. Pretrained 3D experts provide spatially grounded region proposals, while 2D experts provide semantic cues for identifying object parts. The challenge is to integrate these complementary capabilities into a framework that can both produce meaningful part segmentations and progressively refine them. We present PartAgent, a training-free agentic framework for 3D part segmentation built upon two complementary modules: (i) Structural-Semantic Expert Integration combines regions predicted by the 3D expert with multiview semantic evidence from the 2D expert through image-to-surface correspondences, constructing compositional part partitions at multiple granularities. (ii) Observation-Driven Closed-Loop Partition Refinement observes the current partition and its supporting evidence to select targeted inspection, evidence repair, composition, or reselection actions. It verifies proposed changes and uses the updated state and action outcomes to guide subsequent decisions. On PartObjaverse-Tiny-WT, PartAgent achieves 68.41 mIoU, outperforming the strongest competing method by 8.53 points. Across 3DCoMPaT200, PartNeXt, PartNetE, and PartObjaverse-Tiny, PartAgent achieves the highest mIoU on each dataset, averaging 69.36 across the four datasets, 7.28 points above the highest mean among competing methods.
items.abstract_zh: 将三维物体分割为语义上有意义的部件，需要联合推理几何结构与语义上下文。预训练的三维专家提供具有空间定位的区域提议，而二维专家提供用于识别物体部件的语义线索。挑战在于将这些互补能力整合到一个既能产生有意义的部件分割、又能逐步对其进行细化的框架中。我们提出 PartAgent，一个无需训练的智能体式三维部件分割框架，建立在两个互补模块之上：(i) 结构-语义专家集成，通过图像到表面的对应关系，将三维专家预测的区域与来自二维专家的多视图语义证据相结合，在多个粒度上构建组合式部件划分。(ii) 观测驱动的闭环划分细化，观测当前划分及其支撑证据，以选择有针对性的检查、证据修复、组合或重新选择动作。它验证所提出的更改，并利用更新后的状态与动作结果来指导后续决策。在 PartObjaverse-Tiny-WT 上，PartAgent 达到 68.41 mIoU，比最强的对比方法高出 8.53 个点。在 3DCoMPaT200、PartNeXt、PartNetE 和 PartObjaverse-Tiny 上，PartAgent 在每个数据集上均取得最高 mIoU，四个数据集的平均值为 69.36，比对比方法中的最高平均值高 7.28 个点。

items.title_en: Active sensing as control over sensory acquisition
items.title_zh: 主动感知作为对感觉获取的控制
items.abstract_en: The term "active sensing" is used across neuroscience and engineering to describe a wide range of sensing behaviors, but there is no consensus on what makes sensing "active." We propose that the behaviors grouped under this label are better understood as forms of control over sensory acquisition and develop a framework that distinguishes three interacting forms of control. Mechanistic control physically structures sensory input, strategic control modulates sensing in closed loop through adaptive and attentional processes, and agentic control concerns the sensing policies available to an agent and its authority to choose among them. These forms of control can occur separately or in combination, and have distinct consequences for sensory input, perception, behavior, and performance. The framework clarifies active-passive comparisons and provides a common basis for analyzing biological, engineered, and hybrid sensing systems by asking what is controlled, how, and by whom.
items.abstract_zh: “主动感知”一词在神经科学与工程领域被用来描述范围广泛的感知行为，但对于什么使感知成为“主动的”，尚无共识。我们提出，归于此标签下的各种行为最好被理解为对感觉获取的控制形式，并构建了一个区分三种相互作用控制形式的框架。机制性控制以物理方式构造感觉输入；策略性控制通过自适应与注意过程在闭环中调节感知；智能体性控制则涉及智能体可用的感知策略及其在其中进行选择的权限。这些控制形式可以单独出现，也可以组合出现，并对感觉输入、知觉、行为与性能产生不同的影响。该框架澄清了主动-被动比较，并通过追问“控制什么、如何控制、由谁控制”，为分析生物、工程与混合感知系统提供了共同基础。

items.title_en: QuOptLab: Advancing Quantum Optics Experiments with an AI Agent
items.title_zh: QuOptLab：利用 AI 智能体推进量子光学实验
items.abstract_en: Recent advances in AI-assisted theoretical research suggest that AI agents can contribute to research-level problems. Whether they can also advance experimental research by conducting experiments, analyzing the results, and proposing better experimental designs remains an open question. To address this question, we build a simulated quantum optics laboratory and integrate it with an AI agent in QuOptLab. The laboratory includes optical instruments, a robotic arm, and cameras, enabling the agent to carry out and iteratively refine experiments. We consider two complementary tasks: thin-film thickness measurement in free-space optics and edge-coupler design in integrated photonics. In the thin-film thickness measurement task, the agent repeatedly analyzes measurement results and revises its measurement method, including calibration and data analysis, reducing thickness-estimation error from 7.13 to 0.066~nm$^2$ over six epochs in a classical-interference run. For edge-coupler design, the agent iteratively proposes structural modifications, evaluates the resulting coupling performance, and uses the feedback to guide subsequent revisions, increasing simulated coupling efficiency from 85.81% to 91.98%.
items.abstract_zh: AI 辅助理论研究的近期进展表明，AI 智能体可以为研究级问题作出贡献。它们是否也能通过执行实验、分析结果并提出更好的实验设计来推进实验研究，仍是一个开放问题。为回答这个问题，我们构建了一个模拟量子光学实验室，并将其与 AI 智能体集成，形成 QuOptLab。该实验室包括光学仪器、机械臂和相机，使智能体能够执行并迭代改进实验。我们考虑两个互补任务：自由空间光学中的薄膜厚度测量和集成光子学中的边缘耦合器设计。在薄膜厚度测量任务中，智能体反复分析测量结果并修改其测量方法，包括校准和数据分析，在经典干涉运行中经过六个 epoch 将厚度估计误差从 7.13 降至 0.066~nm$^2$。对于边缘耦合器设计，智能体迭代提出结构修改，评估所得耦合性能，并利用反馈指导后续修改，将模拟耦合效率从 85.81% 提高到 91.98%。

items.title_en: Interpretable identification of constitutive parameter field for three-dimensional heterogeneous and graded hyperelastic materials from full-field displacements
items.title_zh: 基于全场位移的三维非均质与梯度超弹性材料本构参数场的可解释识别
items.abstract_en: The inverse problem of identifying spatially varying material properties of heterogeneous solids using experimentally available displacement fields and boundary reaction forces alone remains challenging. Being able to characterize heterogeneous and graded solids would be advantageous in the design and manufacturing of functionally graded materials and composites. Additionally, an efficient technique for identifying heterogeneous material properties from in vivo measurements would be useful in biomedical contexts to characterize heterogeneous biological tissues. Although several techniques developed over the past two decades have addressed inverse identification for homogeneous materials, including linear elastic, hyperelastic, viscoelastic, and elastoplastic solids, comparatively fewer studies have considered heterogeneous and graded materials. Furthermore, several recent approaches to characterizing heterogeneous and graded materials employ parameter-heavy, deep learning-based frameworks trained to enforce force equilibrium at specified collocation points within the material. In this work, we propose an interpretable and time-efficient framework that predicts the three-dimensional relative spatial variation of a constitutive parameter field for multiple parameters of a heterogeneous hyperelastic material, using only displacement-field data. In this work, we validate our framework on 3D synthetic and 2D experimental benchmarks involving heterogeneous, graded, and anisotropic hyperelastic materials. By leveraging the linear nature of the inverse problem for hyperelastic materials and directly optimizing for the constitutive parameters at the finite-element level, we achieve acceptable prediction accuracy with significantly lower computational time compared to recently reported deep-learning-based frameworks.
items.abstract_zh: 仅利用实验可获得的位移场和边界反作用力来识别非均质固体空间变化材料属性的反问题仍具挑战性。能够表征非均质和梯度固体将有利于功能梯度材料和复合材料的设计与制造。此外，一种从体内测量中识别非均质材料属性的高效技术将在生物医学场景中用于表征非均质生物组织。尽管过去二十年开发的若干技术已经解决了均质材料的逆向识别，包括线弹性、超弹性、黏弹性和弹塑性固体，但考虑非均质和梯度材料的研究相对较少。此外，近期几种表征非均质和梯度材料的方法采用参数繁重的、基于深度学习的框架，这些框架经过训练以在材料内指定配点处强制力平衡。在本工作中，我们提出一个可解释且时间高效的框架，仅使用位移场数据预测非均质超弹性材料多个参数的本构参数场的三维相对空间变化。在本工作中，我们在涉及非均质、梯度和各向异性超弹性材料的三维合成和二维实验基准上验证了我们的框架。通过利用超弹性材料反问题的线性性质，并在有限元层面直接优化本构参数，我们以比近期报道的基于深度学习的框架显著更低的计算时间实现了可接受的预测精度。

items.title_en: Repairing the Trustworthiness of Distilled Language Models
items.title_zh: 修复蒸馏语言模型的可信性
items.abstract_en: Knowledge distillation enables the deployment of large language models through smaller student models, but the compression process can introduce regressions in trustworthiness even when downstream performance is preserved. Repairing such failures is challenging because the original distillation corpus is often unavailable, while direct preference optimization may alter capabilities inherited from the teacher. We propose a targeted repair framework based on the proximal Bregman response function (PBRF) that addresses both limitations. We estimate the curvature required for PBRF using a surrogate proxy dataset, removing dependence on the original transfer corpus, and extend the framework to preference-based supervision through an odds-ratio objective. This enables the use of preferred and dispreferred response pairs while constraining changes to the distilled model. Our results show that the proposed approach improves targeted trustworthiness behaviors for both pre-training and post-training models while largely preserving downstream performance, providing a practical alternative to re-distillation or unconstrained preference optimization. Our experiment results show that across different distilled models, the trustworthy regression can be improved by up to 8% with less than 1% decrement in perplexity.
items.abstract_zh: 知识蒸馏通过更小的学生模型实现大语言模型的部署，但即使下游性能得以保持，压缩过程也可能引入可信性方面的退化。修复此类失败具有挑战性，因为原始蒸馏语料通常不可用，而直接偏好优化可能改变从教师继承的能力。我们提出一个基于近端 Bregman 响应函数（PBRF）的定向修复框架，以解决这两个限制。我们使用替代代理数据集估计 PBRF 所需的曲率，从而消除对原始迁移语料的依赖，并通过优势比目标将框架扩展到基于偏好的监督。这使得能够使用偏好和非偏好响应对，同时约束对蒸馏模型的更改。我们的结果表明，所提方法改善了预训练模型和后训练模型的定向可信性行为，同时大体保持下游性能，为再蒸馏或无约束偏好优化提供了一种实用替代方案。我们的实验结果表明，在不同的蒸馏模型上，可信性回归指标最多可改善 8%，而困惑度下降不到 1%。

items.title_en: RePace: Reasoning about Demonstration Speedup for Faster Vision-Language-Action Policies
items.title_zh: RePace：推理演示加速以实现更快的视觉-语言-动作策略
items.abstract_en: Since vision-language-action (VLA) policies can inherit the slow pace of human demonstrations, accelerating these demonstrations before fine-tuning can lead to faster VLA policies without an additional speed-selection module at deployment. Several offline speedup methods have focused on identifying segments that require less precision and assigning predefined speedup factors to the segments. However, even within a single segment, a speedup factor suitable for steady motion may be too high when precise alignment is required. To this end, this paper presents RePace, an offline reasoning framework that determines how much to accelerate each part of a demonstration. For the same recorded movement, RePace measures how much each candidate speedup factor shortens the sequence and compares the resulting observation-action pairs used for training. Given the task instruction, a pretrained language model uses the visual context and original motion of successive windows to interpret these candidate retiming effects and select a speedup profile for the complete episode. Experimental results demonstrate that RePace outperforms the baselines in overall task execution efficiency on both LIBERO and RoboCasa-Kitchen. On all three tasks with a gripper-equipped Franka Research 3 arm, RePace matches or exceeds the acceleration baselines in success rate and completes successful trials faster.
items.abstract_zh: 由于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略可能继承人类演示的缓慢节奏，在微调前加速这些演示可以产生更快的 VLA 策略，而无需在部署时额外的速度选择模块。若干离线加速方法侧重于识别需要较少精度的片段，并为这些片段分配预定义加速因子。然而，即使在单个片段内，适合平稳运动的加速因子在需要精确对齐时也可能过高。为此，本文提出 RePace，一个离线推理框架，用于确定将演示的每个部分加速多少。对于同一记录运动，RePace 测量每个候选加速因子缩短序列的程度，并比较用于训练得到的观测-动作对。给定任务指令，预训练语言模型利用连续窗口的视觉上下文和原始运动来解释这些候选重定时效应，并为完整回合选择加速配置。实验结果表明，RePace 在 LIBERO 和 RoboCasa-Kitchen 上的整体任务执行效率优于基线。在配备夹爪的 Franka Research 3 机械臂上的全部三个任务中，RePace 在成功率上匹配或超过加速基线，并更快完成成功试验。

items.title_en: LoopDVR: Looped Transformer for Efficient Dense Visual Recognition
items.title_zh: LoopDVR：用于高效密集视觉识别的循环 Transformer
items.abstract_en: We propose LoopDVR, a framework for converting pretrained Transformer-based dense visual recognition models into parameter-efficient looped networks. Rather than reducing the network width or depth directly, LoopDVR reuses Transformer blocks across layers in both the ViT backbone and Transformer decoder, reducing the number of parameters while retaining the original computational structure. However, naively sharing parameters can disrupt the distinct transformations learned at different depths. To address this challenge, we identify suitable sharing groups based on inter-layer representation dissimilarity and keep the final backbone block independent for multi-scale feature construction. We then initialize each shared backbone block with the pretrained weights of its group's terminal layer to better preserve the learned representations. An independent Loop Adapter at each layer further helps retain depth-specific transformations within shared blocks. Subsequently, we distill visual representations into the looped backbone and integrate it with a looped decoder for task-specific training. Experiments demonstrate that LoopDVR achieves the best accuracy--parameter trade-offs across dense recognition tasks. Compared with the reference models, it reduces parameters by approximately 28% while maintaining competitive accuracy. Notably, LoopDet-S achieves 50.9 box AP with only 7.0M parameters, highlighting its effectiveness in compact models.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 LoopDVR，一个将预训练的基于 Transformer 的密集视觉识别模型转换为参数高效循环网络的框架。LoopDVR 不直接减小网络宽度或深度，而是在 ViT 主干和 Transformer 解码器中跨层复用 Transformer 块，在保留原始计算结构的同时减少参数数量。然而，朴素地共享参数可能破坏不同深度学到的不同变换。为应对这一挑战，我们基于层间表示差异度识别合适的共享组，并保持最后一个主干块独立以进行多尺度特征构建。然后，我们用每个共享主干块所属组终端层的预训练权重初始化该共享主干块，以更好地保留已学习的表示。每层独立的 Loop Adapter 进一步有助于在共享块内保留深度特定的变换。随后，我们将视觉表示蒸馏到循环主干中，并将其与循环解码器集成以进行任务特定训练。实验表明，LoopDVR 在密集识别任务上实现了最佳的精度—参数权衡。与参考模型相比，它在保持有竞争力精度的同时将参数减少约 28%。值得注意的是，LoopDet-S 仅用 7.0M 参数就达到 50.9 box AP，突显了其在紧凑模型中的有效性。

items.title_en: Direction of ESCRT-III-dependent membrane bending emerges from bilayer asymmetry
items.title_zh: ESCRT-III 依赖性膜弯曲的方向源于双层不对称性
items.abstract_en: ESCRT-III is the cell's principal machinery for reverse-topology membrane scission, cutting necks from within. Yet purified ESCRT-III predominantly assembles on the outside of membranes and bends them the opposite way. How one polymer chooses its direction is a long-standing paradox. Here, we show that ESCRT-III supplies the force, but bilayer asymmetry sets the direction. In budding yeast, sphingolipid asymmetry is required for efficient intraluminal vesicle formation: without it, cargo sorting is impaired and endosomal intermediates accumulate. In reconstituted membranes, imposing either lipid or protein asymmetry across the bilayer is sufficient to orient ESCRT-III-driven deformation. Leaflet-resolved fluorescence-lifetime imaging reveals that both act through a single mechanism: unequal lipid packing between leaflets generates differential tensile stress that dictates which way the membrane bends. Reconstituted membranes are typically symmetric; cellular membranes are not. This resolves the reverse-topology paradox and identifies bilayer asymmetry as a directional cue available to any membrane-remodeling machine.
items.abstract_zh: ESCRT-III 是细胞执行反向拓扑膜剪切、从内部切割颈部的主要机器。然而，纯化的 ESCRT-III 主要组装在膜外侧，并使膜向相反方向弯曲。一种聚合物如何选择其方向是一个长期悖论。在此，我们表明 ESCRT-III 提供力，但双层不对称性决定方向。在芽殖酵母中，鞘脂不对称性是高效腔内囊泡形成所必需的：没有它，货物分选受损，内体中间体积累。在重构膜中，在双层两侧施加脂质或蛋白质不对称性足以定向 ESCRT-III 驱动的变形。小叶分辨的荧光寿命成像显示，两者通过单一机制起作用：小叶之间不等的脂质堆积产生差异拉伸应力，从而决定膜向哪个方向弯曲。重构膜通常是对称的；细胞膜则不是。这解决了反向拓扑悖论，并将双层不对称性确定为任何膜重塑机器都可利用的方向线索。

items.title_en: Geometric Control of Electronic Decoherence in a Chiral Spin-Orbit Coupled Helix
items.title_zh: 手性自旋-轨道耦合螺旋中电子退相干的几何控制
items.abstract_en: While chirality is known to impact chemical and optical properties of molecular systems, as well as their biological function, far less is known about its impact on quantum coherence. By considering a chiral helix as a paradigmatic model, we show that within the Born-Markov regime, changing the degree of helical twist can be used to modulate the electronic decoherence rate. Moderate to strong spin-orbit coupling between next-nearest-neighbor sites along the helix are shown to give rise to a strong dependence of the electronic decoherence rate on the degree of chirality. The effect of chirality on electronic decoherence rates is also seen to be strongly impacted by the spatial and temporal correlations between the local environmental fluctuations to which the local excitations along the helix are subject. Our results show that chirality can serve as a tunable design parameter for quantum engineering and highlight the importance role environmental correlations can play in determining how chirality affects electronic decoherence rates.
items.abstract_zh: 尽管已知手性会影响分子体系的化学和光学性质及其生物功能，但对其量子相干性的影响了解得少得多。通过将手性螺旋视为一个范式模型，我们表明在Born-Markov区域，改变螺旋扭转程度可用于调制电子退相干速率。沿螺旋的次近邻位点之间的中等至强自旋-轨道耦合会导致电子退相干速率对 chiral 程度产生强依赖。手性对电子退相干速率的影响还受到沿螺旋的局域激发所经历的局域环境涨落之间空间和时间相关性的强烈影响。我们的结果表明，手性可作为量子工程的可调设计参数，并突出环境相关性在决定手性如何影响电子退相干速率方面可发挥的重要作用。

items.title_en: Decentralized Clustered Federated Learning for Cellular Traffic Forecasting over LEO Constellations
items.title_zh: 面向 LEO 星座蜂窝流量预测的去中心化聚类联邦学习
items.abstract_en: Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite constellations are positioned to act as orbital edge-compute nodes in emerging 6G non-terrestrial networks, supporting forecasting and control tasks for ground cellular infrastructure. However, training such models is challenged by heterogeneous ground-cell traffic patterns, intermittent links to ground stations, and the satellites' own orbital motion, which continuously shifts the data each satellite observes. In this work, we extend Decentralized Federated Clustering (DFCA) to the LEO setting and apply it to cellular internet-traffic forecasting on the Telecom Italia Milan+Trentino dataset. Satellites cooperate exclusively through $k$-nearest inter-satellite gossip with no ground-side aggregator, while zero-shot head selection lets each satellite specialize to the latent traffic regime of the ground cell currently beneath it. Averaged over $K{=}20$ post-training orbital snapshots, our extension reduces forecasting Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) by $15.3\%$ over a decentralized FedAvg baseline of equivalent capacity, with cluster recovery accuracy of $85.3\%$. The results indicate that clustered specialization yields measurable gains under the structural heterogeneity inherent to realistic cellular-over-LEO scenarios.
items.abstract_zh: 低地球轨道（LEO）卫星星座有望在新兴 6G 非地面网络中充当轨道边缘计算节点，支持地面蜂窝基础设施的预测和控制任务。然而，训练此类模型受到异质地面小区流量模式、与地面站间歇性链路以及卫星自身轨道运动的挑战，后者不断改变每颗卫星观测到的数据。在本工作中，我们将去中心化联邦聚类（DFCA）扩展到 LEO 场景，并将其应用于 Telecom Italia Milan+Trentino 数据集上的蜂窝互联网流量预测。卫星仅通过 $k$ 近邻星间 gossip 协作，没有地面侧聚合器，而零样本头部选择使每颗卫星专用于其当前下方地面小区的潜在流量模式。在 $K{=}20$ 个训练后轨道快照上平均，我们的扩展相比同等容量的去中心化 FedAvg 基线将预测均方根误差（RMSE）降低 15.3%，聚类恢复准确率为 85.3%。结果表明，在真实蜂窝-over-LEO 场景固有的结构异质性下，聚类专门化产生了可测量的增益。

items.title_en: Technical Report MEG2text: Beyond Alignment in Non-Invasive Brain-to-Text
items.title_zh: 技术报告 MEG2text：非侵入式脑到文本中超越对齐
items.abstract_en: Non-invasive brain-to-text seeks to recover language from brain activity without surgery. A central challenge is turning learned brain-language representations into accurate word predictions. We present MEG2text, a decoding system that combines corrected training and evaluation, brain-text alignment, a class-balanced word readout, and target-word language-model fusion. On LibriBrain100's word-ranking task, MEG2text reaches 64.12% mean Top-10 balanced accuracy, improving on published MEG-XL by 16.92 percentage points across four corpora, with gains on each corpus. Controlled comparisons show that both implementation corrections and a learned readout contribute to this improvement. Candidate-level analysis reveals that some words receive informative scores yet consistently lose to competing candidates, while an identical-feature comparison shows that learning the classification rule improves decoding without changing the representation. These findings identify the decoding rule as a consequential part of non-invasive brain-to-text and show how system improvements can make better use of aligned neural features.
items.abstract_zh: 非侵入式脑到文本旨在无需手术地从脑活动中恢复语言。核心挑战在于将学习到的脑-语言表征转化为准确的词预测。我们提出 MEG2text，一种解码系统，它结合了校正后的训练与评估、脑-文本对齐、类别平衡的词读出以及目标词语言模型融合。在 LibriBrain100 的词排序任务上，MEG2text 达到 64.12% 的平均 Top-10 平衡准确率，在四个语料库上相较已发表的 MEG-XL 提升 16.92 个百分点，且每个语料库均有增益。受控比较表明，实现层面的校正和学习到的读出均对这一改进有贡献。候选级别分析揭示，有些词获得有信息量的分数却持续输给竞争候选；而相同特征比较表明，学习分类规则可在不改变表征的情况下改进解码。这些发现将解码规则确定为非侵入式脑到文本中的一个关键部分，并展示系统改进如何能更好地利用对齐的神经特征。

items.title_en: SkySearcher: High-Altitude Onboard VLM Reasoning for Aerial Semantic Search
items.title_zh: SkySearcher：用于空中语义搜索的高空机载 VLM 推理
items.abstract_en: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have improved semantic and visual reasoning, enabling UAVs to search for open-vocabulary queries in unstructured environments at high altitude. However, existing systems mainly follow low-altitude strategies, focusing on close-range iterative exploration, requiring storage-intensive dense 3D metric-semantic reconstructions or relying on large cloud-serviced VLMs assuming constant internet access. We propose SkySearcher, an aerial semantic search navigation method designed for large outdoor scenes. SkySearcher integrates onboard VLM reasoning with a lightweight probabilistic representation that guides an information-driven exploration. The VLM extracts semantic information at high altitude about the target or cues informing about its location. This information is projected to the ground using the camera frustum instead of limited-depth sensors, actively exploiting the expansive field of view offered by elevated sensing. The information regarding the presence or absence of semantic cues is then integrated into a probabilistic map by modeling the spatial belief of the query, maintaining a task-driven memory for the mission and guiding the exploration towards semantically promising regions. Extensive simulations for Aerial Object Goal Navigation on public benchmarks demonstrate that SkySearcher significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in success rate, flight time, and navigation precision, while a deployment of SkySercher running fully onboard a drone demonstrates the applicability of our approach.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）的最新进展提升了语义与视觉推理能力，使无人机能够在高空非结构化环境中搜索开放词汇查询。然而，现有系统主要采用低空策略，聚焦近距离迭代探索，需要存储密集的稠密三维度量-语义重建，或依赖假设持续联网的大型云服务 VLM。我们提出 SkySearcher，一种面向大型室外场景的空中语义搜索导航方法。SkySearcher 将机载 VLM 推理与轻量级概率表征相结合，以引导信息驱动的探索。VLM 在高空提取关于目标或其位置线索的语义信息。该信息使用相机视锥而非有限深度传感器投影到地面，主动利用高空传感提供的广阔视野。随后，通过建模查询的空间置信，将关于语义线索存在与否的信息集成到概率地图中，为任务维护任务驱动的记忆，并引导探索朝向语义上有希望的区域。在公开基准上的空中物体目标导航大量仿真表明，SkySearcher 在成功率、飞行时间和导航精度上显著优于最先进基线；而将 SkySearcher 完全机载部署在无人机上运行，展示了我们方法的适用性。

items.title_en: Beyond Feature Fusion: Sensor-Grounded Semantic-Spiking Learning for Robust Object Detection
items.title_zh: 超越特征融合：面向鲁棒目标检测的传感器锚定语义脉冲学习
items.abstract_en: Underexposure weakens object details, and overexposure obscures boundaries. Spike cameras encode light into high-frequency binary streams. Long-window spike counts give stable appearance cues, while short observations reveal changes in firing rates from sparse measurements. We propose SPIRE, a sensor-grounded semantic-spiking framework for illumination-robust object detection from a single spike stream. SPIRE builds an appearance view from the full packet through detection-oriented illumination adaptation and constructs a sequence of cumulative views from progressively longer prefixes. Each prefix supplies a rate map, an edge map, and a rate difference that tracks changes as spikes accumulate. At selected scales, ANN features and spike-derived initialization jointly set the initial membrane potentials and firing thresholds, allowing semantic cues to shape the responses during temporal encoding. Local spike-count contrasts supervise both branches during training. The residual between measured and ANN-predicted contrasts combines with the spiking features to produce a bounded correction to the fused feature pyramid. On simulated VOC and COCO, SPIRE-D outperforms the strongest baseline by 4.00-5.50 AP50 points across the four under- and overexposure settings. On real PKU-Vidar-DVS recordings, it achieves 67.07 AP50 and 40.10 AP75. SPIRE-D also uses 50.4% fewer MACs than SPFD.
items.abstract_zh: 曝光不足会削弱目标细节，曝光过度会模糊边界。脉冲相机将光编码为高频二值流。长窗口脉冲计数提供稳定的外观线索，而短观测从稀疏测量中揭示发放率的变化。我们提出 SPIRE，一种传感器锚定的语义脉冲框架，用于从单条脉冲流进行光照鲁棒的目标检测。SPIRE 通过面向检测的光照自适应从完整数据包构建外观视图，并从逐渐增长的脉冲前缀构建一系列累积视图。每个前缀提供速率图、边缘图以及随着脉冲累积跟踪变化的速率差。在选定尺度上，ANN 特征和脉冲衍生初始化共同设置初始膜电位和发放阈值，使语义线索能够在时间编码期间塑造响应。训练期间，局部脉冲计数对比监督两个分支。测量对比与 ANN 预测对比之间的残差与脉冲特征结合，对融合特征金字塔产生有界校正。在模拟 VOC 和 COCO 上，SPIRE-D 在四种曝光不足和曝光过度设置下以 4.00–5.50 个 AP50 点优于最强基线。在真实 PKU-Vidar-DVS 记录上，它达到 67.07 AP50 和 40.10 AP75。SPIRE-D 的 MACs 也比 SPFD 少 50.4%。

items.title_en: Resolving cell states in spatial transcriptomics with SCATTER
items.title_zh: 用 SCATTER 解析空间转录组学中的细胞状态
items.abstract_en: A capture spot can contain transcripts from multiple cell types. Differences between spots may reflect changes in cell-type proportions, expression within a cell type, or both, making local cell-type expression difficult to infer from mixed counts. We developed SCATTER to estimate cell-type proportions and relative expression profiles for each cell type at each spot from spatial transcriptomic counts, coordinates, and annotated single-cell reference data. SCATTER weights reference cell profiles using local spatial context, then jointly fits the resulting profiles and cell-type proportions to reconstruct spot counts. Cell2location estimates regularize the proportions. After fitting, SCATTER uses learned gene-specific calibration factors and fitted proportions to allocate observed counts among cell types. In five pseudo-spot benchmarks constructed from imaging data, SCATTER achieved higher cross-spot correlations with measured expression for 82.8-99.8% of evaluated gene-cell type pairs in pairwise comparisons with DestVI, PANDA, and STged. In breast cancer Xenium data, it recovered gene expression associated with the tumor neighborhood and regulon scores. In breast cancer Visium data, inferred stromal and macrophage expression showed distinct associations with neighborhood malignant cell proportions. In multiple sclerosis brain tissue, SCATTER recovered lesion-associated glial expression programs. In colorectal cancer Visium HD data, it mapped cell-type-specific programs at the invasive front and ranked candidate ligand-receptor pairs. SCATTER enables analysis of spatial expression variation within cell types from mixed tissue measurements.
items.abstract_zh: 一个捕获点可包含来自多种细胞类型的转录本。点间差异可能反映细胞类型比例的变化、某一细胞类型内的表达变化，或二者兼有，使得从混合计数推断局部细胞类型表达变得困难。我们开发了 SCATTER，从空间转录组计数、坐标和带注释的单细胞参考数据中估计每个点的细胞类型比例以及每种细胞类型的相对表达谱。SCATTER 使用局部空间上下文对参考细胞谱加权，然后联合拟合所得谱和细胞类型比例以重建点计数。Cell2location 估计对比例进行正则化。拟合后，SCATTER 使用学习到的基因特异性校准因子和拟合比例，将观测计数分配给各细胞类型。在由成像数据构建的五个伪点基准中，与 DestVI、PANDA 和 STged 的两两比较中，SCATTER 在 82.8–99.8% 的受评估基因-细胞类型对上，与测量表达的跨点相关性更高。在乳腺癌 Xenium 数据中，它恢复了与肿瘤邻域和调控子评分相关的基因表达。在乳腺癌 Visium 数据中，推断的基质细胞和巨噬细胞表达与邻域恶性细胞比例显示出不同的关联。在多发性硬化脑组织中，SCATTER 恢复了与病变相关的胶质表达程序。在结直肠癌 Visium HD 数据中，它映射了浸润前沿的细胞类型特异性程序，并对候选配体-受体对进行了排序。SCATTER 能够从混合组织测量中分析细胞类型内的空间表达变异。

items.title_en: The other side of the saturation coin: an experiment to perform saturation of fluorescence spectroscopy in undergraduate laboratories
items.title_zh: 饱和的另一面：在本科实验室中开展荧光光谱饱和实验
items.abstract_en: This article presents an experimental study of saturation and hyperfine pumping effects observed in fluorescence spectra when two counter-propagating beams of light interact with an atomic vapor sample. The experiment focuses on the D2 transition of atomic 87Rb by measuring changes in fluorescence emission as a room-temperature cell is exposed to two counter propagating laser beams of nearly equal intensity. The setup is comparable in complexity to saturated absorption spectroscopy experiments commonly conducted in many undergraduate laboratories but offers the advantage of a complementary view of the atom-light interaction not often found in educational laboratories. The basic theory that is needed to interpret the spectra is also presented. First, an analysis of the timescales involved in these experiments is used to identify and discriminate between different physical processes that take place during the spectroscopic measurements, thus establishing the validity of a simple model based on Einstein's population equations. The solution of these equations is then used to calculate population surfaces that illustrate velocity-selection effects, providing an intuitive explanation of the origin of crossover and atomic resonances and the distinction between them. Both the experimental and theoretical components of this work are aimed at providing students with a thorough understanding of the interaction between electromagnetic radiation and an atomic vapor. Students with prior knowledge of laser optics, basic analog electronics, systems of coupled algebraic equations, introductory quantum mechanics, and basic atomic and statistical physics will be particularly well positioned to benefit from this presentation.
items.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一项实验研究，观察当两束反向传播的光与原子蒸气样品相互作用时，在荧光光谱中观察到的饱和与超精细泵浦效应。实验聚焦于原子87Rb的D2跃迁，通过测量室温样品池暴露于两束强度接近相等的反向传播激光束时荧光发射的变化。该装置的复杂度与许多本科实验室常进行的饱和吸收光谱实验相当，但具有提供教学实验室中不常见的原子-光相互作用互补视角的优势。文中还介绍了解释光谱所需的基本理论。首先，通过分析这些实验中涉及的时间尺度，识别并区分光谱测量期间发生的不同物理过程，从而确立基于爱因斯坦粒子数方程的简单模型的有效性。然后，利用这些方程的解计算展示速度选择效应的粒子数曲面，为交叉共振和原子共振的起源及二者区别提供直观解释。本工作的实验和理论部分均旨在使学生全面理解电磁辐射与原子蒸气之间的相互作用。具备激光光学、基础模拟电子学、耦合代数方程组、入门量子力学以及基础原子与统计物理知识的学生将尤其适合从本介绍中获益。

items.title_en: RHOPE: LLM-Augmented Adaptive Experimental Design with Complex Contextual Information
items.title_zh: RHOPE：具有复杂上下文信息的 LLM 增强自适应实验设计
items.abstract_en: Experimental design allocates limited measurement effort across candidate treatments to learn their expected outcomes. Adaptive designs refine allocations as evidence accumulates, improving estimation and treatment selection. Contextual information can inform these decisions, but exploiting unstructured or high-dimensional context remains challenging. We use large language models (LLMs) to transform complex context into proxy outcomes and propose Residual Horizon Optimization for Prediction-Powered Experimentation (RHOPE), a principled Bayesian adaptive experimentation framework that combines true outcomes with LLM-generated proxy outcomes and formulates finite-batch design as a posterior Markov decision process (MDP). Our methodology uses proxy outcomes in two ways: sample augmentation improves estimation precision, while observing proxies before each allocation decision provides advance information. Synthetic experiments and semi-synthetic experiments using Genomics of Drug Sensitivity in Cancer (GDSC) data suggest that estimation precision drives most gains, with smaller advance-information gains, and highlight the importance of proxy informativeness and moment-estimation accuracy.
items.abstract_zh: 实验设计将有限的测量精力分配到候选处理上，以学习其预期结果。自适应设计随着证据积累细化分配，改进估计和处理选择。上下文信息可为这些决策提供依据，但利用非结构化或高维上下文仍具挑战性。我们使用大语言模型（LLM）将复杂上下文转化为代理结果，并提出预测驱动实验的残差时域优化（RHOPE），这是一个有原则的贝叶斯自适应实验框架，它将真实结果与 LLM 生成的代理结果相结合，并将有限批次设计表述为后验马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）。我们的方法以两种方式使用代理结果：样本增强提高估计精度，而在每个分配决策前观察代理提供提前信息。合成实验和使用癌症药物敏感性基因组学（GDSC）数据的半合成实验表明，估计精度驱动了大部分增益，提前信息带来的增益较小，并凸显了代理信息量和矩估计准确性的重要性。

items.title_en: Mitigating Hallucinations in Medical Question Answering on ESC Cardiology Guidelines: Evaluation and Retrieval Optimization
items.title_zh: 缓解 ESC 心脏病学指南医学问答中的幻觉：评估与检索优化
items.abstract_en: Background: Large language models produce hallucinations in medical question answering (QA). Verify-and-revise pipelines that check atomic claims against retrieved guideline evidence are a standard mitigation, but evaluations almost universally treat the verifier's output as ground truth, an assumption rarely tested. Objective: To measure, claim by claim against human judgement, how such a pipeline fails in a guideline-grounded clinical setting. Methods: We built a dataset of 160 questions (100 patient vignettes from 89 de-identified cases, 60 fact-based) over four recent ESC cardiology guidelines, all approved by a practising internist, and a retrieval corpus of 627 hand-verified guideline records at two chunk granularities. A five-stage pipeline was run under four retrieval configurations and three independent runs (1920 arm-runs); all 606 first-pass refuted claims were manually audited, an independent judge re-judged 906 decisions, and the expert blindly reviewed 100 accepted claims. Results: Only 44.7-50.6% of flagged claims were true hallucinations. Correction loops converged in 85.2-95.1% of cases, yet 35% of genuine final errors were introduced by correction. Single-run true-hallucination recall was 35.6-41.2%, the three-run union 71-80%; verifier agreement was moderate (kappa = 0.505). The blind probe estimated the accepted-claim miss rate at 3.2% (95% CI 0.7-6.7%). Final genuine-error rate: 1.7% of answers. Conclusion: Claim-level verification reduces hallucinated content by an order of magnitude, but verifier reliability, not generation, is the limiting factor and must be measured, not assumed.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：大语言模型在医学问答（QA）中会产生幻觉。通过检索到的指南证据检查原子主张的验证-修正流程是一种标准缓解措施，但评估几乎普遍将验证器的输出视为真实标签，这一假设很少受到检验。目的：以人类判断为对照，逐条主张测量此类流程在以指南为依据的临床环境中如何失败。方法：我们构建了一个包含 160 个问题的数据集（100 个来自 89 个去标识化病例的患者简介，60 个基于事实的问题），覆盖四份近期 ESC 心脏病学指南，全部由一名执业内科医生审核；并构建了一个检索语料库，包含 627 条手工验证的指南记录，具有两种分块粒度。一个五阶段流程在四种检索配置和三次独立运行下运行（1920 次实验臂运行）；所有 606 条首轮被反驳的主张均经人工审核，一名独立评判者重新评判了 906 项决策，专家盲审了 100 条被接受的主张。结果：仅 44.7–50.6% 的被标记主张是真正的幻觉。修正循环在 85.2–95.1% 的案例中收敛，但 35% 的真实最终错误是由修正引入的。单次运行的真实幻觉召回率为 35.6–41.2%，三次运行的并集为 71–80%；验证器一致性为中等（kappa = 0.505）。盲法探测估计被接受主张的漏检率为 3.2%（95% CI 0.7–6.7%）。最终真实错误率：占答案的 1.7%。结论：主张级验证将幻觉内容减少一个数量级，但限制因素在于验证器可靠性而非生成，且必须测量而非假设。

items.title_en: FailPoint-X: A Policy-Matched, Failure-Anchored Benchmark for Offline VLA Post-Training from Human Takeovers
items.title_zh: FailPoint-X：一个策略匹配、以失败为锚点的基准，用于从人类接管进行离线VLA后训练
items.abstract_en: Human takeovers offer corrective supervision for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, but their contribution to offline post-training must be separated from that of continued optimization. We introduce FailPoint-X, a benchmark for offline VLA post-training with human takeovers. To represent uncertainty in failure onset, an annotator marks an interval for each failure, and training takeovers start at seeded frames sampled within it. From one fixed $π_{0.5}$ checkpoint, which also initializes post-training, we assemble 629 natural failures across 10 LIBERO-X task families at up to five difficulty levels. All 2,823 takeover attempts are logged; 2,400 are accepted recoveries, of which 2,320 are used for post-training. Evaluation restarts every method from the fixed midpoints of 384 held-out failure intervals. Under matched actor-update counts, we compare behavior cloning of recoveries, value-based offline learning on recoveries and failed rollouts, and continued training on existing demonstrations. Within 1,200 steps on the 240 L1-L3 held-out failures, cloning improves recovery by 29.4 percentage points (pp) over the demonstration-only control; the value-based learner does not establish a further gain (1.5 pp). In exploratory evaluation from L1-L5 nominal starts at the same horizon, cloning loses 30.0 pp of success relative to the base policy; mixing in demonstrations reduces the loss to 16.5 pp, a reduction that shrinks under a stricter, pre-specified horizon. Restorable failure states and a shared evaluator let all methods be compared from identical starts.
items.abstract_zh: 人类接管为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略提供纠正性监督，但其对离线后训练的贡献必须与持续优化带来的贡献区分开。我们提出 FailPoint-X，一个用于利用人类接管进行离线 VLA 后训练的基准。为表示失败起始时间的不确定性，标注者为每次失败标记一个区间，训练用接管从该区间内采样的种子帧开始。从一个固定的 $π_{0.5}$ 检查点（该检查点也用于初始化后训练）出发，我们汇集了 10 个 LIBERO-X 任务家族、最多五个难度级别下的 629 次自然失败。所有 2,823 次接管尝试均被记录；其中 2,400 次为被接受的恢复，2,320 次用于后训练。评估时，每种方法都从 384 个留出失败区间的固定中点重新开始。在匹配的 actor 更新次数下，我们比较对恢复轨迹的行为克隆、在恢复和失败 rollout 上的基于价值的离线学习，以及在现有演示上的持续训练。在 240 个 L1-L3 留出失败上、1,200 步内，克隆相对仅演示对照将恢复率提高 29.4 个百分点（pp）；基于价值的学习器未建立进一步增益（1.5 pp）。在相同时间范围下从 L1-L5 名义起点进行的探索性评估中，克隆相对基础策略损失 30.0 pp 的成功率；混入演示将该损失降至 16.5 pp，而在更严格的预先指定时间范围下该降低幅度会缩小。可恢复的失败状态和共享评估器使所有方法都能从相同起点进行比较。

items.title_en: Fewer Fractions, Equieffective Plans: An optimization framework based on equieffective dose
items.title_zh: 更少分次、等效计划：一种基于等效剂量的优化框架
items.abstract_en: Background: Non-standard fractionation requires caution before clinical use, and planners often need to manually modify the prescription and dose constraints for non-linear biological effects. Purpose: To develop an extension within a treatment planning system that enables the generation of hypofractionated plans based on equieffective dose, $EQD_{n_{ref}}$, for an alternative fractionation deliverable in $n$ fractions, such that it is equieffective with the reference fractionation for a specified biological endpoint. Methods: A research build of RayStation v2025 was extended to optimize $EQD_{n_{ref}}$ plans. This study used anonymized data from three head and neck patients. $\text{CTV}_p$ and $\text{CTV}_n$ were prescribed 70 Gy and 54 Gy in 35 fractions. Targets, spinal cord, and brainstem were robustly optimized for $\pm3.5$% density and $\pm3.0$ mm setup uncertainties. For each patient, hypofractionated plans were created with 34, 32, 30, and 25 fractions. Sensitivity analysis evaluated the impact of $α/β$ uncertainty. Results: All equieffective hypofractionated plans maintained target coverage and met mandatory clinical goals for organs-at-risk (OARs). Compared to standard fractionation, DVH parameters indicated an average $ΔEQD_{n_{ref}}$ <0.2 Gy for $\text{CTV}_p$ and no difference for $\text{CTV}_n$. For parallel OARs, the median mean-dose difference between hypofractionation (to 30 fractions) and standard fractionation was generally <1% of the prescribed dose. $α/β$ uncertainty produced the greatest variation in the 25-fraction regimen, with absolute $ΔEQD_{n_{ref}}$ up to 0.88 Gy for targets and up to 0.63 Gy for the spinal cord and brainstem. Conclusions: An $EQD_{n_{ref}}$-based framework can generate equieffective hypofractionated plans, making it feasible to reduce fractions without substantially deviating from existing clinical protocols.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：非标准分次在临床使用前需要谨慎，计划设计者通常需要手动修改处方和剂量约束，以应对非线性生物效应。目的：在治疗计划系统内开发一个扩展，使其能够基于等效剂量 $EQD_{n_{ref}}$ 生成大分次计划，该计划针对可在 $n$ 次分次中实施的可替代分次方案，并在指定生物终点上与参考分次等效。方法：将 RayStation v2025 的研究版本扩展用于优化 $EQD_{n_{ref}}$ 计划。本研究使用三名头颈部患者的匿名数据。$\text{CTV}_p$ 和 $\text{CTV}_n$ 的处方分别为 70 Gy 和 54 Gy，分 35 次。靶区、脊髓和脑干针对 $\pm3.5$% 密度不确定性和 $\pm3.0$ mm 摆位不确定性进行稳健优化。对每位患者，创建 34、32、30 和 25 次分次的大分次计划。敏感性分析评估了 $α/β$ 不确定性的影响。结果：所有等效大分次计划均维持靶区覆盖，并满足危及器官（OAR）的强制性临床目标。与标准分次相比，DVH 参数显示 $\text{CTV}_p$ 的平均 $ΔEQD_{n_{ref}}$ <0.2 Gy，$\text{CTV}_n$ 无差异。对于并联 OAR，大分次（至 30 次）与标准分次之间的平均剂量差异中位数一般 <处方剂量的 1%。$α/β$ 不确定性在 25 次方案中产生最大变化，靶区的绝对 $ΔEQD_{n_{ref}}$ 最高达 0.88 Gy，脊髓和脑干最高达 0.63 Gy。结论：基于 $EQD_{n_{ref}}$ 的框架可以生成等效大分次计划，使得在不显著偏离现有临床方案的情况下减少分次数成为可行。

items.title_en: Stochastic Failure Dynamics in a Model Peptidoglycan Mesh under Hydrolysis and Mechanical Loading
items.title_zh: 水解和机械载荷下模型肽聚糖网架的随机失效动力学
items.abstract_en: We develop a minimal stochastic-mechanical model for failure dynamics of the Gram-negative peptidoglycan (PG) cell wall under blocked growth and continued hydrolysis. The cell wall is modelled as a collection of load-bearing cross-sections, with random number of cross-links in each such cross-section, around a fixed degree of cross-linking. To understand failure dynamics of the cell wall under antibacterial agents which prevent insertion of fresh PG material, peptide bonds are progressively excised by hydrolases, while insertion/formation of new bonds is blocked. We compare and contrast rupture dynamics in no-load and load-activated regimes, using extreme value theory and stochastic simulations, deriving limiting laws for system failure in both the long-cell and large crosslinking limits. For a cross-section with many bonds, the mean failure time grows only log- arithmically with bond number, giving diminishing returns from additional cross-linking. In the no-load case, the centered failure time converges to a Gumbel law, though crucially, load changes the centered distribution and accelerates the final stages of collapse. In long cells, failure follows a weakest-link Weibull-type scaling controlled by the least cross-linked regions, with mechanical load reducing the failure-time scale without changing the weakest-link exponent. The fraction of bonds removed before failure tends to zero, showing that collapse can remain highly localized even while the global cross-linking degree stays high. Slowing down growth and other cellular functions is a typical antibiotic escape mechanism for bacteria and in this context, we show that, hydrolase down-regulation uniformly rescales the failure-time distribution and delays collapse, but does not remove the load-induced preference for rupture in weakened regions.
items.abstract_zh: 我们建立一个最小随机-力学模型，用于描述革兰氏阴性肽聚糖（PG）细胞壁在生长受阻且水解持续进行时的失效动力学。细胞壁被建模为承载截面的集合，每个此类截面中的交联数在固定交联度附近随机。为理解在阻止新鲜 PG 材料插入的抗菌剂作用下细胞壁的失效动力学，肽键被水解酶逐步切除，而新键的插入/形成被阻断。我们使用极值理论和随机模拟，比较并对照无载荷与载荷激活两种情形下的破裂动力学，并推导长细胞极限和大交联极限下系统失效的极限规律。对于具有许多键的截面，平均失效时间仅随键数对数增长，因此额外交联带来递减回报。在无载荷情形下，中心化失效时间收敛到 Gumbel 律，但关键的是，载荷会改变中心化分布并加速最终坍塌阶段。在长细胞中，失效遵循由交联最少区域控制的最弱链 Weibull 型标度，机械载荷降低失效时间尺度但不改变最弱链指数。失效前被移除的键比例趋于零，表明即使全局交联度仍然很高，坍塌也可以保持高度局域化。减缓生长和其他细胞功能是细菌典型的抗生素逃逸机制；在此背景下，我们表明水解酶下调会均匀重标度失效时间分布并延迟坍塌，但不会消除载荷诱导的、在弱化区域发生破裂的偏好。

items.title_en: Anatomy of orbital and spin responses in GaAs and Si: Hall, inverse Faraday, and magneto-optical Kerr effects
items.title_zh: GaAs 和 Si 中轨道与自旋响应的剖析：霍尔、逆法拉第和磁光克尔效应
items.abstract_en: Magneto-optical signals in nonmagnetic semiconductors entangle spin and orbital contributions, both in angular-momentum generation and magneto-optical detection. We calculate these contributions for electron-doped GaAs and Si using density-functional theory, linear-response theory, and a second-order density-matrix treatment of the inverse Faraday effect. At small electron doping, the intrinsic orbital Hall conductivity exceeds its spin counterpart in magnitude, while the orbital contribution to light-induced magnetization dominates over broad photon-energy ranges. We show that orbital- and spin-resolved optical Hall and polar Kerr coefficients exhibit stronger sensitivity to orbital moments than to equal spin moments. This contrast reflects direct electric-dipole coupling to orbital motion versus spin-orbit-mediated coupling to spin polarization. Consequently, Si maintains a substantial orbital magneto-optical response despite its weak spin-orbit interaction. At probe energies of 1.5 eV in GaAs and 3.0 eV in Si, the magnitude of the Kerr rotation per unit orbital moment is approximately 5 and 13 times larger than that per unit spin moment, respectively. Combining the calculated Hall conductivities and Kerr coefficients with a phenomenological drift-diffusion model yields predominantly orbital edge signals for the assumed diffusion constants and relaxation lengths. These results indicate that optical detection of induced magnetization in doped semiconductors such as GaAs and Si can be dominated by orbital signals, and therefore cannot be interpreted solely in terms of spin polarization.
items.abstract_zh: 非磁性半导体中的磁光信号在角动量产生和磁光检测中都会使自旋和轨道贡献相互纠缠。我们使用密度泛函理论、线性响应理论以及逆法拉第效应的二阶密度矩阵处理，计算了电子掺杂 GaAs 和 Si 中的这些贡献。在小电子掺杂下，本征轨道霍尔电导率在幅度上超过其自旋对应量，而光致磁化中的轨道贡献在较宽光子能量范围内占主导。我们表明，轨道分辨和自旋分辨的光学霍尔系数与极向克尔系数对轨道矩的敏感性比对等量自旋矩更强。这种对比反映了电偶极直接耦合到轨道运动，而自旋极化则通过自旋-轨道介导的耦合。因此，尽管 Si 的自旋-轨道相互作用较弱，它仍保持可观的轨道磁光响应。在 GaAs 的 1.5 eV 和 Si 的 3.0 eV 探测能量下，单位轨道矩的克尔旋转幅度分别约为单位自旋矩的 5 倍和 13 倍。将计算得到的霍尔电导率和克尔系数与唯象漂移-扩散模型结合，在假设的扩散常数和弛豫长度下主要得到轨道边缘信号。这些结果表明，在 GaAs 和 Si 等掺杂半导体中，对诱导磁化的光学检测可能由轨道信号主导，因此不能仅用自旋极化来解释。

items.title_en: Fractal Neural Synthesis: Constant-Storage Procedural Weight Derivation via Complex Quadratic Boundary Dynamics
items.title_zh: 分形神经合成：通过复二次边界动力学的恒定存储过程式权重推导
items.abstract_en: Conventional neural networks store synaptic parameters as explicit tensors whose persistent Flash footprint scales linearly (O(W)) with parameter count, constraining resource-limited edge microcontrollers. We formulate and systematically evaluate Fractal Neural Synthesis (FNS), a procedural weight derivation architecture that replaces hidden-layer matrices with a constant 24-byte coordinate seed Theta = (c_x, c_y, ell) in F_64^3 anchored near the complex quadratic bifurcation boundary dM of f_c(z) = z^2 + c. We introduce a large-bailout (R = 256) smooth escape kernel, four zero-overhead geometric sampling apertures--Cartesian Grid, coprime 3x3 Rule-of-Thirds (Z/9Z), phi-Vogel spiral, and multi-scale Harmonic Tripod--and prove conditional Kolmogorov (K_Kolm <= 192 + c_0 bits) and Shannon entropy bounds. Across magnifications zeta in [10^0, 10^8], C^1 Fourier and lattice-noise bases collapse to post-standardization rank ~2.25 and SHA-256 PRNG exhibits avalanche discontinuity (rho ~ 0.019, 50.6% micro-step retention), whereas dM uniquely sustains both rank (~10.0) and local continuity (rho in [0.81, 0.97], 89.2% retention). Under leak-free 10-fold CV across four zero-scaler-byte non-linear benchmarks, FNS with an INT8 readout surpasses 0-hidden Linear-INT8 by +3.6 to +10.8 pp while delivering 10.7x-129x total Flash reduction (725x-2,773x hidden reduction) relative to converged Float32 MLPs (90.30% Ionosphere in 285 B; 97.22% Optical Digits in 2,598 B; 97.90% PenDigits in 2,598 B; 87.00% Satimage in 1,570 B).
items.abstract_zh: 传统神经网络将突触参数存储为显式张量，其持久 Flash 占用随参数数量线性增长（O(W)），限制了资源受限的边缘微控制器。我们提出并系统评估分形神经合成（FNS），一种过程式权重推导架构，用位于 F_64^3 中、锚定在 f_c(z) = z^2 + c 的复二次分岔边界 dM 附近的恒定 24 字节坐标种子 Theta = (c_x, c_y, ell) 替代隐藏层矩阵。我们引入大逃逸半径（R = 256）的平滑逃逸核、四种零开销几何采样孔径——笛卡尔网格、互质 3x3 三分法（Z/9Z）、phi-Vogel 螺旋和多尺度 Harmonic Tripod——并证明条件 Kolmogorov 界（K_Kolm <= 192 + c_0 比特）和 Shannon 熵界。在放大倍数 zeta 属于 [10^0, 10^8] 范围内，C^1 Fourier 和晶格噪声基坍缩到标准化后秩约 2.25，SHA-256 PRNG 表现出雪崩不连续性（rho 约 0.019，微步保留率 50.6%），而 dM 独特地同时维持秩（约 10.0）和局部连续性（rho 在 [0.81, 0.97]，保留率 89.2%）。在四个 zero-scaler-byte 非线性基准上进行无泄漏 10 折交叉验证，带有 INT8 读出层的 FNS 比 0 隐藏层 Linear-INT8 高出 +3.6 至 +10.8 个百分点，同时相对于收敛的 Float32 MLP 实现 10.7 倍至 129 倍的总 Flash 减少（隐藏层减少 725 倍至 2,773 倍）（Ionosphere 90.30%，285 B；Optical Digits 97.22%，2,598 B；PenDigits 97.90%，2,598 B；Satimage 87.00%，1,570 B）。

items.title_en: Learning from Unreliable Operator References: Claim-Level Rewards for Customer Support Agents
items.title_zh: 从不可靠的人工坐席参考中学习：面向客户支持智能体的声明级奖励
items.abstract_en: Even a correct operator reply can be an unreliable training target for a customer-support agent. About a quarter of the factual claims in these replies lacked full support in the agent's knowledge base and tool records. We treat operator replies as claims to verify rather than answers to imitate. Unverified claims guide revisions to the knowledge base and tools. Verified claims serve as coverage targets in a claim-level GRPO reward that scores factual precision against the evidence the agent retrieved for its answer. On an offline benchmark, 8.6% of the GRPO agent's text answers were flagged for hallucinations, compared with 13.6% for the supervised fine-tuning baseline. In a randomized A/B test against the existing procedural bot, the deployed system increased the share of conversations closed without a human operator from 63.3% to 80.8%.
items.abstract_zh: 即使是正确的人工坐席回复，也可能成为客户支持智能体的不可靠训练目标。在这些回复中，约四分之一的事实性声明在其知识库和工具记录中缺乏充分支持。我们将人工坐席回复视为需要核验的声明，而非要模仿的答案。未核验声明用于指导知识库和工具的修订。已核验声明作为声明级 GRPO 奖励中的覆盖目标，该奖励根据智能体为其答案检索到的证据来评分事实精确度。在一个离线基准上，GRPO 智能体有 8.6% 的文本答案因幻觉被标记，而监督微调基线为 13.6%。在与现有流程机器人进行的随机 A/B 测试中，部署系统将无需人工坐席即可关闭的对话占比从 63.3% 提高到 80.8%。

items.title_en: Model Predictive Control of a Multirotor UAV with a Cable-Suspended Payload: A Comparison of Shifted and Transformer-Based Warm Starts
items.title_zh: 缆索悬挂载荷多旋翼无人机的模型预测控制：移位式与基于Transformer的热启动比较
items.abstract_en: This study investigates model predictive control (MPC) of a multirotor drone (unmanned aerial vehicle, UAV) carrying a cable-suspended payload, comparing conventional shifted initialization with Transformer-based warm starting of a sequential convex programming (SCP) optimizer. The controller uses a coupled mechanical model with an elastic cable and a double-pendulum representation of the suspended load. Its formulation includes move-blocked control inputs, finite-difference sensitivities, constrained quadratic subproblems, and input-feasibility projection. A Transformer trained on expert SCP solutions predicts an initial control sequence, which is subsequently refined by the same optimizer used for the conventional methods. Numerical experiments compare zero, shifted, and Transformer initialization under identical controller settings. For independently solved MPC problems, Transformer initialization reduces computation time relative to zero initialization. In sequential closed-loop simulations, however, shifting the preceding optimized control sequence provides the lowest computation time, while all three methods produce similar tracking behavior. These findings emphasize the importance of comparing learned warm starts with conventional initialization methods that reuse previous MPC solutions. The measured optimization times exceed the control sampling period; consequently, real-time implementation is not demonstrated. Keywords: Model predictive control; sequential convex programming; Transformer; warm start; cable-suspended payload; multirotor drone.
items.abstract_zh: 本研究研究携带缆索悬挂载荷的多旋翼无人机（unmanned aerial vehicle, UAV）的模型预测控制（MPC），比较传统移位初始化与基于 Transformer 的热启动对序列凸规划（SCP）优化器的影响。控制器使用包含弹性缆索以及悬挂载荷双摆表示的耦合力学模型。其表述包括移动分块控制输入、有限差分灵敏度、约束二次子问题以及输入可行性投影。一个在专家 SCP 解上训练的 Transformer 预测初始控制序列，随后由与传统方法相同的优化器进行细化。数值实验在相同控制器设置下比较零初始化、移位初始化和 Transformer 初始化。对于独立求解的 MPC 问题，Transformer 初始化相对于零初始化减少计算时间。然而，在序贯闭环仿真中，移位前一个已优化控制序列提供最低计算时间，而三种方法产生相似的跟踪行为。这些发现强调，将学习到的热启动与重用先前 MPC 解的传统初始化方法进行比较很重要。测得的优化时间超过控制采样周期；因此，未展示实时实现。关键词：模型预测控制；序列凸规划；Transformer；热启动；缆索悬挂载荷；多旋翼无人机。

items.title_en: GeoCAM: Self-Supervised Sonar-Optical Representation Learning via Geographic Overlap Supervision
items.title_zh: GeoCAM：通过地理重叠监督的自监督声呐-光学表征学习
items.abstract_en: Cross-modal self-supervised learning for paired side-scan sonar and underwater optical imagery is a promising direction for benthic habitat understanding, but it remains underexplored because existing methods do not fully exploit the one-to-many correspondences and geographic metadata available in real opti-acoustic surveys. This limits the ability to learn representations that are both semantically meaningful and geometrically consistent from abundant unlabeled marine data. To address this problem, we present GeoCAM, a geography-guided framework that learns a shared embedding space for sonar tiles and their associated optical views without semantic annotations. GeoCAM achieves its goal by combining three components: (i) a Set Attention Aggregator that adaptively summarizes multiple optical observations into a single tile-level representation; (ii) a geometry-weighted InfoNCE objective that converts GPS-derived footprint overlap into soft positive supervision; and (iii) an optional cross-modal masked reconstruction branch that encourages physically grounded cross-modal alignment. Experiments on the BenthiCat SSS-CAM dataset show that GeoCAM can be effectively exploited to learn which sonar and camera samples describe the same seabed patch, improving cross-modal retrieval and alignment over strong contrastive baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/FadiZidiDz/GeoCAM.
items.abstract_zh: 配对侧扫声呐与水下光学影像的跨模态自监督学习是底栖栖息地理解的一个有前景方向，但由于现有方法未充分利用真实光学-声学调查中可用的一对多对应关系和地理元数据，该方向仍探索不足。这限制了从大量未标注海洋数据中学习既具语义意义又具几何一致性的表征的能力。为解决这个问题，我们提出 GeoCAM，一个地理引导框架，可在无需语义标注的情况下为声呐瓦片及其关联光学视图学习共享嵌入空间。GeoCAM 通过组合三个组件实现其目标：(i) 集合注意力聚合器，将多个光学观测自适应汇总为单个瓦片级表示；(ii) 几何加权 InfoNCE 目标，将 GPS 推导的覆盖范围重叠转换为软正监督；(iii) 可选的跨模态掩码重建分支，鼓励物理上合理的跨模态对齐。在 BenthiCat SSS-CAM 数据集上的实验表明，GeoCAM 可被有效用于学习哪些声呐和相机样本描述同一海底斑块，相比强对比基线改进了跨模态检索和对齐。代码见 https://github.com/FadiZidiDz/GeoCAM。

items.title_en: Did the Model Forecast It, or Already Know It? Evaluating Large Language Models for Novel Drug-Target Prioritisation with a Temporal Knowledge-Graph Oracle
items.title_zh: 模型是预测了它，还是早已知道它？使用时间知识图谱预言机评估大语言模型用于新药靶点优先级排序
items.abstract_en: AI systems increasingly help decide which drug targets enter costly clinical trials. We recast each target-disease hypothesis as a dated event, the pair's first clinical trial. This lets us test whether a language model can forecast such events after its training cutoff, rather than recall events before it. We rebuild a dated biomedical knowledge graph as it stood at the end of each year from 2020 up to its newest version. We then ask six open language models, with and without this graph, which targets will enter a first trial for a disease the next year. Without retrieval, the models rank about as well as trial history, a count of each target's past trials in the same therapeutic area, also after their training cutoffs. Evidence dated before the decision adds at most a small gain, before or after the models' training cutoffs. The newest graph raises five of six models clearly above that baseline, but its paths usually include the answer: the pair's own trial, dated after the decision. Evaluations of target prioritisation should date both features and labels, with evidence from before the decision and outcomes after it.
items.abstract_zh: AI 系统越来越多地帮助决定哪些药物靶点进入昂贵的临床试验。我们将每个靶点-疾病假设重新表述为一个带日期的事件，即该配对的首个临床试验。这使我们能够检验语言模型能否在其训练截止时间之后预测此类事件，而不是回忆其之前的事件。我们重建了一个带日期的生物医学知识图谱，使其分别呈现为从 2020 年到其最新版本之间每一年的年末状态。然后，我们询问六个开放语言模型，在有和没有该图谱的情况下，预测下一年哪些靶点将进入针对某一疾病的首个试验。在没有检索的情况下，这些模型的排序表现与试验历史基线大致相当；该基线是每个靶点在同一治疗领域中既往试验数量的计数，且同样在其训练截止时间之后。在模型训练截止时间之前或之后，日期早于决策的证据最多只带来小幅增益。最新图谱使六个模型中的五个明显高于该基线，但其路径通常包含答案：该配对自身的试验，且日期在决策之后。靶点优先级排序的评估应对特征和标签都标注日期，使用决策之前的证据和决策之后的结果。

items.title_en: Domain advantage in two-dimensional quantum-device design with multi-modal agentic harness
items.title_zh: 多模态智能体框架在二维量子器件设计中的领域优势
items.abstract_en: High-quality two-dimensional quantum devices are commonly fabricated from mechanically exfoliated crystals, whose irregular shapes and placement require a lithographic layout tailored to each specimen. Drawing these layouts remains largely manual. We introduce qlaybench, a benchmark that tests whether language-model agents can turn microscope images and experimental requirements into device layouts that fit the specimen. Agents with conventional tools often construct devices when material outlines are supplied, but struggle to identify those outlines from images. Modelled on the human workflow, qlaybot, a multimodal agentic harness, connects image interpretation to the tools used to align images, draw device features and inspect the resulting layout. We evaluate each layout with checks drawn from practical design experience, asking whether it fits the specimen and connects its intended components. With greater computational effort, an agent using qlaybot passes 81.5% of the benchmark tasks, compared with 24.1% when it uses conventional tools. This domain advantage highlights the importance of connecting scientific interpretation of a specimen to geometric design and provides a route towards reducing manual effort in two-dimensional quantum-device fabrication.
items.abstract_zh: 高质量二维量子器件通常由机械剥离晶体制备，其不规则形状和放置位置要求为每个样品定制光刻版图。绘制这些版图在很大程度上仍依赖人工。我们提出 qlaybench，一个基准，用于测试语言模型智能体能否将显微镜图像和实验要求转化为适合样品的器件版图。使用传统工具的智能体在提供材料轮廓时通常能构建设计器件，但难以从图像中识别这些轮廓。qlaybot 是一个多模态智能体框架，仿照人类工作流程，将图像解读与用于对齐图像、绘制器件特征和检查所得版图的工具连接起来。我们使用源自实际设计经验的检查项评估每个版图，询问其是否适合样品并连接其预期组件。在更大的计算投入下，使用 qlaybot 的智能体通过了 81.5% 的基准任务，而使用传统工具时为 24.1%。这种领域优势凸显了将样品的科学解读与几何设计相连接的重要性，并提供了一条减少二维量子器件制造中人工工作量的途径。

items.title_en: A gene informed benchmark for BioScoring of pathology foundation models
items.title_zh: 用于病理基础模型 BioScoring 的基因信息基准
items.abstract_en: Pathology foundation models are usually compared by their performance on downstream tasks such as classification and retrieval. While such benchmarks measure how useful a model is, they provide no insight into the biology it represents. We introduce BioScore, a benchmark that quantifies how well an image encoder captures cell identities, with spatial transcriptomics of the same tissue as the reference. A sparse autoencoder splits the encoder's patch embeddings into sparse features, which we cluster into a fixed number of groups. BioScore then measures, for each of 52 cell identities defined by marker genes, how specifically one group follows the identity's expression over the tissue. Because the autoencoder training is fully unsupervised, a match shows that the model represents the cell identity from the image alone. We score 8 pathology foundation models and 3 natural-image models. Every pathology model scores above every natural-image model (0.299--0.371 \vs 0.214--0.232), and paired tests separate three tiers among the pathology models. Unlike a supervised probe, BioScore needs no labels, builds its reference from the data and scores even from few sections, yet it ranks the encoders as a probe does. Its per-identity breakdown indicates which cell identities each encoder captures or misses.
items.abstract_zh: 病理基础模型通常通过其在分类和检索等下游任务上的性能进行比较。虽然此类基准衡量模型有多大用处，但它们无法揭示模型所表征的生物学。我们提出 BioScore，这是一个量化图像编码器捕获细胞身份能力的基准，并以同一组织的空间转录组学作为参考。稀疏自编码器将编码器的图像块嵌入拆分为稀疏特征，我们将其聚类为固定数量的组。随后，BioScore 针对由标记基因定义的 52 种细胞身份中的每一种，衡量某一组在组织范围内跟随该身份表达的特异性有多高。由于自编码器训练完全无监督，匹配表明模型仅从图像就表征了该细胞身份。我们对 8 个病理基础模型和 3 个自然图像模型进行评分。每个病理模型都高于每个自然图像模型（0.299–0.371 对 0.214–0.232），配对检验将病理模型分为三个层级。与监督探针不同，BioScore 不需要标签，从数据构建参考，甚至可基于少量切片评分，但其对编码器的排序与探针一致。其按细胞身份的分项结果指示每个编码器捕获或遗漏了哪些细胞身份。

items.title_en: PINN-Slicer: Exploiting Rotational Symmetry to Solve the Photon Orbit Equation Around a Black Hole
items.title_zh: PINN-Slicer：利用旋转对称性求解黑洞周围的光子轨道方程
items.abstract_en: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) typically struggle with long-horizon domains, often requiring the network to be retrained as the domain grows. We present PINN-Slicer, a method for second-order autonomous ordinary differential equations, $\ddot{u} = G(u, \dot{u})$, which exploits the invariance of this class of equations under translations of the independent variable. A single PINN, embedded within a solution ansatz that enforces the initial conditions explicitly, is trained on a thin slice of the independent variable using Sobol-sampled initial conditions. The PINN is then deployed recursively, slice-by-slice, across the full domain. We demonstrate PINN-Slicer on the nonlinear equation that describes photon orbits around a black hole, and reach a point-by-point root-mean-square error (RMSE) below $10^{-3}$ in $u = r_s/r$ (the inverse radial coordinate in units of the Schwarzschild radius) relative to a finite-difference reference solution. A key advantage of PINN-Slicer is that a single trained network generalizes to any orbital initial condition within the training range, without retraining. In addition, PINN-Slicer can cope with solution domains that may not be known a priori.
items.abstract_zh: 物理信息神经网络（PINN）通常难以处理长时程域，往往需要随着域增长而重新训练网络。我们提出 PINN-Slicer，这是一种用于二阶自治常微分方程 $\ddot{u} = G(u, \dot{u})$ 的方法，它利用该类方程在自变量平移下的不变性。单个 PINN 被嵌入一个显式施加初始条件的解拟设中，并使用 Sobol 采样的初始条件，在自变量的一个薄切片上训练。随后，该 PINN 以逐切片方式递归部署到整个域。我们在描述黑洞周围光子轨道的非线性方程上演示了 PINN-Slicer，相对于有限差分参考解，在 $u = r_s/r$（以史瓦西半径为单位的径向坐标倒数）上达到逐点均方根误差（RMSE）低于 $10^{-3}$。PINN-Slicer 的一个关键优势是，单个已训练网络无需重新训练即可泛化到训练范围内的任意轨道初始条件。此外，PINN-Slicer 能够处理可能无法先验已知的解域。

items.title_en: MRCT: An Object-Centric Two-Layer Control Architecture for Heavy-Payload Multi-Robot Transportation
items.title_zh: MRCT：一种面向重载多机器人运输的以物体为中心的两层控制架构
items.abstract_en: Cooperative transportation of heavy payloads by heterogeneous mobile manipulators requires coordinated payload motion, force distribution, and compliant physical interaction. This paper presents MRCT, an object-centric two-layer control architecture for multi-robot transportation. At the object level, a model predictive controller (MPC) generates a coordinated contact-force reference for the payload. At the robot level, whole- body impedance control (WBIC) modules on individual robots realise the reference through a confidence-based blending of velocity-tracking and impedance torques. The blending mechanism emphasises tracking when the joint-velocity error is small and increases compliance when tracking degrades because of abrupt reference changes or physical disturbances. Simulation and hardware experiments with a heterogeneous team comprising a single-arm and a dual-arm mobile manipulator transporting a near-rated table payload demonstrate accurate object tracking, regulated contact forces, and stable payload orientation. Parameter sensitivity studies, obstacle-avoidance transportation, and step-load disturbance experiments further demonstrate the effectiveness of MRCT for reliable cooperative transportation under the evaluated conditions
items.abstract_zh: 由异构移动操作机器人协同运输重载有效载荷，需要协调的有效载荷运动、力分配和柔顺的物理交互。本文提出 MRCT，一种以物体为中心的多机器人运输两层控制架构。在物体层，模型预测控制器（MPC）为有效载荷生成协调的接触力参考。在机器人层，各机器人上的全身阻抗控制（WBIC）模块通过基于置信度的速度跟踪力矩与阻抗力矩混合来实现该参考。该混合机制在关节速度误差较小时强调跟踪，而在因参考突变或物理扰动导致跟踪退化时增加柔顺性。使用由单臂和双臂移动操作机器人组成的异构团队运输接近额定负载的桌子有效载荷的仿真与硬件实验，展示了准确的对象跟踪、受调控的接触力以及稳定的有效载荷姿态。参数敏感性研究、避障运输和阶跃负载扰动实验进一步证明了 MRCT 在所评估条件下用于可靠协同运输的有效性。

items.title_en: TAT-Det: A Dataset for Testicular Appendage Torsion Detection and Segmentation in Ultrasound Images
items.title_zh: TAT-Det：用于超声图像中睾丸附件扭转检测与分割的数据集
items.abstract_en: Background: Testicular appendage torsion (TAT) is the leading cause of acute scrotal pain in prepubertal children. Yet, its diagnosis remains challenging due to nonspecific clinical manifestations and the absence of standardized datasets for pediatric acute scrotal emergencies. Results: We present TAT-Det, an expert-annotated ultrasound dataset specifically designed for TAT. TAT-Det comprises 2,600 ultrasound images from 1,203 patients collected at the Children's Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine. Each TAT-positive image is accompanied by lesion-level bounding boxes for detection and pixel-level segmentation masks for fine-grained delineation. Annotations were produced through a multi-stage workflow involving independent annotation by board-certified pediatric sonographers, consensus review, and refinement. Baseline benchmarks for object detection and semantic segmentation using representative deep learning models are further provided, with YOLO11m achieving the best detection performance and RWKV-UNet the best segmentation performance. Conclusions: TAT-Det addresses the lack of publicly available resources for pediatric emergency ultrasound and establishes a foundation for developing and evaluating artificial intelligence methods for automated TAT analysis.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：睾丸附件扭转（TAT）是青春期前儿童急性阴囊疼痛的首要原因。然而，由于其临床表现缺乏特异性，且缺乏针对儿科急性阴囊急症的标准化数据集，其诊断仍然具有挑战性。结果：我们提出 TAT-Det，这是一个专门为 TAT 设计的专家标注超声数据集。TAT-Det 包含 2,600 幅超声图像，来自在浙江大学医学院附属儿童医院采集的 1,203 例患者。每幅 TAT 阳性图像均附有用于检测的病灶级边界框和用于细粒度勾画的像素级分割掩膜。标注通过多阶段工作流程产生，包括由委员会认证的儿科超声医师独立标注、共识审核和细化。进一步提供了使用代表性深度学习模型的目标检测和语义分割基线基准，其中 YOLO11m 取得最佳检测性能，RWKV-UNet 取得最佳分割性能。结论：TAT-Det 弥补了儿科急诊超声公开可用资源的缺乏，并为开发和评估用于自动化 TAT 分析的人工智能方法奠定了基础。

items.title_en: Quantum chaotic signature in non-empirical ensemble of DNA base pairs
items.title_zh: DNA 碱基对非经验系综中的量子混沌特征
items.abstract_en: The statistical study of many-body chaotic quantum systems would indicate important phenomena such as short-range level repulsion and long-range spectral rigidity. We investigate such behavior in an ensemble of gas-phase guanine-cytosine (GC) and adenine-thymine (AT) Watson-Crick (WC) base pairs by calculating their Kohn-Sham molecular orbital energy levels via ab initio density functional theory (DFT). We track the probability distribution, adjacent-gap ratios (AGR), number variance, and spectral compressibility of the unfolded level spacings to see whether their statistics follow the statistics of the eigenvalues of random matrices. After comparing the results to Poisson, semi-Poisson (SP), and Gaussian Orthogonal Ensemble (GOE) statistics, it becomes evident that the statistics of orbital energy levels agree closely with the semi-Poisson distribution, pointing to an intermediate regime between integrability and chaos, characterized by level repulsion and strong long-range correlations. Potential biophysical implications for charge transfer and related biological processes are also discussed.
items.abstract_zh: 对多体混沌量子系统的统计研究可揭示短程能级排斥和长程谱刚性等重要现象。我们通过从头算密度泛函理论（DFT）计算 Kohn-Sham 分子轨道能级，研究气相鸟嘌呤-胞嘧啶（GC）和腺嘌呤-胸腺嘧啶（AT）Watson-Crick（WC）碱基对系综中的此类行为。我们追踪展开后的能级间距的概率分布、相邻间距比（AGR）、数方差和谱可压缩性，以观察其统计是否遵循随机矩阵特征值的统计。在将结果与泊松、半泊松（SP）和高斯正交系综（GOE）统计进行比较后，可以明显看出轨道能级的统计与半泊松分布密切吻合，表明其处于可积性与混沌之间的中间区域，以能级排斥和强长程关联为特征。还讨论了其对电荷转移及相关生物过程的潜在生物物理意义。

items.title_en: Voltage-Enhanced Photorefractive Hysteresis in Thin-Film Lithium Niobate Photonic-Crystal Cavities
items.title_zh: 薄膜铌酸锂光子晶体腔中电压增强的光折变迟滞
items.abstract_en: We observe voltage-enhanced photorefractive hysteresis in thin-film lithium niobate nanocavities, causing the resonance to appear at different wavelengths during increasing- and decreasing-wavelength laser scans. Their separation grows with bias magnitude and optical power, but depends weakly on scan speed over 1-200 nm/s. A quasi-static surface-trap model links voltage-biased carrier transport to asymmetric trapping, whose space-charge field shifts the resonance through the Pockels effect. The model captures this hysteresis across three cavities through switching between stable steady states. Space-charge feedback opposes further carrier separation, limiting the hysteresis gap. The model informs photorefractive mitigation and resonance control in integrated electro-optic devices.
items.abstract_zh: 我们在薄膜铌酸锂纳米腔中观察到电压增强的光折变迟滞，导致在波长增加和减少的激光扫描过程中，谐振出现在不同波长。二者的间隔随偏压大小和光功率增大，但在 1–200 nm/s 的扫描速度范围内依赖性较弱。一个准静态表面陷阱模型将电压偏置下的载流子输运与非对称俘获联系起来，其空间电荷场通过普克尔斯效应移动谐振。该模型通过稳定稳态之间的切换，在三个腔中再现了这种迟滞。空间电荷反馈阻止载流子进一步分离，从而限制迟滞间隙。该模型为集成电光器件中的光折变抑制和谐振控制提供依据。

items.title_en: Steerable by Design: Conditional Pretraining for Robust Control of Language Models
items.title_zh: 设计即可操控：用于语言模型稳健控制的条件预训练
items.abstract_en: Our goal is to build language models that are steerable by design. Today's language models are pretrained with next-token prediction, which relegates alignment and control to the final 1% of training tokens or inference-time interventions. These models repurpose a single input channel for both instructions and data, leading to common failure modes where the model mistakenly treats data as instructions such as intentional jailbreaks and unintentional in-context alignment drift. To correct this, we propose a pretraining method and architecture that separates the two from the very start, producing Mancelle-3B. An encoder processes high-level semantic features of upcoming text with cross-attention that prevents the token stream from writing back into this control channel. During pretraining, the model learns to rely on these features to predict the next token, turning the channel into an effective handle for steering the model. Mancelle-3B steers more strongly than prompt- and activation-based methods on comparable open models while maintaining fluency, and it withstands adversarial black-box and soft-prompt counter-steering that defeats those baselines. We reproduce this against a more controlled baseline with Mancelle-400M. Our results show that robust control can be built into language models if we do so early and intentionally.
items.abstract_zh: 我们的目标是构建在设计上即可操控的语言模型。当前的语言模型通过下一词元预测进行预训练，这将对齐和控制降级到最后1%的训练词元或推理时干预。这些模型将单一输入通道同时复用于指令和数据，导致常见失败模式：模型误将数据当作指令，例如有意越狱和无意的上下文内对齐漂移。为纠正这一点，我们提出一种从一开始就将二者分离的预训练方法和架构，产生 Mancelle-3B。编码器通过交叉注意力处理即将出现文本的高层语义特征，这种交叉注意力阻止词元流写回该控制通道。在预训练期间，模型学会依赖这些特征来预测下一词元，使该通道成为操控模型的有效抓手。在可比的开源模型上，Mancelle-3B 比基于提示和基于激活的方法操控更强，同时保持流畅性，并能抵御击败那些基线的对抗性黑盒和软提示反操控。我们用 Mancelle-400M 在更受控的基线上复现了这一点。我们的结果表明，如果及早且有意识地这样做，稳健控制可以内建于语言模型中。

items.title_en: What Does Skill Lift Actually Measure? A Source-Code-Level Audit and Noise-Aware Reanalysis of SkillsBench
items.title_zh: 技能提升究竟测量了什么？对 SkillsBench 的源代码级审计与噪声感知再分析
items.abstract_en: Agent skills are directories of instructions, reference materials, and scripts loaded on demand by coding agents. According to SkillsBench, although human-curated skills can raise the passing rate by about 16.6 percentage points (pp) on average, they have actually reduced the results for some tasks. Later research has started to gate or eliminate skills according to the above per-task gains. We have audited the above benchmark at the source-code level and analysed 7,554 public trials to form 1,421 paired "(configuration, task) cells". Source-code audit identified two controlled-verified cases of grader dependence and one operational definition gap; the average lift on these three tasks was 74.6 pp, and the overall average lift for the full set was 18.7 pp. The audit also found that four tasks contained placeholder skill directories, and a certain execution harness additionally added 48 built-in skills in most runs. No task-level reduction achieved statistical significance in the pooled reanalysis with multiple-testing correction. As there were at most three runs per condition for each cell, the observed negative differences are very susceptible to run-sampling noise, and arithmetically, 58% of the cells could not have shown a decrease. Therefore, the raw numbers of negative cells cannot show that skills cause harm. A gating strategy based on the skill-free score seems to improve by 2-3 pp in the logs; however, even after shuffling condition labels to remove any skill effect, it still achieves an increase of 4-7 pp. On the held-out runs not used for fitting and decision-making, there was no statistically significant improvement. The audit ledger and analysis scripts have been published by us.
items.abstract_zh: 智能体技能是由编码智能体按需加载的指令、参考资料和脚本目录。根据 SkillsBench，尽管人工策展的技能平均可将通过率提高约 16.6 个百分点（pp），但它们实际上降低了一些任务的结果。后续研究已开始根据上述逐任务增益对技能进行门控或剔除。我们在源代码层面对上述基准进行了审计，并分析了 7,554 次公开试验，形成 1,421 个配对的“(配置, 任务) 单元”。源代码审计识别出两个经控制验证的评分器依赖案例和一个操作定义缺口；这三个任务上的平均提升为 74.6 pp，而全集总体平均提升为 18.7 pp。审计还发现四个任务包含占位技能目录，并且某个执行框架在大多数运行中额外加入了 48 个内置技能。在带多重检验校正的汇总再分析中，没有任何任务级降低达到统计显著性。由于每个单元每种条件最多只有三次运行，观察到的负差异非常容易受到运行采样噪声影响；并且从算术上看，58% 的单元不可能出现下降。因此，负向单元的原始数量不能表明技能会造成损害。基于无技能得分的门控策略在日志中似乎提高了 2-3 pp；然而，即使在打乱条件标签以消除任何技能效应后，它仍实现 4-7 pp 的提升。在未用于拟合和决策的留出运行上，没有统计显著改善。我们已发布审计账本和分析脚本。

items.title_en: ReWeave: Emergent Physical Task Topologies for Embodied Harness Optimization and Cross-Task Meta-Distillation
items.title_zh: ReWeave：用于具身执行框架优化与跨任务元蒸馏的涌现物理任务拓扑
items.abstract_en: Long-horizon embodied tasks involve physical dependencies that may only become clear through interaction. As task understanding deepens, past trials can reveal new information for adaptation and transfer. However, coarse progress feedback cannot identify which physical preconditions held, leaving search unguided, while task-specific optimization easily overfits to individual scenes, making cross-task transfer brittle. We introduce ReWeave, a framework that jointly optimizes an embodied agent harness and an emergent physical task topology from interaction without updating policy weights. Keeping execution policies and perception frozen, ReWeave co-optimizes coupled context, workflows, and control loops. As new evidence revises the topology, ReWeave reprojects past trials onto the updated task understanding, exposing retained progress, regressions, and bottlenecks that guide parent selection and search width. Across tasks, matching verified local mechanisms to unmet preconditions consolidates 72 specialist units into 44 reusable groups ($0.34\times$ full concatenation) within a compact shared harness capable of continual learning. ReWeave improves held-out success from 89.00% to 98.75% on LIBERO-PRO and from 25.50% to 58.25% on RoboDojo, while uncovering retained progress in 89% of 159 failed RoboDojo development trials and translating stronger offline reasoning into higher online performance. On eight unseen LIBERO-PRO tasks, the shared harness reaches 51.3% success versus 41.3% for direct distillation, rising to 75.0% after continual learning.
items.abstract_zh: 长时程具身任务涉及物理依赖关系，这些依赖可能只有通过交互才变得清晰。随着任务理解加深，过去的尝试可以揭示用于适应和迁移的新信息。然而，粗粒度进度反馈无法识别哪些物理前置条件成立，使搜索缺乏引导；而任务特定优化容易过拟合到单个场景，使跨任务迁移变得脆弱。我们引入 ReWeave，一个在不更新策略权重的情况下，从交互中联合优化具身智能体执行框架和涌现物理任务拓扑的框架。ReWeave 保持执行策略和感知冻结，协同优化耦合的上下文、工作流和控制回路。当新证据修正拓扑时，ReWeave 将过去的尝试重新投影到更新后的任务理解上，揭示保留的进展、回退和瓶颈，以指导父代选择和搜索宽度。跨任务地，将已验证的局部机制与未满足的前置条件匹配，可在能够持续学习的紧凑共享执行框架内，将 72 个专家单元整合为 44 个可复用组（为完整拼接的 $0.34\times$）。ReWeave 在 LIBERO-PRO 上将留出成功率从 89.00% 提高到 98.75%，在 RoboDojo 上从 25.50% 提高到 58.25%，同时在 159 个失败的 RoboDojo 开发试验中的 89% 里发现保留的进展，并将更强的离线推理转化为更高的在线性能。在八个未见过的 LIBERO-PRO 任务上，共享执行框架达到 51.3% 成功率，而直接蒸馏为 41.3%，在持续学习后升至 75.0%。
