items.title_en: Improving and Expanding Video Editing Capabilities Without Videos
items.title_zh: 无需视频即可改进和扩展视频编辑能力
items.abstract_en: Image editing models can follow a wide range of instructions, but video editing models still lag behind, limited in part by the difficulty of collecting paired source and edited videos. Is it possible to transfer advanced image editing capabilities to video editors without new paired videos? We introduce Image-to-Video Transfer (I2VT), which improves pretrained video editors and expands them to new editing tasks using an image editor. It enables efficient post-training with no architectural changes and no new videos, using only individual images. Our key idea is to let the video editor role-play as an image editor: it edits an image as a one-frame video, with the image editor guiding the video editor's predictions at each denoising step. Although the video editor sees only single images during training, at test time it applies the improved and expanded capabilities to whole video clips while preserving temporal consistency. To push the boundaries of video editing, we introduce OpenVE++, an extension of OpenVE-Bench that adds four new editing tasks useful for video production, including action changes, expression changes, body movements, and scene relighting. Our experiments across three different video editors show that I2VT improves existing editing capabilities and expands them to new tasks, and our models achieve state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on both OpenVE-Bench and OpenVE++.
items.abstract_zh: 图像编辑模型可以遵循广泛的指令，但视频编辑模型仍然落后，部分受限于收集配对的源视频和编辑后视频的困难。是否可能在没有新的配对视频的情况下，将先进的图像编辑能力迁移到视频编辑器？我们引入图像到视频迁移（I2VT），它使用图像编辑器改进预训练视频编辑器，并将其扩展到新的编辑任务。它无需架构改变，也无需新视频，仅使用单张图像即可实现高效后训练。我们的关键思想是让视频编辑器扮演图像编辑器：它将图像作为单帧视频进行编辑，图像编辑器在每个去噪步骤引导视频编辑器的预测。尽管视频编辑器在训练期间只看到单张图像，但在测试时它将改进和扩展后的能力应用于整个视频片段，同时保持时间一致性。为推进视频编辑的边界，我们引入 OpenVE++，它是 OpenVE-Bench 的扩展，新增四个对视频制作有用的编辑任务，包括动作变化、表情变化、身体运动和场景重光照。我们在三种不同视频编辑器上的实验表明，I2VT 改进了现有编辑能力并将其扩展到新任务，我们的模型在 OpenVE-Bench 和 OpenVE++ 上均达到最先进（SOTA）性能。

items.title_en: Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao Reconstruction of Discrete space Population Dynamics
items.title_zh: 离散空间群体动力学的 Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao 重建
items.abstract_en: Reconstructing the continuous time dynamics of cell state evolution from sparse snapshot observations can be formulated as an unbalanced optimal transport problem. To study such dynamics at a coarse grained cell type level, unbalanced optimal transport must be extended to discrete state spaces. Inspired by discrete flow matching, we extended the dynamic Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao (WFR) problem to discrete spaces, and derived a closed form for its solution. For particularly large state spaces or more general models, we proposed an unbalanced discrete flow matching as a numerical approximation method, which provides a Markovian reconstruction of the optimal WFR flow. Our discrete WFR framework also stays stable across different coarse grain resolution. Finally, numerical experiments demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed approach, and applications to real biological data supported the plausibility of the reconstructed dynamics.
items.abstract_zh: 从稀疏快照观测中重建细胞状态演化的连续时间动力学，可以表述为非平衡最优传输问题。为了在粗粒化细胞类型层面研究此类动力学，非平衡最优传输必须扩展到离散状态空间。受离散流匹配启发，我们将动态 Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao（WFR）问题扩展到离散空间，并推导出其解的闭式形式。对于特别大的状态空间或更一般的模型，我们提出非平衡离散流匹配作为数值近似方法，它提供最优 WFR 流的马尔可夫重建。我们的离散 WFR 框架在不同粗粒化分辨率下也保持稳定。最后，数值实验证明了所提方法的有效性，应用于真实生物数据支持了重建动力学的合理性。

items.title_en: Complementary mechanisms of critical quantum metrology
items.title_zh: 临界量子计量学的互补机制
items.abstract_en: Critical metrology conventionally exploits enhanced susceptibility to a system parameter near a phase transition. Here we identify a complementary mechanism for critically enhanced estimation of intrinsic system parameters via suppressed quantum noise rather than enhanced response. We demonstrate both mechanisms in coherently radiating spin states (CRSS)-correlated states of $N$ spin-$1/2$ particles defined as asymptotic eigenstates of the collective-spin lowering operator with complex eigenvalue $r e^{-i\varphi}$. At the critical value $r=1$, CRSS exhibit a second-order transition. We show that near criticality, estimation of $r$ benefits from enhanced susceptibility despite increased noise, whereas estimation of $\varphi$ benefits from suppressed quantum noise without enhanced response. Remarkably, both yield the same estimation error $\sim N^{-2/3}$, improving over the standard quantum limit $N^{-1/2}$. For $\varphi$, this establishes quantum-enhanced metrology of phases intrinsic to the critical system, rather than phases externally encoded by interferometry. We demonstrate these results for CRSS realizations in both dissipative (superradiant) and Hamiltonian (Ising) systems relevant to cavity QED and trapped ions, where fast preparation of CRSS is shown possible thanks to gap opening. Applications to metrology of coupling rates and phases or optical lengths are discussed.
items.abstract_zh: 临界计量学传统上利用相变附近对系统参数的增强敏感性。在这里，我们识别出一种互补机制，通过抑制量子噪声而非增强响应，实现内禀系统参数的临界增强估计。我们在由 N 个自旋-1/2 粒子组成的相干辐射自旋态（CRSS）关联态中展示了这两种机制，这些态定义为具有复本征值 r e^{-iφ} 的集体自旋降算符的渐近本征态。在临界值 r=1 处，CRSS 表现出二阶转变。我们表明，在临界点附近，r 的估计受益于增强的敏感性，尽管噪声增加；而 φ 的估计受益于抑制的量子噪声，且没有增强的响应。值得注意的是，两者都给出相同的估计误差 ∼N^{-2/3}，优于标准量子极限 N^{-1/2}。对于 φ，这建立了对临界系统内禀相位的量子增强计量，而不是由干涉测量从外部编码的相位。我们展示了与腔 QED 和囚禁离子相关的耗散（超辐射）和哈密顿（Ising）系统中 CRSS 实现的这些结果，其中由于能隙打开，CRSS 的快速制备被证明是可能的。讨论了对耦合速率以及相位或光学长度的计量应用。

items.title_en: Cell-Type-Specific Expression Is Hard to Predict from Bulk, but It Is Still Useful
items.title_zh: 细胞类型特异性表达难以从 bulk 数据预测，但仍然有用
items.abstract_en: Single-cell-informed deconvolution provides cell-type-resolved features for clinical bulk RNA cohorts. Most existing methods predict the proportions $π_k$ of the $K$ constituent cell types (CTs). Fewer predict cell-type-specific expression (CTSE) $μ_{kg}$ of gene $g$ in CT $k$, which can capture cell states that proportions miss, but recent benchmarks find it much harder. We explain this gap with closed-form accuracy bounds. For CTSE, we derive an $R^2$ ceiling for per-gene linear estimators. For proportions, the best linear estimator, which pools evidence across genes, has a closed-form $R^2$, and a computable lower bound on it predicts which CTs are learnable. We study targeted deconvolution of 106 biologically curated (CT, gene) pairs, found post hoc to have higher learnability scores. On overall survival in non-small cell lung cancer, estimation difficulty does not predict prognostic value across these targets. Yet a sparse survival model on deconvolved features, mostly CTSE, predicts survival as well as a sparse model on the bulk genes themselves, while attributing its signal to specific cell types. Some deconvolved CTSE features reveal prognostic signal not seen in the corresponding bulk gene.
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞信息引导的解卷积为临床 bulk RNA 队列提供细胞类型分辨的特征。大多数现有方法预测 K 个组成细胞类型（CT）的比例 π_k。较少方法预测基因 g 在 CT k 中的细胞类型特异性表达（CTSE）μ_{kg}，这可以捕捉比例所遗漏的细胞状态，但近期基准发现它要困难得多。我们用闭式精度界解释这一差距。对于 CTSE，我们推导逐基因线性估计器的 R^2 上限。对于比例，最佳线性估计器跨基因汇集证据，具有闭式 R^2，并且其上可计算的下界可预测哪些 CT 是可学习的。我们研究了对 106 个经生物学策展的（CT, 基因）对的靶向解卷积，这些对事后被发现具有更高的可学习性得分。在非小细胞肺癌的总生存期上，估计难度并不能预测这些目标间的预后价值。然而，一个基于解卷积特征（主要是 CTSE）的稀疏生存模型，其预测生存的效果与基于 bulk 基因本身的稀疏模型一样好，同时将其信号归因于特定细胞类型。一些解卷积后的 CTSE 特征揭示了相应 bulk 基因中未见的预后信号。

items.title_en: TACT-Bench: Testing Adaptive Conversational Threats against Tool-Use Agents
items.title_zh: TACT-Bench：测试针对工具使用智能体的自适应对话威胁
items.abstract_en: The growing autonomy of AI agents in using external tools and making decisions has created an urgent need for comprehensive safety benchmarks. Existing benchmarks test compromised tool channels or adaptive multi-turn attacks, though they may not capture the unique capabilities of policy-governed tool-use agents, which must resist unauthorized requests without abandoning the legitimate work embedded in the same interaction. To fill this gap, we introduce TACT-Bench, a stateful benchmark built around scenario-specific stories, personas, manipulation tactics, and response-adaptive escalation. Each adversarial task targets an action explicitly prohibited by the policy provided to the assistant, while the policy remains hidden from the attacking user. TACT pairs each adversarial task with at least one benign counterpart, and its adversarial tasks retain authorized ground-truth actions when a compliant resolution remains available. We define these base tasks as TACT-Base. We additionally introduce TACT-TrustPrime, which places an independent benign task before an unrelated attack in the same conversation. We also propose Paired Selective Trustworthiness (PST), which combines explicit safe refusal with demonstrated capability on matched benign tasks, to analyze an agent's overcautiousness and practicality. Averaged across 6 different models as assistants, TACT-Base raises Attack-Induced Failure Rate (AFR) by 17.53% over four compatible attack baselines, and TACT-TrustPrime raises it by a further 17.01%. The two evaluated defense methods reduce AFR by only 8.35%--9.41% on average and do not consistently improve PST, underscoring the need for stronger policy-enforcement methods.
items.abstract_zh: AI 智能体在使用外部工具和做出决策方面自主性不断增强，迫切需要全面的安全基准。现有基准测试被攻陷的工具通道或自适应多轮攻击，但可能无法捕捉受策略约束的工具使用智能体的独特能力，这类智能体必须在不放弃同一交互中嵌入的合法工作的情况下抵御未授权请求。为填补这一空白，我们引入 TACT-Bench，一个围绕场景特定故事、人物设定、操纵策略和响应自适应升级构建的有状态基准。每个对抗任务都针对提供给助手的策略明确禁止的动作，而该策略对攻击用户保持隐藏。TACT 为每个对抗任务配对至少一个良性对应任务，并且当仍存在合规解决方案时，其对抗任务保留授权的真实动作。我们将这些基础任务定义为 TACT-Base。我们还引入 TACT-TrustPrime，它在同一对话中把独立的良性任务置于无关攻击之前。我们还提出配对选择性可信度（Paired Selective Trustworthiness, PST），它结合明确的安全拒绝与在匹配良性任务上展示的能力，以分析智能体的过度谨慎和实用性。以 6 个不同模型作为助手进行平均，TACT-Base 相比四个兼容攻击基线将攻击诱导失败率（AFR）提高 17.53%，TACT-TrustPrime 再将其提高 17.01%。两种被评估的防御方法平均仅将 AFR 降低 8.35%–9.41%，且不能一致改善 PST，凸显了需要更强的策略执行方法。

items.title_en: AXE: AlpaSim E2E Closed Loop Challenge Technical Report
items.title_zh: AXE：AlpaSim 端到端闭环挑战技术报告
items.abstract_en: This report presents a comprehensive pipeline for developing an end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving model for the Physical AI AV Track. The framework consists of data curation, HD map auto-labelling, data-driven imitation learning, and simulator-based reinforcement learning. To ensure safety in the closed-loop setting, we introduce a selection-based E2E planning approach that leverages object detection and BEV segmentation to filter out trajectory candidates likely to cause collisions or off-road driving. Trained on NVIDIA NuRec and the NVIDIA PAI-AV dataset, our method scores a fixed vocabulary of trajectory candidates for collision, drivable-area compliance, and progress learned from simulated rollouts, and selects the best candidate that passes the filter. This design highlights the effectiveness of combining E2E planning with perception-based trajectory filtering for safe and reliable closed-loop autonomous driving.
items.abstract_zh: 本报告提出了一个用于 Physical AI AV Track 的端到端（E2E）自动驾驶模型开发的综合流程。该框架包括数据整理、高清地图自动标注、数据驱动的模仿学习和基于模拟器的强化学习。为确保闭环设置中的安全性，我们引入一种基于选择的 E2E 规划方法，利用目标检测和 BEV 分割来过滤可能造成碰撞或越野行驶的轨迹候选。在 NVIDIA NuRec 和 NVIDIA PAI-AV 数据集上训练后，我们的方法对固定词汇的轨迹候选在碰撞、可行驶区域符合性和从模拟推演中学习到的进度方面进行评分，并选择通过过滤器的最佳候选。这一设计突出了将 E2E 规划与基于感知的轨迹过滤相结合，对于安全可靠的闭环自动驾驶的有效性。

items.title_en: AIRIS: Benchmarking Social Embodied Intelligence in Egocentric Streaming Videos
items.title_zh: AIRIS：在第一人称流式视频中评测社会具身智能
items.abstract_en: Embodied agents operating around people must not only recognize social cues, but also decide when the available evidence is sufficient, whether to intervene, and how to respond without violating social norms. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate these abilities in isolation or with access to completed videos, obscuring where an online social decision fails. We introduce AIRIS, a causal streaming benchmark that formulates social embodied intelligence as a time-anchored chain of Attention, Intention, Reaction, and Interaction (A-I-R-I). AIRIS contains 8,000 expert-curated questions grounded in 357 egocentric clips across 11 context categories and 36 capability dimensions. At each query, models receive only the observation prefix available at that time; decision-aware metrics reward calibrated waiting and complete reactions while penalizing premature commitment. Evaluating 45 proprietary and open-source general-purpose, embodied, streaming-video, and omni-modal models reveals fragmented and temporally miscalibrated competence. General-purpose VLMs excel at passive cue grounding and intent recognition, whereas embodied specialists lead on isolated reaction sub-decisions; yet across all families, models frequently guess intents before sufficient evidence emerges and fail to jointly align intervention timing, action domain, and concrete execution within the same episode. AIRIS thus provides a diagnostic foundation for bridging the gap between passive social perception and reliable embodied interaction.
items.abstract_zh: 在人类周围运行的具身智能体不仅必须识别社会线索，还必须判断现有证据何时充分、是否介入，以及如何在不违反社会规范的情况下作出回应。现有基准通常孤立地评估这些能力，或让模型访问完整视频，从而掩盖在线社会决策在何处失败。我们提出 AIRIS，一个因果流式基准，将社会具身智能表述为以时间为锚的注意、意图、反应与交互（A-I-R-I）链。AIRIS 包含 8,000 个由专家精心整理的问题，这些问题基于 357 个第一人称视频片段，涵盖 11 个上下文类别和 36 个能力维度。每次查询时，模型仅接收当时可用的观测前缀；决策感知指标奖励经过校准的等待和完整反应，同时惩罚过早承诺。对 45 个专有和开源的通用的、具身的、流式视频的以及全模态的模型进行评估，揭示出能力碎片化和时间校准失准。通用 VLM 擅长被动线索定位和意图识别，而具身专用模型在孤立反应子决策上领先；然而在所有模型家族中，模型经常在充分证据出现之前猜测意图，并且未能在同一片段内联合对齐介入时机、动作域和具体执行。因此，AIRIS 为弥合被动社会感知与可靠具身交互之间的差距提供了诊断基础。

items.title_en: From the Deterministic Hook Effect to Stochastic Reliability in Ternary Complex Formation
items.title_zh: 从确定性钩子效应到三元复合物形成的随机可靠性
items.abstract_en: Ternary binding systems occur in signaling, scaffold-mediated assembly, and targeted protein degradation. A mediator brings two partners into a productive ternary complex, but excess mediator can hold them in separate binary complexes. Consequently, ternary complex formation can increase and then decrease as the mediator dose increases, producing the hook effect. Deterministic dose-response curves describe the average behavior but do not indicate whether individual small compartments reliably form the complex. A minimal reversible binding network was studied using deterministic equations, exact stochastic simulations, and a simple catalytic extension. The deterministic model recovered the hook-shaped response. In stochastic simulations, small volumes often failed to accumulate the required number of complexes, even where the deterministic prediction was favorable. At low mediator doses, failure reflected a shortage of mediator molecules; at high doses, material accumulated in free or binary-bound forms. Larger volumes increased the range of mediator doses supporting reliable formation, while stricter copy-number thresholds narrowed that range. Faster ternary-complex completion or slower breakup improved reliability. In the catalytic model, product formation also depended on how early productive complexes formed. These results show why a favorable average binding response does not necessarily ensure reliable assembly in small reaction volumes.
items.abstract_zh: 三元结合系统出现在信号传导、支架介导的组装和靶向蛋白质降解中。介导物将两个伙伴带到一起形成有效三元复合物，但过量的介导物可将它们保持在分离的二元复合物中。因此，随着介导物剂量增加，三元复合物形成可先增加后减少，产生钩子效应。确定性剂量-反应曲线描述平均行为，但不表明单个小隔室是否可靠地形成复合物。使用确定性方程、精确随机模拟和一个简单催化扩展研究了最小可逆结合网络。确定性模型重现了钩形反应。在随机模拟中，小体积常常无法积累所需数量的复合物，即使在确定性预测有利的情况下也是如此。在低介导物剂量下，失败反映介导物分子短缺；在高剂量下，物质以游离或二元结合形式积累。较大体积增加了支持可靠形成的介导物剂量范围，而更严格的拷贝数阈值缩小了该范围。更快的三元复合物完成或更慢的解体提高了可靠性。在催化模型中，产物形成还取决于有效复合物形成的早晚。这些结果说明了为什么有利的平均结合反应并不一定确保小反应体积中的可靠组装。

items.title_en: Exact monogamy of steering and remote Wigner negativity for multimode Gaussian nodes
items.title_zh: 多模高斯节点的导引与远程 Wigner 负性的精确单配性
items.abstract_en: Optical quantum networks route correlations through nodes that hold several modes and are linked to many neighbors. Steering is the correlation behind one-sided device-independent tasks and behind the remote preparation of non-Gaussian states. It is monogamous for a single mode, which can be steered by only one party, but how many neighbors can steer a node with $k$ modes was not known. We show that for Gaussian states the answer is exactly $2k-1$ when the neighbors use Gaussian measurements, with any number of measurement settings. The limit follows from a simple bound. To every neighbor we assign a share, computed from the covariance matrix, and we prove that the shares of all neighbors add up to at most $k$, irrespective of the amount of squeezing, amplification or noise the network contains. A neighbor steers the node by Gaussian measurements exactly when its share exceeds one half, and a network built from a harmonic tight frame reaches the limit. The same number governs remote Wigner negativity. A heralded non-Gaussian operation at the node can make at most $2k-1$ neighbors Wigner negative, and in our network a single heralded projection makes all of them negative in the same run. With $n$ settings of arbitrary measurements, at most $nk-1$ neighbors can steer the node or violate a Bell inequality with it. More than $2k-1$ neighbors can therefore steer the node or violate a Bell inequality with it only if they use non-Gaussian measurements with at least three settings, whereas entanglement can reach any number of neighbors. These results determine exactly how many neighbors one multimode node can serve with steering and with remote Wigner negativity.
items.abstract_zh: 光学量子网络通过持有多个模式并连接许多邻居的节点来路由关联。导引是单边设备无关任务以及非高斯态远程制备背后的关联。对于单个模式，导引是单配的，即只能被一方导引；但多少个邻居能够导引一个具有 k 个模式的节点此前尚不清楚。我们表明，对于高斯态，当邻居使用高斯测量时，答案恰好是 2k-1，且测量设置数量任意。该限制来自一个简单界。我们为每个邻居分配一个份额，该份额由协方差矩阵计算，并证明所有邻居的份额总和至多为 k，无论网络包含多少压缩、放大或噪声。一个邻居通过高斯测量导引该节点，当且仅当其份额超过二分之一；由调和紧框架构建的网络可达到该极限。同一数目支配远程 Wigner 负性。节点处的一次预报非高斯操作至多能使 2k-1 个邻居呈 Wigner 负性，而在我们的网络中，单次预报投影可在同一次运行中使所有这些邻居呈负性。使用任意测量的 n 个设置时，至多有 nk-1 个邻居能够导引该节点或与其违反 Bell 不等式。因此，超过 2k-1 个邻居要导引该节点或与其违反 Bell 不等式，只有当它们使用至少三种设置的非高斯测量时才可能；而纠缠可以到达任意数量的邻居。这些结果精确确定了一个多模节点在导引和远程 Wigner 负性方面能够服务多少个邻居。

items.title_en: SysBio-SR: Benchmarking Symbolic Regression for Trajectory Fidelity and Mechanism Recovery in Systems Biology
items.title_zh: SysBio-SR：在系统生物学中基准测试符号回归的轨迹保真度与机制恢复
items.abstract_en: Symbolic regression seeks to discover interpretable governing equations for dynamical systems from data. In systems biology, however, accurately reproducing system trajectories does not necessarily imply recovery of the underlying reaction mechanisms. Existing benchmarks evaluate numerical accuracy, expression complexity, or equation-level similarity, but not agreement between recovered reactions and reference mechanisms in biological systems. We introduce SysBio-SR, a benchmark of 198 literature-based biological ODE systems with reaction annotations spanning mass action, Michaelis--Menten, Hill, and complex kinetics. Trajectory fidelity is evaluated across all systems under in-distribution reconstruction and out-of-distribution (OOD) extrapolation, while mechanism recovery is assessed on the subset of 161 systems. We evaluate trajectory fidelity across 11 symbolic-discovery methods and assess mechanism recovery for three reaction-based methods. Joint analysis across systems highlights how severely trajectory-based evaluation overestimates true mechanism recovery. Motivated by these findings, we develop KineSelect, a framework that searches candidate reaction topologies under biologically grounded kinetic laws to select optimal mechanisms that balance trajectory fidelity with structural parsimony. Compared with the strongest baseline, KineSelect improves aggregate OOD extrapolation \(R^2\) by 19.2\% and overall reaction F1 score by 14.3\%.
items.abstract_zh: 符号回归旨在从数据中发现动力系统的可解释控制方程。然而，在系统生物学中，准确重现系统轨迹并不一定意味着恢复底层反应机制。现有基准评估数值精度、表达式复杂度或方程级相似性，但不评估生物系统中恢复的反应与参考机制之间的一致性。我们提出 SysBio-SR，一个包含 198 个基于文献的生物 ODE 系统的基准，其反应注释涵盖质量作用、Michaelis-Menten、Hill 和复杂动力学。轨迹保真度在所有系统上于分布内重建和分布外（OOD）外推下评估，而机制恢复在 161 个系统的子集上评估。我们评估了 11 种符号发现方法的轨迹保真度，并评估了三种基于反应的方法的机制恢复。跨系统的联合分析凸显了基于轨迹的评估在多大程度上严重高估真实机制恢复。受这些发现启发，我们开发了 KineSelect，一个在具有生物学依据的动力学定律下搜索候选反应拓扑的框架，以选择在轨迹保真度与结构简约性之间取得平衡的最优机制。与最强基线相比，KineSelect 将总体 OOD 外推 R² 提高 19.2%，并将总体反应 F1 分数提高 14.3%。

items.title_en: Tablassert: Declarative Extraction of Knowledge Graphs from Biomedical Tables
items.title_zh: Tablassert：从生物医学表格中声明式提取知识图谱
items.abstract_en: Tables published in biomedical research papers, particularly supplemental tables, capture knowledge assertions that may not be in the main text of the manuscript for several reasons, including low statistical significance, space limitations, and narrative scope. These tables include data (e.g., association statistics, assay readouts, curated gene lists, and omics) encoding relationships between biological entities. Tablassert converts such tabular data (Excel, CSV, TSV, Parquet) into knowledge graphs ready for the NCATS Biomedical Data Translator (Fecho et al. 2025). A user declares in YAML how each table's data map to subject-predicate-object-qualifier statements; Tablassert resolves free text (e.g., ''lung cancer'') to standard identifiers, attaches provenance and statistics, and emits graph files conforming to Translator standards (D. Unni, Bruskiewich, and Moxon 2026; D. R. Unni et al. 2022).
items.abstract_zh: 生物医学研究论文中发表的表格，尤其是补充表格，捕获了可能未出现在稿件正文中的知识断言，原因包括统计显著性低、篇幅限制和叙述范围。这些表格包含编码生物实体之间关系的数据（例如关联统计量、测定读数、整理好的基因列表和组学数据）。Tablassert 将此类表格数据（Excel、CSV、TSV、Parquet）转换为可供 NCATS Biomedical Data Translator 使用的知识图谱（Fecho et al. 2025）。用户在 YAML 中声明每个表格的数据如何映射到主语-谓语-宾语-限定语陈述；Tablassert 将自由文本（例如“肺癌”）解析为标准标识符，附加来源和统计信息，并生成符合 Translator 标准的图文件（D. Unni, Bruskiewich, and Moxon 2026; D. R. Unni et al. 2022）。

items.title_en: $μ$MPC: Microsecond-Scale Nonlinear and World Model Control from Edge to GPU via Koopman-Linearized Precompilation
items.title_zh: μMPC：通过 Koopman 线性化预编译实现从边缘到 GPU 的微秒级非线性与世界模型控制
items.abstract_en: We present $μ$MPC, a fast model predictive control (MPC) framework that reduces online computation using learned Koopman-linearized dynamics. By precomputing finite-horizon control-to-output maps, $μ$MPC eliminates lifted-state trajectories, yielding an action-only Koopman-Compiled QP (KC-QP) with $Hn_u$ decision variables, independent of lifted dimension. A fixed, precomputed primal operator enables efficient primal-dual iterations using only matrix-vector products and projections, accommodating changing goals and constraints without refactorization. This efficiency also enables control-aware dynamics learning through differentiable KC-QPs in the training loop and batched DAgger-style data aggregation. $μ$MPC achieves solve times as low as $23μ$s on a desktop CPU and 24 ms onboard a 168 MHz Crazyflie microcontroller. It scales to 4096D quadruped control in under 5 ms, visual planning with 2048D world models in 0.4 ms, and collision-aware planning for 200 quadrotors at over 30 Hz on the GPU. Across these benchmarks, $μ$MPC achieves up to $108\times$ faster constrained MPC and $1907\times$ faster visuomotor planning than competing methods.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 μMPC，一个快速模型预测控制（MPC）框架，利用学习到的 Koopman 线性化动力学减少在线计算。通过预计算有限时域的控制到输出映射，μMPC 消除了提升状态轨迹，产生一个仅含动作的 Koopman 编译 QP（KC-QP），其决策变量为 Hn_u，且与提升维度无关。一个固定且预计算的原算子使得仅使用矩阵-向量乘积和投影的高效原对偶迭代成为可能，无需重新分解即可适应变化的目标和约束。这种效率还使得在训练循环中通过可微 KC-QP 以及批处理 DAgger 风格的数据聚合来进行控制感知的动力学学习成为可能。μMPC 在桌面 CPU 上实现低至 23 μs 的求解时间，在 168 MHz Crazyflie 微控制器上实现 24 ms 的求解时间。它可扩展到 5 ms 以内的 4096 维四足控制、0.4 ms 内使用 2048 维世界模型的视觉规划，以及 GPU 上以超过 30 Hz 对 200 架四旋翼进行碰撞感知规划。在这些基准上，μMPC 相比竞争方法实现高达 108 倍的更快约束 MPC 和 1907 倍的更快视觉运动规划。

items.title_en: What a Drop Reveals: Sim-to-Real Material Estimation for Deformable Objects from Video
items.title_zh: 一次跌落揭示了什么：从视频进行可变形物体的仿真到真实材料估计
items.abstract_en: How an object deforms when it hits the ground reveals what it is made of. From a single real video of a drop, we estimate a deformable object's density-normalized stiffness $E/ρ$, and its yield stress $σ_Y/ρ$ when the impact causes plastic deformation, with a feed-forward predictor trained only in simulation. Real videos carry no material labels, so such predictors are developed and validated on synthetic data alone. We show that synthetic validation ranks their geometric inputs in the wrong order. Material acts through 3D deformation, and tracklets lifted to 3D with estimated depth are indeed the most accurate input in simulation. However, on real drops they are the least accurate, and better depth does not repair them: the failure persists with simulator depth in training, LiDAR depth at test time, and exact depth on rendered replays of the real drops. Short 2D optical-flow tracklets do the opposite: they improve nothing in simulation, yet they transfer best. Material is therefore better read from what perception measures consistently in both domains than from what is most informative in simulation. Our predictor, PhysReader, reads the video and 2D tracklets and learns the lift to 3D in simulation by matching a teacher that sees exact 3D deformation. To measure transfer, we introduce PhysReader-Real: 16 everyday objects dropped five times each, with reference materials fit jointly to each object's drops and checked against tensile tests. On PhysReader-Real, PhysReader is closer to the reference materials than every other input and baseline. The one exception is a per-scene optimizer started from PhysReader's prediction, which ends slightly closer but takes 49 minutes per video instead of 12 seconds.
items.abstract_zh: 物体撞击地面时如何变形揭示了它的材质。仅凭一次跌落的单个真实视频，我们使用仅在仿真中训练的前馈预测器，估计可变形物体的密度归一化刚度 E/ρ，并在撞击导致塑性变形时估计其屈服应力 σ_Y/ρ。真实视频不携带材料标签，因此此类预测器仅基于合成数据开发和验证。我们表明，合成验证对其几何输入的排序是错误的。材料通过 3D 变形起作用，而利用估计深度提升到 3D 的轨迹片段在仿真中确实是最准确的输入。然而，在真实跌落中它们却是最不准确的，而且更好的深度并不能修复这一点：无论训练时使用模拟器深度、测试时使用 LiDAR 深度，还是在真实跌落的渲染回放中使用精确深度，这种失败都持续存在。短的 2D 光流轨迹片段则相反：它们在仿真中没有任何改善，却迁移效果最好。因此，材料最好从感知在两个域中一致测量的内容中读取，而不是从仿真中最具信息量的内容中读取。我们的预测器 PhysReader 读取视频和 2D 轨迹片段，并通过匹配一个能看到精确 3D 变形的教师模型，在仿真中学习到 3D 的提升。为衡量迁移，我们引入 PhysReader-Real：16 个日常物体，每个跌落五次，参考材料通过联合拟合每个物体的多次跌落得到，并与拉伸测试进行核对。在 PhysReader-Real 上，PhysReader 比所有其他输入和基线都更接近参考材料。唯一的例外是一个从 PhysReader 预测启动的逐场景优化器，它最终略更接近，但每个视频耗时 49 分钟，而不是 12 秒。

items.title_en: Extraction of Glaucoma Diagnosis, Type, and Severity from Clinical Notes using Secure Cloud-based Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 使用安全的云端大语言模型从临床笔记中提取青光眼诊断、类型和严重程度
items.abstract_en: Purpose: To evaluate the performance of large language models (LLMs) in extracting glaucoma diagnosis, type, and severity from clinical notes in the electronic health record (EHR). Methods: Clinical notes of glaucoma-related encounters between 2014 and 2024 from 1,242 subjects were extracted from the Bascom Palmer Ophthalmic Repository. Two fellowship-trained glaucoma specialists labeled notes for glaucoma presence, type, and severity. Dataset was split into development (10%), validation (10%), and test (80%) sets. Five LLMs (Claude Opus 4.6, DeepSeek-V3.2, GPT-5.2, Grok 4.1 fast non-reasoning, and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B) were accessed via Microsoft Foundry within HIPAA-compliant containers. Model performance was assessed using standard metrics. Clinician-entered ICD-10 codes were also compared with adjudicated labels. Main Outcome Measures: Gwet AC1, accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and F1-score. Results: Inter-grader agreement for glaucoma diagnosis, type, and severity was high (Gwet AC1 0.940, 0.917, 0.906, respectively). For glaucoma diagnosis, LLMs demonstrated high accuracy, with Claude achieving 97.5%, DeepSeek 96.0%, GPT 96.2%, Grok 94.4%, and Qwen 95.5%. F1 scores for glaucoma detection ranged from 97.0% to 98.9%. For type, accuracies were 97.1%, 94.2%, 94.2%, 94.0%, and 94.4%, respectively. F1 scores for the most prevalent type (POAG) ranged from 96.6% to 98.9%. For severity, accuracies were 95.0%, 94.8%, 94.5%, 94.0%, and 95.2%, respectively, with F1 scores ranging from 89.7% to 96.3%. ICD-10 codes demonstrated lower accuracies for type and severity (87.3% and 69.2%, respectively). Conclusions: LLMs accurately extracted glaucoma diagnosis, type, and severity from free-text clinical notes, outperforming ICD-based phenotyping. Translational Relevance: LLMs have the potential to transform unstructured documentation into scalable, research-ready phenotypes for EHR-based glaucoma cohort construction.
items.abstract_zh: 目的：评估大语言模型（LLM）从电子健康记录（EHR）的临床笔记中提取青光眼诊断、类型和严重程度的性能。方法：从 Bascom Palmer 眼科数据库提取 2014 年至 2024 年间 1,242 名受试者青光眼相关就诊的临床笔记。两名接受过专科进修培训的青光眼专家对笔记进行标注，标记青光眼是否存在、类型和严重程度。数据集划分为开发集（10%）、验证集（10%）和测试集（80%）。通过符合 HIPAA 的容器内的 Microsoft Foundry 访问五个 LLM（Claude Opus 4.6、DeepSeek-V3.2、GPT-5.2、Grok 4.1 fast non-reasoning 和 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B）。使用标准指标评估模型性能。还将临床医生录入的 ICD-10 编码与裁定标签进行比较。主要结局指标：Gwet AC1、准确率、灵敏度、特异度和 F1 分数。结果：青光眼诊断、类型和严重程度的评分者间一致性很高（Gwet AC1 分别为 0.940、0.917、0.906）。对于青光眼诊断，LLM 表现出高准确率，Claude 达到 97.5%，DeepSeek 96.0%，GPT 96.2%，Grok 94.4%，Qwen 95.5%。青光眼检测的 F1 分数范围为 97.0% 至 98.9%。对于类型，准确率分别为 97.1%、94.2%、94.2%、94.0% 和 94.4%。最常见类型（POAG）的 F1 分数范围为 96.6% 至 98.9%。对于严重程度，准确率分别为 95.0%、94.8%、94.5%、94.0% 和 95.2%，F1 分数范围为 89.7% 至 96.3%。ICD-10 编码在类型和严重程度上的准确率较低（分别为 87.3% 和 69.2%）。结论：LLM 能从自由文本临床笔记中准确提取青光眼诊断、类型和严重程度，优于基于 ICD 的表型提取。转化相关性：LLM 有潜力将非结构化文档转化为可扩展、可供研究的表型，用于基于 EHR 构建青光眼队列。

items.title_en: A Reconfigurable Four-State Sensor Based on Orthogonal Thermal and Chemical Stimuli
items.title_zh: 基于正交热与化学刺激的可重构四态传感器
items.abstract_en: This article presents a novel four-state refractive index (RI) sensor based on distinct phases of palladium (Pd) and vanadium dioxide (VO$_2$), controlled by orthogonal thermal and chemical stimuli. This is a numerical, simulation-only study: all results are obtained from two-dimensional finite-element method (FEM) simulations. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first reported multi-state reconfigurable RI sensor tuned by external control. VO$_2$ serves as a phase change material (PCM) offering two thermally switchable phases with highly contrasting optical properties, while the hydrogen absorption property of Pd provides two additional phases. Combining these, four operational states are realized: (i) $α$-Pd/low-$T$ VO$_2$; (ii) $β$-PdH$_x$/low-$T$ VO$_2$; (iii) $α$-Pd/high-$T$ VO$_2$; and (iv) $β$-PdH$_x$/high-$T$ VO$_2$. Thermal crosstalk between Pd and VO$_2$ is mitigated through tungsten (W) doping of VO$_2$. This work further introduces conditional state sensitivity (CSS), a novel figure of merit quantifying the optical contrast between each state transition. The proposed sensor achieves a peak sensitivity of 2871 nm/RIU for the undoped reference configuration and 2798 nm/RIU for the practical W-doped device, together with a peak CSS of 16,872 nm/RIU, establishing it as a multi-state reconfigurable platform with reduced thermal crosstalk and potential applications in industrial safety monitoring and optical logic gates.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种新型四态折射率（RI）传感器，基于钯（Pd）和二氧化钒（VO2）的不同相态，由正交的热与化学刺激控制。这是一项数值的、仅仿真的研究：所有结果均来自二维有限元方法（FEM）仿真。据我们所知，这是首次报道的由外部控制调谐的多态可重构RI传感器。VO2作为相变材料（PCM），提供两个热切换相，其光学性质高度对比；而Pd的氢吸收特性提供另外两个相。结合这些，实现了四个工作状态：(i) α-Pd/低T VO2；(ii) β-PdHx/低T VO2；(iii) α-Pd/高T VO2；(iv) β-PdHx/高T VO2。Pd与VO2之间的热串扰通过VO2的钨（W）掺杂得到缓解。本工作进一步引入条件态灵敏度（CSS），一种量化每个状态跃迁之间光学对比度的新颖品质因数。所提出的传感器在未掺杂参考配置下达到2871 nm/RIU的峰值灵敏度，在实际W掺杂器件中为2798 nm/RIU，并具有16,872 nm/RIU的峰值CSS，使其成为一个具有降低热串扰的多态可重构平台，并在工业安全监测和光学逻辑门中具有潜在应用。

items.title_en: PtychoFM: A Foundation Model for Ptychographic Imaging
items.title_zh: PtychoFM：叠层成像的基础模型
items.abstract_en: Ptychography provides high-resolution lensless imaging across X-ray, electron, and optical microscopy, but reconstructing images from diffraction measurements generally requires computationally intensity iterative phase retrieval. These methods often require experiment-specific analysis, limiting real-time feedback as data acquisition rates increase. Here, we demonstrate PtychoFM, a physics-aware foundation model for ptychographic imaging that combines large-scale pre-training with experiment-specific fine-tuning to reconstruct complex object images directly from individual diffraction patterns. Trained using a differentiable forward model without object-space labels, PtychoFM transfers from step-scan training data on one sample to fly-scan measurements of other samples with different feature sizes, morphologies, and refraction indices. At a synchrotron beamline, diffraction frames were streamed from the detector to a single GPU for inference at up to 200 frames per second and returned for real-time visualization. PtychoFM provides a practical route to rapid, transferable ptychographic reconstruction and live experimental feedback under nonideal conditions.
items.abstract_zh: 叠层成像可在 X 射线、电子和光学显微术中提供高分辨率无透镜成像，但从衍射测量重建图像通常需要计算密集的迭代相位恢复。这些方法往往需要针对具体实验的分析，随着数据采集速率提高，限制了实时反馈。在此，我们展示 PtychoFM，一种用于叠层成像的物理感知基础模型，它结合大规模预训练与实验特定微调，可直接从单个衍射图重建复杂物体图像。PtychoFM 使用可微前向模型训练，无需物体空间标签，可从一种样品的步进扫描训练数据迁移到具有不同特征尺寸、形貌和折射率的其他样品的飞行扫描测量。在同步辐射光束线上，衍射帧从探测器流式传输到单个 GPU 进行推理，速度最高达每秒 200 帧，并返回用于实时可视化。PtychoFM 为在非理想条件下实现快速、可迁移的叠层重建和实时实验反馈提供了实用途径。

items.title_en: Tokenisation is not in APX
items.title_zh: Tokenisation不属于APX
items.abstract_en: In this paper, we prove that, unless P=NP, no polynomial-time algorithm can find a tokeniser whose objective is within any constant factor of the optimum, meaning that tokenisation is not in the APX complexity class. We prove this for direct and bottom-up tokenisation, under both a compression or unigram log-likelihood objectives, and for binary or larger alphabets. We further show that, even over unary alphabets, direct tokenisation is APX-hard, and thus admits no polynomial-time approximation scheme.
items.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们证明，除非P=NP，否则不存在多项式时间算法能够找到其目标在最优值的任意常数因子范围内的分词器，这意味着分词不属于APX复杂度类。我们针对直接分词和自底向上分词、在压缩或一元对数似然目标下、以及二元或更大字母表证明了这一点。我们进一步表明，即使在一元字母表上，直接分词也是APX难的，因此不存在多项式时间近似方案。

items.title_en: Reference-Model-Guided Distributed MPC for UAV Swarm Formation Flying Under Switching Directed Graphs
items.title_zh: 切换有向图下基于参考模型引导的无人机集群编队飞行分布式MPC
items.abstract_en: Distributed formation control of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarms in complex environments faces several challenges, including switching inter-agent connectivity, limited communication, external disturbances, and collision avoidance. To address these challenges, we propose a reference-model-guided distributed model predictive control (MPC) framework for UAV swarm formation. Each UAV uses relative-position information from its neighbors as input to a local reference model, whose output serves as the formation guidance for the onboard MPC controller. Meanwhile, a Kalman filter is utilized to predict neighboring UAV motions, enabling the construction of inter-UAV collision-avoidance constraints solely from instantaneous relative-state information. By decoupling MPC optimization from distributed coordination, this control architecture preserves the look-ahead planning and constraint-handling capabilities of MPC while enhancing the swarm's adaptability to switching directed graphs. Moreover, eliminating the exchange of neighbors' predicted trajectories reduces communication bandwidth demands, offering strong scalability for large-scale UAV swarms. To improve robustness and safety, disturbance-observer-based feedforward compensation is employed, while the bounded residual disturbance is explicitly considered in the control barrier function (CBF)-based obstacle-avoidance constraints. Finally, the proposed framework is validated through both simulations and real-world flight experiments. Specifically, the flight verification is conducted on a fully distributed multi-UAV platform without external global localization.
items.abstract_zh: 复杂环境中无人机（UAV）集群的分布式编队控制面临若干挑战，包括智能体间连通性切换、通信受限、外部扰动和碰撞避免。为应对这些挑战，我们提出一种参考模型引导的无人机集群编队分布式模型预测控制（MPC）框架。每架无人机将其邻居的相对位置信息作为局部参考模型的输入，该模型的输出作为机载MPC控制器的编队引导。同时，利用卡尔曼滤波器预测邻近无人机的运动，使得仅根据瞬时相对状态信息即可构建无人机间避碰约束。通过将MPC优化与分布式协调解耦，该控制架构保留了MPC的前瞻规划和约束处理能力，同时增强了集群对切换有向图的适应性。此外，消除邻居预测轨迹的交换降低了通信带宽需求，为大规模无人机集群提供了强可扩展性。为提高鲁棒性和安全性，采用了基于扰动观测器的前馈补偿，同时在基于控制屏障函数（CBF）的避障约束中显式考虑有界残余扰动。最后，通过仿真和真实飞行实验验证了所提出的框架。具体而言，飞行验证在无外部全局定位的全分布式多无人机平台上进行。

items.title_en: TIDE-Flow: Fine-Grained Temporal Evidence and Structured Displacement Matching for Spike Optical Flow
items.title_zh: TIDE-Flow：面向脉冲光流的细粒度时间证据与结构化位移匹配
items.abstract_en: Spike cameras capture high-speed motion through an integrate-and-fire mechanism, providing fine-grained temporal observations without exposure blur. However, their binary streams encode accumulated illumination rather than instantaneous intensity, making reliable motion estimation challenging. Existing spike-based methods exploit temporal aggregation to construct motion representations, but this process may weaken fine-grained firing patterns. Meanwhile, correlation-based estimators often rely on learned matching features without explicitly characterizing the spatial distribution and ambiguity of candidate displacements. To address these challenges, we propose TIDE-Flow, a spike-based optical flow estimation framework that jointly exploits Temporal Integration Evidence (TIE) and Displacement Evidence Encoding (DEE). TIE combines raw spike patterns, multi-scale firing statistics, temporal moments, and boundary-aware interval cues, preserving complementary temporal information before spatial feature compression. DEE further integrates structured candidate-grid features with explicit displacement statistics to characterize matching geometry and competing correspondences. Both components are incorporated into a difference-correlation recurrent refinement framework, enabling effective temporal motion modeling and correspondence estimation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of TIDE-Flow, with controlled ablations validating the contributions of temporal and displacement evidence modeling.
items.abstract_zh: 脉冲相机通过积分-发放机制捕获高速运动，提供无曝光模糊的细粒度时间观测。然而，其二进制流编码的是累积光照而非瞬时强度，使得可靠的运动估计具有挑战性。现有的基于脉冲的方法利用时间聚合来构建运动表示，但这一过程可能削弱细粒度发放模式。同时，基于相关性的估计器通常依赖学习到的匹配特征，而没有显式刻画候选位移的空间分布和歧义性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出TIDE-Flow，一种基于脉冲的光流估计框架，联合利用时间积分证据（TIE）和位移证据编码（DEE）。TIE结合原始脉冲模式、多尺度发放统计、时间矩和边界感知区间线索，在空间特征压缩之前保留互补的时间信息。DEE进一步将结构化候选网格特征与显式位移统计相结合，以刻画匹配几何和竞争对应关系。两个组件都被纳入差分相关循环细化框架，从而实现有效的时间运动建模和对应估计。大量实验证明了TIDE-Flow的有效性，受控消融验证了时间证据建模和位移证据建模的贡献。

items.title_en: Distinguishing Social Isolation, Social Support, and Contextual False Positives in Clinical Notes Using Fine-Tuned Language Models: Multisite Validation Study
items.title_zh: 使用微调语言模型区分临床记录中的社会隔离、社会支持与上下文假阳性：多站点验证研究
items.abstract_en: Background: Social isolation and social support are clinically important but inconsistently represented in structured electronic health record data. Their identification from clinical narratives is complicated by nuanced, context-dependent language and by variation in how social connectedness is documented across clinical settings, patient populations, and geographic locations. Models intended for health care use must therefore distinguish social isolation from documented support, negation, ambiguous social circumstances, and non-social clinical uses of similar terminology while remaining robust to differences in documentation practices. Objective: This study aimed to develop and evaluate locally deployable, fine-tuned language models for context-aware classification of social isolation, social support, and contextually similar non-relevant clinical text across multiple health systems. Materials and Methods: We conducted a retrospective study using electronic health record data from 326,847 adults aged 50 years or older who received care at 3 Tennessee health systems from 2020 to 2023. Candidate clinical text was identified using social-environment ICD-10-CM Z codes and an established social isolation lexicon. Human annotators classified 9,748 spans from 9,578 clinical notes contributed by 6,881 patients as social isolation, social support, or no social isolation. The annotated corpus included social isolation and support concepts including negations, infection-control and microbiology terminology, institutional living arrangements, and other contextually ambiguous examples. FLAN-T5-Large, BERT, RoBERTa, and Gemma-2-2B were fine-tuned for 3-class span classification. Full fine-tuning and parameter-efficient fine-tuning using low-rank adaptation approaches were evaluated for the best performing model, FLAN-T5-Large. Performance was assessed using site-based internal-external cross-validation, with macro-F1 as the primary metric. Results: The annotated corpus included 2,318 social isolation spans, 638 social support spans, and 6,792 spans classified as no social isolation. Fully fine-tuned FLAN-T5-Large achieved the best performance, with a mean macro-F1 of 0.90 (SD 0.01). Class-specific F1 scores were 0.85 (SD 0.03) for social isolation, 0.87 (SD 0.04) for social support, and 0.96 (SD 0.02) for no social isolation. Gemma-2-2B achieved a macro-F1 of 0.85 (SD 0.01), compared with 0.84 (SD 0.06) for RoBERTa and 0.86 (SD 0.06) for BERT. Full fine-tuning also outperformed parameter-efficient fine-tuning in secondary pooled analyses (macro-F1 0.93 vs 0.90) in the corresponding held-out evaluation for the FLAN-T5-Large model. Remaining errors primarily involved patients who lived alone but received assistance, family presence without meaningful support, grief-related language, and non-social clinical uses of isolation terminology. Conclusions: Fine-tuned language models can distinguish social isolation, social support, and contextually similar but unrelated language across heterogeneous clinical settings. FLAN-T5-Large provided the strongest and most stable performance, including for the less frequent social support class. The 3-class annotation framework, inclusion of difficult negative examples, and multisite evaluation offer a practical approach for converting nuanced social-connectedness documentation into structured data. Further work should evaluate end-to-end identification in unselected clinical notes and prospective integration into clinical and population health workflows.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：社会隔离和社会支持具有临床重要性，但在结构化电子健康记录数据中的表示并不一致。从临床叙述中识别这些概念较为复杂，原因在于语言细微且依赖上下文，以及不同临床环境、患者群体和地理位置对社会连接性的记录方式存在差异。因此，拟用于医疗保健的模型必须区分社会隔离与已记录的支持、否定、模糊的社会境况以及类似术语的非社会性临床用法，同时要对记录实践的差异保持稳健。目的：本研究旨在开发并评估可本地部署的微调语言模型，用于在多个卫生系统中对社会隔离、社会支持以及上下文相似但无关的临床文本进行上下文感知分类。材料与方法：我们开展了一项回顾性研究，使用电子健康记录数据，纳入2020年至2023年在田纳西州3个卫生系统接受医疗服务的326,847名50岁及以上成年人。候选临床文本通过社会环境ICD-10-CM Z代码和既有的社会隔离词表识别。人工标注者将来自6,881名患者贡献的9,578份临床记录中的9,748个文本片段分类为社会隔离、社会支持或无社会隔离。标注语料包含社会隔离和支持概念，包括否定、感染控制和微生物学术语、机构居住安排以及其他上下文模糊示例。对FLAN-T5-Large、BERT、RoBERTa和Gemma-2-2B进行微调，用于三分类文本片段分类。对表现最佳的模型FLAN-T5-Large评估了全量微调以及使用低秩适配方法的参数高效微调。性能采用基于站点的内部-外部交叉验证评估，以macro-F1为主要指标。结果：标注语料包括2,318个社会隔离文本片段、638个社会支持文本片段和6,792个被分类为无社会隔离的文本片段。全量微调的FLAN-T5-Large表现最佳，平均macro-F1为0.90（SD 0.01）。各类别F1分数分别为：社会隔离0.85（SD 0.03）、社会支持0.87（SD 0.04）、无社会隔离0.96（SD 0.02）。Gemma-2-2B的macro-F1为0.85（SD 0.01），RoBERTa为0.84（SD 0.06），BERT为0.86（SD 0.06）。在FLAN-T5-Large模型相应的留出评估中，二次汇总分析显示全量微调也优于参数高效微调（macro-F1 0.93对0.90）。剩余错误主要涉及独居但获得帮助的患者、家人陪伴但无实质性支持、与悲伤相关的语言，以及隔离术语的非社会性临床用法。结论：微调语言模型能够在异质临床环境中区分社会隔离、社会支持以及上下文相似但无关的语言。FLAN-T5-Large提供了最强且最稳定的性能，包括对较少见的社会支持类别。三分类标注框架、纳入困难负例以及多站点评估，为将细微的社会连接性记录转化为结构化数据提供了一种实用方法。进一步工作应评估在未筛选临床记录中的端到端识别，并评估其前瞻性整合到临床和人群健康工作流程中。

items.title_en: Reducing T gates in product formulas with agent loops
items.title_zh: 使用智能体循环减少乘积公式中的T门
items.abstract_en: Quantum chemistry calculations on a fault-tolerant quantum computer usually require many $\text{T}$ gates. This cost depends on the simulation method and how precisely its rotations are implemented. In this paper, we used Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, a large language model (LLM), in a coding-agent loop to optimize the structure and rotation-synthesis precision of product formulas (PFs) for quantum phase estimation (QPE). Each of five independent searches optimized a shared protocol across 115 HamLib molecular Hamiltonians spanning 4--16 qubits over 100 code mutations. The searches started from a calibrated, nested second-order PF with uniform synthesis precision. We minimized $T_{95}$, the estimated total $\text{T}$-gate cost including QPE queries and repeated attempts for $95\%$ success probability, while requiring chemical accuracy for every training Hamiltonian. We name the best protocol found error-limited optimized Trotter evolution (ELOTE). It achieves chemical accuracy for its training data and achieved median and geometric-mean $T_{95}$ reductions of $85.35\%$ and $84.82\%$, respectively. ELOTE combines contributions to the same Pauli string, uses a first-order PF, and varies synthesis precision with coefficient magnitude, Pauli support, and diagonal character. We also tested ELOTE on 76 larger Hamiltonians with 18--22 qubits, which met chemical accuracy in every case. For ten reaction energies, we further optimized a shared $δ$-ELOTE protocol. It reduced geometric-mean $T_{95}$ by $58.90\%$ relative to ELOTE while preserving chemical accuracy for every signed reaction difference. These classically verified results show cost savings from shared protocols across molecules and reactions, and motivate similar searches in which energy measurements from quantum computers guide explorations in a coding-agent loop.
items.abstract_zh: 在容错量子计算机上进行量子化学计算通常需要许多T门。该成本取决于模拟方法及其旋转实现的精确程度。在本文中，我们在编码智能体循环中使用大型语言模型（LLM）Nemotron 3.5 Lightning，来优化用于量子相位估计（QPE）的乘积公式（PF）的结构和旋转合成精度。五次独立搜索中的每一次都在100次代码变异中优化一个共享协议，覆盖115个HamLib分子哈密顿量，范围从4到16个量子比特。搜索从具有均匀合成精度的经校准嵌套二阶PF开始。我们最小化T95，即估计的总T门成本，包括QPE查询和为95%成功概率的重复尝试，同时要求每个训练哈密顿量达到化学精度。我们将找到的最佳协议命名为误差受限优化Trotter演化（ELOTE）。它在其训练数据上达到化学精度，并分别实现了中位数和几何平均T95降低85.35%和84.82%。ELOTE合并对同一Pauli串的贡献，使用一阶PF，并根据系数大小、Pauli支撑集和对角特性改变合成精度。我们还在76个具有18–22个量子比特的更大哈密顿量上测试了ELOTE，其在每种情况下都达到化学精度。对于十个反应能，我们进一步优化了一个共享的δ-ELOTE协议。相对于ELOTE，它将几何平均T95降低了58.90%，同时保持每个带符号反应差的化学精度。这些经经典验证的结果表明，跨分子和反应的共享协议可节省成本，并推动类似搜索，其中来自量子计算机的能量测量在编码智能体循环中引导探索。

items.title_en: Sliding-Window Detection of Hidden Regimes under Stochastic Switching
items.title_zh: 随机切换下隐藏机制的滑动窗口检测
items.abstract_en: A sliding-window average is a simple estimator of the current state of a hidden regime-switching process, such as a hidden Markov model. A longer window averages out more noise but is more likely to contain a switch, and the question is what such a switch costs. We analyse the decoder that assigns the average of the last $m$ observations to the nearest regime mean. For two regimes with conditionally independent, stochastically ordered observations, a switch inside the window, averaged uniformly over its positions and directions, causes an error with probability exactly $1/2$. Consequently, for every stationary switching law, the error is at most $\bar P(m)+\bar s(m-1)/2$, where $\bar P(m)$ is the stationary-weighted single-regime error and $\bar s$ the switch rate. Under Markov switching, time reversal shows that a window whose oldest and current regimes differ is misclassified with probability exactly $1/2$, however many switches it contains, and the bound is attained up to a factor $p_{\min}^{m-1}$. For Gaussian noise with common variance, minimizing the bound gives an explicit window length which, in units of $σ^2/Δ^2$, depends only on the expected number of switches in that time. As switching probabilities vanish proportionally, the optimal error is $\bar s\log(1/\bar s)/(2I)(1+o(1))$, with $I$ the single-regime Chernoff exponent. In the Gaussian case this is twice the Bayes error. For symmetric switching, exponentially weighted moving averages reduce this factor to at most $2\log2\approx1.39$, and two-block weights adapted to the switch rate attain the Bayes rate. For three or more regimes, long-window switch costs are set by the geometry of the regime means. For Markov-modulated random walks with $\pm1$ steps on a reflecting lattice, a position-aware decoder learns as fast as without walls under holding boundaries, while steps at bouncing boundaries carry none.
items.abstract_zh: 滑动窗口平均是隐藏机制切换过程（如隐马尔可夫模型）当前状态的一种简单估计器。更长的窗口能平均掉更多噪声，但更可能包含一次切换，问题在于这种切换的代价是什么。我们分析将最近m个观测的平均值分配给最近机制均值的解码器。对于具有条件独立、随机有序观测的两个机制，窗口内的一次切换在其位置和方向上均匀平均后，导致错误的概率恰好为1/2。因此，对于每个平稳切换律，误差至多为P̄(m)+s̄(m−1)/2，其中P̄(m)是平稳加权的单机制误差，s̄是切换率。在马尔可夫切换下，时间反转表明，最旧和当前机制不同的窗口无论包含多少次切换，被误分类的概率恰好为1/2，并且该界可在因子p_min^{m−1}内达到。对于具有共同方差的高斯噪声，最小化该界给出了一个显式窗口长度，其以σ^2/Δ^2为单位，仅取决于该时间内期望的切换次数。当切换概率按比例消失时，最优误差为s̄ log(1/s̄)/(2I)(1+o(1))，其中I是单机制Chernoff指数。在高斯情况下，这是贝叶斯误差的两倍。对于对称切换，指数加权移动平均将该因子降低到至多2log2≈1.39，而适应切换率的双块权重达到贝叶斯率。对于三个或更多机制，长窗口切换代价由机制均值的几何结构决定。对于在反射格点上具有±1步的马尔可夫调制随机游走，位置感知解码器在保持边界下学习速度与无墙时一样快，而在反弹边界处的步不携带任何信息。

items.title_en: $μ$-Bench: Benchmarking Multi-User Task Completion in Shared Interaction Voice Agents
items.title_zh: $μ$-Bench：面向共享交互语音代理的多用户任务完成基准测试
items.abstract_en: Voice agents in shared spaces must satisfy interdependent multi-user requests while upholding per-user authority, privacy, and task constraints. Existing evaluations offer limited coverage when participants react throughout a session. We introduce $μ$-Bench, a benchmark for joint task completion in closed-loop, full-duplex multi-user voice interaction. Simulated participants act from isolated profiles of goals, knowledge, and permissions, adapting to the agent's speech and tool outcomes. Across 20 domains, 100 scenarios vary group size, acoustics, and follow-up demands to form 800 cases (408 tool-augmented, 392 tool-free). Joint Task Success (JTS) requires all user goals, privacy boundaries, and terminal states to hold jointly, while Pure JTS further disallows unauthorized tool calls; Attribution, Threading, and Coordination (ATC) diagnostics localize failures. Across 13 voice agents, proprietary systems peak at 62.24\% tool-free and 65.44\% tool-augmented success, while open-weight models remain below 20\%. ATC diagnostics show that open-weight models lag primarily in multi-turn attribution and threading, and controlled contrasts reveal that larger groups consistently degrade joint task success across capable systems. By coupling reactive multi-user simulation with verifiable session-level outcomes, $μ$-Bench provides a rigorous testbed for shared voice agents.
items.abstract_zh: 共享空间中的语音代理必须在维护每位用户权限、隐私和任务约束的同时，满足相互依赖的多用户请求。现有评估在参与者于整个会话过程中做出反应时的覆盖范围有限。我们提出 $μ$-Bench，一个用于闭环、全双工多用户语音交互中联合任务完成的基准。模拟参与者依据彼此隔离的目标、知识和权限画像行动，并对代理的语音和工具结果作出适应。该基准覆盖 20 个领域，100 个场景通过改变群体规模、声学条件和后续需求，形成 800 个案例（408 个工具增强案例，392 个无工具案例）。联合任务成功（JTS）要求所有用户目标、隐私边界和终止状态同时成立，而纯 JTS 进一步禁止未经授权的工具调用；归因、线程化与协调（ATC）诊断用于定位失败。在 13 个语音代理中，专有系统最高达到 62.24\% 的无工具成功率和 65.44\% 的工具增强成功率，而开放权重模型仍低于 20\%。ATC 诊断显示，开放权重模型主要在多轮归因和线程化方面落后，受控对比还揭示，在能力较强的系统中，更大的群体规模会持续降低联合任务成功率。通过将反应式多用户模拟与可验证的会话级结果相结合，$μ$-Bench 为共享语音代理提供了严格的测试平台。

items.title_en: AGLR: Attribute-Guided Latent Refinement for Fine-Grained Humanoid Motion Generation and Editing
items.title_zh: AGLR：属性引导的潜在细化，用于细粒度人形运动生成与编辑
items.abstract_en: Humanoid motion generation must accommodate evolving task requirements, where localized adjustments should satisfy new geometric constraints without disrupting desired motion details. However, language-based control lacks geometric precision, while joint-level constraints require explicit spatial targets. Local geometric constraints are also underdetermined, complicating target satisfaction and source preservation. We present AGLR (Attribute-Guided Latent Refinement), a unified framework for fine-grained humanoid motion generation and editing through source-anchored refinement. A compact geometric interface supports composable, time-varying control of limb extents, torso orientation, and root trajectories. Given a generated or encoded base latent, an Attribute Residual Adapter predicts a single-pass correction, with dual-level supervision enforcing target matching and selective preservation across attributes and motion coordinates. On HumanML3D-G1, AGLR achieves the highest controllable-generation and preservation-constrained editing success rates among evaluated methods. Editing take only 9.1 ms for a cached 500-frame motion, without additional sampling or test-time optimization. Zero-shot evaluation on BONES-SEED-G1 further demonstrates transfer without fine-tuning.
items.abstract_zh: 人形运动生成必须适应不断变化的任务需求，其中局部调整应在不破坏所需运动细节的情况下满足新的几何约束。然而，基于语言的控制缺乏几何精度，而关节级约束需要明确的空间目标。局部几何约束也是欠定的，这使目标满足与源保留变得复杂。我们提出 AGLR（属性引导的潜在细化），一个通过源锚定细化实现细粒度人形运动生成与编辑的统一框架。一个紧凑的几何接口支持对肢体范围、躯干朝向和根轨迹进行可组合、随时间变化的控制。给定生成或编码的基础潜在表示，属性残差适配器预测单次前向修正，并通过双层监督在属性与运动坐标上强制目标匹配和选择性保留。在 HumanML3D-G1 上，AGLR 在所评估方法中取得了最高的可控生成成功率和保留约束编辑成功率。对于缓存的 500 帧运动，编辑仅需 9.1 ms，且无需额外采样或测试时优化。在 BONES-SEED-G1 上的零样本评估进一步展示了无需微调的迁移能力。

items.title_en: DDxBasis: Explaining Frozen Foundation Encoder-based Medical Classification by Exact Differential Diagnosis
items.title_zh: DDxBasis：通过精确鉴别诊断解释基于冻结基础编码器的医学分类
items.abstract_en: In differential diagnosis (DDx), a clinician explains a diagnosis by the few findings that separate it from the alternatives. Medical image classifiers cannot yet explain themselves this way. Existing explanations are either faithful but spread over hundreds of concepts, or compact but leave part of each decision unexplained. We present DDxBasis, which explains a classifier on a frozen foundation encoder as a differential diagnosis in three steps. First, a concept bottleneck reads all patch tokens at every encoder layer using gated, second-order slot attention. A concept basis then regroups the concepts into two-pole axes, each a differential between groups of diagnoses. Finally, we read a differential diagnosis from each axis through the typical presentation of its poles, the pertinent findings of the case, and counterfactual edits of borderline cases. Across five medical datasets, DDxBasis is the most accurate frozen-encoder model and close to the best published domain-specific results. Because every concept adds its own evidence, its reproducible concept basis splits each decision exactly, at no cost in accuracy. Without ordered stage or concept labels, the axes recover cell lineages and rare subtypes, agree with dermatologists' structure annotations, and expose planted and real shortcuts.
items.abstract_zh: 在鉴别诊断（DDx）中，临床医生通过少数将其与替代诊断区分开来的发现来解释诊断。医学图像分类器尚不能以这种方式自我解释。现有解释要么忠实但分散在数百个概念上，要么紧凑但使每个决策的一部分未被解释。我们提出 DDxBasis，它在冻结基础编码器上将分类器解释为鉴别诊断，分为三步。首先，概念瓶颈使用门控二阶槽注意力在每个编码器层读取所有图像块 token。随后，概念基将概念重新分组为双极轴，每个轴都是诊断组之间的差异。最后，我们通过各极的典型表现、病例的相关发现以及对边缘病例的反事实编辑，从每个轴读取鉴别诊断。在五个医学数据集上，DDxBasis 是最准确的冻结编码器模型，并接近已发表的最佳领域特定结果。由于每个概念都添加自身证据，其可复现的概念基能够精确拆分每个决策，且不带来准确率损失。在没有有序阶段标签或概念标签的情况下，这些轴能够恢复细胞谱系和罕见亚型，与皮肤科医生的结构标注一致，并揭示植入的捷径和真实捷径。

items.title_en: Navigating Gestational Health in the Reddit Pregnancy Community: A Mixed-Methods Study of Online Peer Discourse and Embodied Experience
items.title_zh: 在Reddit怀孕社区中探索妊娠健康：对在线同伴话语与具身经验的混合方法研究
items.abstract_en: Background: While health behaviours and clinical markers such as gestational weight gain GWG), physical activity, and nutrition are critical for optimizing maternal and fetal outcomes, pregnant individuals often face a fragmented informational landscape characterized by a heavy burden of clinical restrictions. Consequently, many turn to online, pseudo-anonymous communities like Reddit to crowdsource support, share experiences, and navigate complex health decisions outside the formal clinical encounter. This study aimed to examine how pregnant individuals utilize the Reddit community r/Pregnant to seek health-related information, navigate clinical recommendations surrounding GWG and health-related behaviours, and share lived experiences. Methods: An explanatory sequential mixed-methods study design was employed, combining computational topic modeling and qualitative analysis. In aim 1, all public posts published on the r/Pregnant subreddit between 2009 and 2024 were analyzed using BERTopic, a transformer-based modeling framework, to map the landscape of discourse and identify health-related topics. In aim 2, nine health-related topics were purposively selected, and 700 high-engagement posts (ranked by comment volume) across topics were analyzed using reflexive thematic analysis, following Braun and Clarke's six-phase framework. Results: BERTopic identified 90 distinct pregnancy-related topics across 15 years of discourse. Nine were health-related and selected for analysis, with gestational weight gain having the highest volume (Rank 14; 2,241 posts). Reflexive thematic analysis generated five overarching themes: (1) Reddit as a Site of Collective Sense-Making; (2) Decision-Making Under Uncertainty; (3) The Emotional Burden of Maternal Responsibility; (4) Embodied Knowledge in Practice; and (5) Social Pressure and Autonomy. Conclusions: A substantial gap exists between standardized prenatal clinical guidelines and the lived, physical reality of pregnancy. Pregnant individuals actively use digital peer support to adapt clinical advice, cope with weight-related stigma, and exercise autonomy. These findings highlight the importance of strengthening prenatal healthcare communication through more empathetic, non-judgmental, and individualized approaches that better reflect pregnant individuals concerns and lived experiences.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：虽然健康行为和临床标志物（如妊娠期体重增加（GWG）、身体活动和营养）对优化母婴结局至关重要，但孕妇常面临碎片化的信息环境，其特征是沉重的临床限制负担。因此，许多人转向Reddit等在线、伪匿名社区，以众包支持、分享经历，并在正式临床诊疗之外处理复杂的健康决策。本研究旨在考察孕妇如何利用Reddit社区r/Pregnant寻求健康相关信息、处理围绕GWG和健康相关行为的临床建议，并分享生活经验。方法：采用解释性序列混合方法研究设计，结合计算主题建模和定性分析。在目标1中，使用基于Transformer的建模框架BERTopic分析2009年至2024年间发布在r/Pregnant子版块的所有公开帖子，以绘制话语图景并识别健康相关主题。在目标2中，有目的性地选择九个健康相关主题，并使用反思性主题分析分析跨主题的700条高参与度帖子（按评论量排名），遵循Braun和Clarke的六阶段框架。结果：BERTopic在15年的话语中识别出90个不同的妊娠相关主题。其中九个与健康相关并选作分析，妊娠期体重增加的帖子量最高（排名第14；2,241条帖子）。反思性主题分析生成五个总体主题：（1）Reddit作为集体意义建构的场所；（2）不确定性下的决策；（3）母性责任的情感负担；（4）实践中的具身知识；（5）社会压力与自主性。结论：标准化产前临床指南与妊娠的真实、身体现实之间存在巨大差距。孕妇积极使用数字同伴支持来调整临床建议、应对与体重相关的污名并行使自主权。这些发现强调通过更具同理心、非评判性和个体化的方法加强产前医疗沟通的重要性，这些方法能更好地反映孕妇的关切和生活经验。

items.title_en: Reducing RSA-2048 Factoring Resources Below One Billion Toffolis via LLM-Driven Verifiable Quantum Compilation
items.title_zh: 通过LLM驱动的可验证量子编译将RSA-2048分解资源降至十亿Toffoli门以下
items.abstract_en: Modular exponentiation dominates the logical cost of factoring 2048-bit RSA integers (RSA-2048) with Shor's algorithm. Recent approaches based on approximate residue number systems (RNS) sharply reduce the required logical qubits, yet still demand billions of Toffoli gates. Optimizing these circuits is difficult because shared ancilla qubits and measurement-based uncomputation tightly couple the arithmetic stages, while rare overflows in compressed registers occur too infrequently for random simulation to detect. Here we use large language model (LLM)-driven search to redesign the RNS pipeline across stages and build a deterministic compiler that produces a Pareto frontier of RSA-2048 circuits. We bound rare overflow probabilities analytically and verify the resulting elementary gate sequences across all constituent RNS primes on representative circuits. Relative to Gidney's 2025 baseline under matched adder accounting, our frontier cuts the minimum qubit-Toffoli product by 70.1% and lowers expected factoring Toffolis by up to 78.6% at matched accumulator precision, bringing RSA-2048 factoring below one billion Toffolis for the first time.
items.abstract_zh: 模幂运算主导了用Shor算法分解2048位RSA整数（RSA-2048）的逻辑成本。近期基于近似剩余数系统（RNS）的方法大幅减少了所需逻辑量子比特，但仍需要数十亿个Toffoli门。优化这些电路很困难，因为共享辅助量子比特和基于测量的反计算紧密耦合算术阶段，而压缩寄存器中的稀有溢出发生得过于稀少，随机模拟难以检测。在此，我们使用大语言模型（LLM）驱动的搜索跨阶段重新设计RNS流水线，并构建确定性编译器，生成RSA-2048电路的帕累托前沿。我们解析地界定稀有溢出概率，并在代表性电路上验证所有组成RNS素数上的所得基本门序列。相对于Gidney 2025基线在匹配加法器核算下，我们的前沿将最小量子比特-Toffoli乘积降低70.1%，并在匹配累加器精度下将预期分解Toffoli门数最多降低78.6%，首次将RSA-2048分解降至十亿个Toffoli门以下。

items.title_en: Not all world models can doubt: how training objective and architecture shape epistemic uncertainty in JEPA and RSSM world models
items.title_zh: 并非所有世界模型都能“怀疑”：训练目标与架构如何塑造 JEPA 与 RSSM 世界模型中的认知不确定性
items.abstract_en: World models predict how an environment responds to actions, so that candidate actions can be evaluated before execution. Executed actions, or decisions, taken in this manner are only as reliable as the model's predictive capabilities, and predictions in turn are only reliable within the model's experience. Epistemic uncertainty (EU) is the signal that marks where that experience ends. In this work we offer an extensive empirical study on how training objectives and architectures shape epistemic uncertainty of world models. More precisely, we present a controlled comparison of post-hoc EU (last-layer Laplace and ensembles) between two dominant models of different paradigms: 1) LeWorldModel (LeWM): A joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA), which predicts the next embedding without a decoder, and 2) DreamerV3: A recurrent state-space model (RSSM), which reconstructs the observation from a recurrent latent state. In ten simulated visual-control environments, we follow a controlled state perturbation of the environment state through every stage of the models up to the final EU estimate. We find that the RSSM attenuates the state perturbation through two mechanisms before it reaches an estimator on the predictor feature. Its recurrent update averages over context, so a change in a single frame reaches the state at a fraction of its size and recovers only as the change persists. Its reconstruction objective weights an entity by the pixels it covers, so a small object can be lost due to the training objective. The JEPA has neither mechanism and passes the change through all stages to the uncertainty. We further show that this translates to gaps in five uncertainty related downstream tasks, from unfamiliar-state detection to uncertainty-penalised planning: the RSSM uncertainty misses deviations that its own posterior registers, whereas the JEPA uncertainty reports what its model sees.
items.abstract_zh: 世界模型预测环境如何对动作作出响应，从而可以在执行前评估候选动作。以这种方式执行的动作或决策，其可靠性取决于模型的预测能力；而预测又仅在模型的经验范围内可靠。认知不确定性（EU）是标记该经验范围终止位置的信号。在这项工作中，我们开展了一项广泛的实证研究，考察训练目标和架构如何塑造世界模型的认知不确定性。更具体地说，我们对两种不同范式的主流模型进行了事后 EU（最后一层 Laplace 和集成）的受控比较：1）LeWorldModel（LeWM）：一种联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），在没有解码器的情况下预测下一嵌入；2）DreamerV3：一种循环状态空间模型（RSSM），从循环潜在状态重建观测。在十个模拟视觉控制环境中，我们让环境状态受到受控状态扰动，并跟踪其经过模型各阶段直至最终 EU 估计。我们发现，RSSM 在状态扰动到达预测器特征上的估计器之前，通过两种机制削弱该扰动。其循环更新对上下文进行平均，因此单帧变化仅以一部分幅度到达状态，并且只有在变化持续时才恢复。其重建目标按实体覆盖的像素对其进行加权，因此小物体可能因训练目标而丢失。JEPA 没有这两种机制，会将变化贯穿所有阶段传递到不确定性。我们进一步表明，这转化为五个与不确定性相关的下游任务中的差距，从陌生状态检测到不确定性惩罚规划：RSSM 的不确定性漏掉了其自身后验所记录的偏差，而 JEPA 的不确定性报告了其模型所看到的内容。

items.title_en: DRBench Pro: A Knowledge-Centric Benchmark for Professional Deep Research Agents
items.title_zh: DRBench Pro：面向专业深度研究代理的以知识为中心的基准
items.abstract_en: Deep research agents gather information from multiple sources and synthesize it into reports on complex, open-ended questions. Existing benchmarks assess report quality along several dimensions, but lack a dedicated knowledge-centric evaluation of which research directions a report covers and how deeply it explores them. We introduce DRBench Pro, a benchmark that makes structured knowledge coverage the primary evaluation target. Our automated pipeline builds local knowledge trees from Wikipedia and uses sampled subgraphs to generate research queries and evidence-grounded rubrics. Each rubric corresponds to a relation in the tree, preserving the structure of the knowledge being evaluated. Agents receive only the research query. This structure allows us to measure breadth across major research directions and depth along related knowledge chains, with their geometric mean giving overall coverage. The benchmark includes 144 cases across 24 domains and 44,102 rubrics. Evaluating 16 deep research agents reveals different strengths in breadth and depth, with the best-performing agent reaching 57.04% overall coverage. Rubric judgments agree closely with human annotations, and agent rankings remain stable across the tested metric configurations.
items.abstract_zh: 深度研究代理从多个来源收集信息，并将其综合为关于复杂开放问题的报告。现有基准从多个维度评估报告质量，但缺乏一种专门以知识为中心的评估，用来衡量报告覆盖了哪些研究方向以及对这些方向的探索深度。我们提出 DRBench Pro，一个将结构化知识覆盖作为主要评估目标的基准。我们的自动化流水线从 Wikipedia 构建本地知识树，并使用采样子图生成研究查询和基于证据的评分细则。每条评分细则对应知识树中的一个关系，从而保留被评估知识的结构。代理仅接收研究查询。这种结构使我们能够衡量主要研究方向的广度以及相关知识点链上的深度，并以二者的几何平均值给出总体覆盖度。该基准包含 24 个领域的 144 个案例和 44,102 条评分细则。对 16 个深度研究代理的评估揭示了它们在广度和深度上的不同优势，表现最好的代理总体覆盖度达到 57.04%。评分细则判断与人工标注高度一致，并且代理排名在测试的指标配置下保持稳定。

items.title_en: One Policy, Many Bodies: Cooperative Human-Object Interaction with Heterogeneous Teams
items.title_zh: 一个策略，多种身体：异构团队中的人-物协作交互
items.abstract_en: Physics-based human-object interaction (HOI) has enabled multiple characters to cooperatively transport objects, but existing cooperative controllers largely assume homogeneous embodiments and predefined interaction tasks. We ask whether a single physics-based policy can enable cooperation across diverse embodiments, team compositions, and interaction skills. We present MorphHOI, a decentralised framework built on a key insight: effective heterogeneous cooperation requires a unified representation across embodiments while accounting for differences in their physical capabilities. To realise this insight, we introduce a canonical body interface that unifies observation and action spaces, together with an embodiment-conditioned transformer that adapts cooperative decisions to the physical capabilities of each agent and its teammates. To extend cooperation to new interaction skills, we reuse the learned cooperative policy through task-specific tokens and lightweight adaptation, preserving its original capabilities. Our framework achieves success rates of up to 96.7\% on seen embodiments, 95.6\% on unseen embodiments, and 91.4\% on novel payloads. Furthermore, the learned cooperation extends to diverse interaction skills with high success rates, including box carrying, transport on stairs, and waypoint following, while preserving previously acquired cooperative capabilities.
items.abstract_zh: 基于物理的人-物交互（HOI）已使多个角色能够协作搬运物体，但现有协作控制器大多假设同质具身和预定义交互任务。我们探究单一基于物理的策略能否在多样具身、团队组成和交互技能之间实现协作。我们提出MorphHOI，一个去中心化框架，基于一个关键洞见：有效的异构协作需要跨具身的统一表示，同时考虑其物理能力差异。为实现这一洞见，我们引入一个规范身体接口，统一观测空间和动作空间，并引入一个以具身为条件的Transformer，使协作决策适应每个智能体及其队友的物理能力。为将协作扩展到新的交互技能，我们通过任务特定token和轻量适配复用已学习的协作策略，同时保留其原始能力。我们的框架在已见具身上达到高达96.7%的成功率，在未见具身上达到95.6%，在新颖载荷上达到91.4%。此外，所学协作可扩展到多种交互技能并具有高成功率，包括搬箱子、在楼梯上运输和航点跟随，同时保留先前获得的协作能力。

items.title_en: Part-Set Prototypes for Explainable Mountain Gazelles Sex Classification
items.title_zh: 用于可解释山地瞪羚性别分类的部件集合原型（Part-Set Prototypes）
items.abstract_en: Self-explainable visual models for fine-grained recognition are often hindered by rigid geometric constraints that cannot capture diverse semantic shapes in unconstrained "in-the-wild" imagery. Real-world camera-trap data introduces challenges, including non-optimal poses, lighting variations, occlusions, animal camouflage, and environmental shortcuts. To address this, we introduce set prototypes, a general architecture where both part cardinality and unconstrained spatial layouts are mined directly from data. Our joint-matching formulation places parts simultaneously on a frozen DINOv3 token grid via truncated Sinkhorn competition, allowing unsupported parts to abstain without spatial collapse. We evaluate our approach on Mountain Gazelle sex classification, a camera-trap benchmark, where our model achieves 0.878 macro-F1--outperforming prior architectures and at par with an unconstrained linear probe. The strongest prototypes localize to distinctive biological areas such as horns, neck and body, allowing ecologists to visually verify decisions before trusting the metric. This formulation generalizes naturally to diverse ecological monitoring challenges beyond a single species.
items.abstract_zh: 用于细粒度识别的自解释视觉模型常常受到刚性几何约束的阻碍，这些约束无法捕捉无约束“野外”图像中多样的语义形状。真实世界的相机陷阱数据带来挑战，包括非最佳姿态、光照变化、遮挡、动物伪装和环境捷径。为解决这一问题，我们引入集合原型（set prototypes），一种通用架构，其中部件基数和无约束空间布局均直接从数据中挖掘。我们的联合匹配公式通过截断 Sinkhorn 竞争将部件同时放置在冻结的 DINOv3 token 网格上，使不受支持的部件能够弃权而不发生空间塌缩。我们在山地瞪羚性别分类这一相机陷阱基准上评估我们的方法，模型达到 0.878 macro-F1——优于先前架构，并与无约束线性探针持平。最强的原型定位到角、颈和身体等独特生物区域，使生态学家能够在信任指标之前可视化验证决策。该公式自然泛化到超越单一物种的多样生态监测挑战。

items.title_en: Lattice models of chiral random motion: A short review
items.title_zh: 手性随机运动的晶格模型：简短综述
items.abstract_en: Chirality, a systematic rotational bias, is ubiquitous in many random motion patterns, from bacteria cells, that swim in circles near surfaces and spinning colloids, to charged particles diffusing under the influence of magnetic fields. In two dimensions, chirality renders random transport \textit{odd}: the diffusion tensor acquires an antisymmetric part that leaves the mean-squared displacement invariant but modifies fluxes and boundary currents. Lattice models for random motion are a natural setting to study chirality, since they are exactly solvable, connect directly to heterogeneous media, cellular automata, and programmable robots, and in discrete time admit fully chiral limits with a localised bulk and edge transport. Lattice walks with a rotational bias have been introduced in different communities several times since 1960, yet without a common language or conceptual connection between them. Here we review these models from the perspective that on the lattice, chirality requires memory. Taking the recently introduced chiral random walk model as a template, we describe the walker with an internal degree of freedom. With a chiral biased updating rule, the full diffusion tensor of this chiral walker turns odd. Within this picture, we can unite persistent and chiral walks, run-and-tumble motion, and cyclic random motions in one framework. We discuss how the memory is followed into the environment; in Lorentz lattice gases, kinetic and rotor walks, and random odd environments; and into the path; in spiral self-avoiding walks.
items.abstract_zh: 手性，即系统性旋转偏置，广泛存在于许多随机运动模式中，从在表面附近做圆周游动的细菌细胞和旋转胶体，到在磁场影响下扩散的带电粒子。在二维中，手性使随机输运变为奇的：扩散张量获得反对称部分，该部分保持均方位移不变，但改变通量和边界流。随机运动的晶格模型是研究手性的自然框架，因为它们可精确求解、直接联系到异质介质、元胞自动机和可编程机器人，并在离散时间中允许具有局域体输运和边缘输运的完全手性极限。自1960年以来，不同领域多次引入具有旋转偏置的晶格行走，但彼此之间缺乏共同语言或概念联系。本文从“在晶格上手性需要记忆”的视角综述这些模型。以最近引入的手性随机行走模型为模板，我们用内部自由度描述行走者。在手性偏置更新规则下，该手性行走者的完整扩散张量变为奇的。在这一图景中，我们可以将持续行走与手性行走、运行-翻滚运动以及循环随机运动统一在一个框架中。我们讨论记忆如何进入环境——在洛伦兹晶格气体、动力学行走和转子行走以及随机奇环境中——以及如何进入路径——在螺旋自回避行走中。

items.title_en: Dark and bright solitons in a multimodal lithium tantalate microresonator
items.title_zh: 多模态钽酸锂微谐振器中的暗孤子和亮孤子
items.abstract_en: Bright-soliton and dark-pulse microcombs provide complementary outputs. Integrating both states in a single resonator would expand the operating capabilities of an integrated coherent source, but requires opposite group-velocity-dispersion (GVD) channels while reconciling localized interfamily interaction for dark-pulse formation with spectral isolation for independent bright-soliton pumping. Wavelength-addressed access to both states is achieved in a LiTaO$_3$ microring through two TE-like transverse mode families. The higher-order TE$_{10}$ family fulfills two distinct roles in different spectral regions. Within localized avoided-mode-crossing regions, mode-resolved spectroscopy implicates TE$_{10}$ in perturbing the normal-GVD TE$_{00}$ resonance sequence. Away from these regions, TE$_{10}$ retains anomalous GVD and remains spectrally isolated as an independently pumpable bright-soliton channel; at representative pump resonances, the closest resonance of the non-addressed family is separated by 75--192 loaded cavity linewidths. With the input polarization held fixed, pumping TE$_{00}$ and TE$_{10}$ resonances generates dark-pulse and bright-soliton microcombs, respectively. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first experimental realization of a dark-pulse microcomb in an integrated LiTaO$_3$ microring. These results establish transverse-mode-family engineering as a route to combining localized modal interaction with independent spectral addressing in a single microresonator.
items.abstract_zh: 亮孤子与暗脉冲微梳提供互补输出。在单一谐振器中集成这两种状态将扩展集成相干源的工作能力，但需要相反群速度色散（GVD）的通道，同时要协调用于暗脉冲形成的局域族间相互作用与用于独立亮孤子泵浦的光谱隔离。在LiTaO3微环中，通过两个类TE横模模族实现了对两种状态的波长寻址访问。高阶TE10模族在不同光谱区域承担两种不同角色。在局域避免模式交叉区域内，模式分辨光谱表明TE10参与扰动正常GVD的TE00谐振序列。在这些区域之外，TE10保持反常GVD，并作为可独立泵浦的亮孤子通道保持光谱隔离；在代表性泵浦谐振处，非寻址模族最近的谐振相隔75--192个加载腔线宽。在输入偏振保持固定的情况下，泵浦TE00和TE10谐振分别产生暗脉冲微梳和亮孤子微梳。据我们所知，这是在集成LiTaO3微环中首次实验实现暗脉冲微梳。这些结果确立了横模模族工程作为一种在单一微谐振器中结合局域模式相互作用与独立光谱寻址的途径。

items.title_en: The Linguistic Knowledge Benchmark: Do Language Models Know the Foundations of Early-Grade Literacy?
items.title_zh: 语言知识基准：语言模型是否了解低年级读写能力的基础？
items.abstract_en: Many languages of instruction in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) are poorly represented in the data used to train language models. Before these models can support early-grade literacy in such languages, we need to know whether they hold the linguistic knowledge of each language that literacy teaching relies on. To test this, we present the Linguistic Knowledge Benchmark and the reproducible, largely automated pipeline that turns curriculum documents, teacher guides and pupil books into a vetted question set organised on a fixed grid of nine linguistic domains and seven grade levels. The pipeline combines LLM-driven source survey, feature consolidation, item generation and quality control with an item-selection step inspired by item response theory and a final expert review. We instantiate it for Kiswahili (Kenya; 135 items) and English (United Kingdom; 137 items) and evaluate 121 and 119 models respectively. Frontier models exceed 90% accuracy in both languages, but accuracy falls steeply for smaller and cheaper models, and more so in Kiswahili. The two best models under 10 billion parameters reach 91.7% and 73.0% in English but only 51.9% and 40.7% in Kiswahili, and the mean accuracy of models deployable on mobile and tablet hardware is 47% in English against 24% in Kiswahili. The models most practical for low-resource classrooms are therefore the least capable in the languages they would serve. We release a 20-item sample per language, all pipeline prompts, open-source code, and a public leaderboard. This is the first rung of a three-level evaluation ladder for measuring and generating decodable text to support foundational literacy.
items.abstract_zh: 低收入和中等收入国家（LMIC）的许多教学语言在用于训练语言模型的数据中代表性不足。在这些模型能够支持此类语言的低年级读写能力之前，我们需要知道它们是否具备读写教学所依赖的每种语言的语言知识。为检验这一点，我们提出语言知识基准，以及一条可复现、基本自动化的流水线，该流水线将课程文件、教师指南和学生用书转化为经过审核的题目集，并组织在由九个语言领域和七个年级水平构成的固定网格上。该流水线结合了由 LLM 驱动的来源调查、特征整合、题目生成与质量控制，以及受项目反应理论启发的题目选择步骤和最终专家评审。我们为斯瓦希里语（肯尼亚；135 题）和英语（英国；137 题）实例化该基准，并分别评估了 121 个和 119 个模型。前沿模型在两种语言上的准确率均超过 90%，但更小、更便宜的模型准确率急剧下降，且在斯瓦希里语中下降更明显。参数量低于 100 亿的两个最佳模型在英语中达到 91.7% 和 73.0%，但在斯瓦希里语中仅为 51.9% 和 40.7%；可部署在手机和平板硬件上的模型平均准确率在英语中为 47%，在斯瓦希里语中为 24%。因此，对低资源课堂最实用的模型，在其将要服务的语言中反而能力最弱。我们发布每种语言 20 题的样本、所有流水线提示词、开源代码以及公开排行榜。这是用于测量和生成可解码文本以支持基础读写能力的三级评估阶梯的第一级。

items.title_en: One Latent World for Heterogeneous LiDARs: A Scan Pattern Agnostic 4D World Model via Direct Ray Decoding
items.title_zh: 异构LiDAR的单一潜在世界：通过直接光线解码的扫描模式无关4D世界模型
items.abstract_en: LiDAR world models generate and predict metric 3D observations in the form of LiDAR scans. They typically synthesize scans following the scan pattern of their training sensor or render them from an intermediate 3D surface or field. However, following one scan pattern limits transfer to LiDARs with other patterns, and rendering from intermediate geometry can cause incorrect depths and false returns. In this paper, we propose a scan pattern agnostic 4D LiDAR world model that decouples the scene from sensor observation, so one spatial latent can be observed by heterogeneous LiDARs at the same mounting position without regeneration. Our decoder predicts the hit probability and depth of each ray directly from the latent, combining global scene context with local features retrieved at a preliminary depth. Without an intermediate surface or field, it reduces incorrect depths and false returns, and as each ray is decoded independently from one latent, LiDARs that share a ray receive the same return and observe one consistent scene. Finally, a diffusion transformer generates scenes in this latent and predicts 4D sequences from observed latents warped by the given ego and object motion. On KITTI-360 and nuScenes, our model generates realistic scenes and reduces the registration error between predicted frames by about 70% relative to the best compared world model. Its decoder yields 19 to 28% lower depth error than the rendering used by other world models, and generated scans benefit several downstream tasks. Our code will be open-sourced. More details are available at https://minwoo0611.github.io/OneLatentWorld.
items.abstract_zh: LiDAR世界模型以LiDAR扫描的形式生成并预测度量3D观测。它们通常按照训练传感器的扫描模式合成扫描，或从中间3D表面或场渲染扫描。然而，遵循单一扫描模式限制了对具有其他模式的LiDAR的迁移，而从中间几何渲染可能导致错误深度和虚假回波。本文提出一种扫描模式无关的4D LiDAR世界模型，将场景与传感器观测解耦，使得同一安装位置上的异构LiDAR可观测同一个空间潜在表示而无需重新生成。我们的解码器直接从潜在表示预测每条光线的命中概率和深度，将全局场景上下文与在初步深度处检索到的局部特征相结合。无需中间表面或场，它减少了错误深度和虚假回波；由于每条光线从同一潜在表示独立解码，共享同一条光线的LiDAR获得相同回波并观测到一致场景。最后，一个扩散Transformer在该潜在空间中生成场景，并根据经给定自车和物体运动变形的观测潜在表示预测4D序列。在KITTI-360和nuScenes上，我们的模型生成逼真场景，并相对于最佳对比世界模型将预测帧之间的配准误差降低约70%。其解码器相比其他世界模型所用渲染产生低19%至28%的深度误差，生成的扫描有利于若干下游任务。我们的代码将开源。更多细节见 https://minwoo0611.github.io/OneLatentWorld。
